title: Stablecoins as Private Money: A Policy Agenda
affiliations: ETH Zurich - CER-ETH -Center of Economic Research, ETH Zürich and ETH Zürich - KOF Swiss Economic Institute

detail.title: Stablecoins as Private Money: A Policy Agenda

publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Financial Studies Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Stablecoins are rapidly expanding as money-like assets for payments, trading, settlement, and cross-border transfer. In response, policymakers are moving quickly to develop new regulatory frameworks to safeguard the monetary and financial system. This article develops a forward-looking, research-based policy agenda for stablecoins, drawing on monetary theory, recent market developments (including stress events), our own analytical framework, and the broader academic literature. In our view, a world in which stablecoins reach scale requires a coherent package of measures: tools to preserve financial stability and resilience against liquidity crises; protections for monetary sovereignty and the singleness of money; rules on stablecoin remuneration; constraints on platform market power alongside interoperability requirements; robust financial-integrity rules; and international coordination to limit regulatory arbitrage and close cross-border loopholes such as multi-issuer structures. We also highlight several areas that require further evaluation prior to policy adoption, including whether (and under what conditions) a public liquidity backstop for systemic issuers or central-bank reserve access is warranted, as well as modernization pathways within the traditional monetary system. We benchmark our agenda against the U.S. GENIUS Act and the EU’s MiCA and provide a cross-jurisdictional comparison.

AI.tldr: 该论文为稳定币制定了一个前瞻性的政策议程，基于货币理论和市场发展，提出了包括金融稳定工具、货币主权保护、平台监管、国际协调等一揽子措施，并与美国和欧盟的现有法规进行了比较。
AI.research_question: 在稳定币可能大规模应用的背景下，需要什么样的综合性政策框架来确保金融稳定、保护货币主权并促进健康发展？
AI.motivation: 稳定币作为类似货币的资产在支付、交易、结算和跨境转移中迅速扩张，政策制定者需要快速制定监管框架来保护货币和金融体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币理论、金融稳定理论、监管经济学、国际金融协调理论。
AI.method: 基于货币理论、近期市场发展（包括压力事件）、作者的分析框架以及更广泛的学术文献，进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 稳定币达到规模应用需要一揽子措施：金融稳定和流动性危机抵御工具；货币主权和货币统一性保护；稳定币报酬规则；平台市场力量约束和互操作性要求；健全的金融诚信规则；限制监管套利和跨境漏洞的国际协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 为稳定币监管提供了基于货币理论的系统性分析框架，整合了金融稳定、货币主权、平台监管等多维度理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的监管议程，包括具体措施建议和政策实施优先级，并与美国GENIUS法案和欧盟MiCA进行了比较分析，具有实际指导价值。

title: Latency-Critical AI Orchestration Frameworks for Financial and Mission-Critical SD-WAN Environments

detail.title: Latency-Critical AI Orchestration Frameworks for Financial and Mission-Critical SD-WAN Environments
detail.abstract: Financial trading platforms and other mission-critical enterprise networks are examples of latency-sensitive environments that require high-performance and high-reliability with quality of service (QoS) guarantees. Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN) provide flexibility and programmability; however, they continue to fall short of meeting the strict latency and fault-tolerance demands of these environments, especially when operating conditions are dynamic. This paper describes the first of its kind AI-driven orchestration framework designed specifically to improve the paradox of latency and increase the reliability in such environments. The framework employs real-time AI monitoring to tune and control cross-layer orchestration mechanisms to elicit changes to routing, resource allocation, and traffic steering. The methodology adopted both real-world and simulated contexts to provide a comprehensive assessment of varying prevailing conditions and network failures. The research shows a considerable enhancement in end-to-end fault tolerance, lost packets, and consistent QoS for latency-sensitive applications, especially in financial services. The improvements are the result of closed-loop AI designed to predict network failures and congestion and initiate routing changes autonomously without the need for human intervention. The findings highlight the potential of AI-driven SD-WAN orchestration to transform enterprise network management, offering a robust approach for organizations requiring high-performance, resilient connectivity. Future designs can leverage this framework to integrate more sophisticated predictive analytics, hybrid AI models, and automated policy enforcement to further enhance performance and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个AI驱动的SD-WAN编排框架，专门解决金融交易等延迟敏感环境中的延迟与可靠性矛盾问题，通过实时AI监控和跨层编排机制，显著提升了端到端容错能力和服务质量。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个AI驱动的SD-WAN编排框架，在动态操作条件下满足延迟敏感环境（如金融交易平台）的严格延迟和容错需求？
AI.motivation: 金融交易平台等关键任务企业网络需要高性能、高可靠性和服务质量保证，但现有SD-WAN在动态条件下仍无法满足严格的延迟和容错要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI驱动的网络编排理论、跨层网络优化理论、实时监控与预测分析理论、闭环控制系统理论。
AI.method: 采用真实世界和模拟环境相结合的方法，通过实时AI监控调整路由、资源分配和流量引导等跨层编排机制，评估不同网络条件和故障情况。
AI.findings: 研究显示在端到端容错、丢包率和延迟敏感应用（特别是金融服务）的QoS一致性方面有显著提升，AI能够预测网络故障和拥塞并自主启动路由变更。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出专门针对延迟敏感环境的AI驱动SD-WAN编排框架理论，建立了跨层编排与AI实时监控相结合的理论模型，为智能网络管理提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融交易等关键任务网络提供了可操作的AI驱动编排解决方案，能够自主预测和应对网络故障，减少人工干预，提升网络可靠性和性能，为企业网络管理提供了实用框架。

detail.abstract: Talking about theories of interest we will talk in detail about the different concepts given with respect to the interest rate. title: Generative AI's Implications for Democratic Elections in a World at Risk: A Dahlian Perspective

detail.title: Generative AI's Implications for Democratic Elections in a World at Risk: A Dahlian Perspective

publicationDetails.detailsText: Electoral Integrity Project, Technology and the Future of Democracy, Pre-APSA Workshop

detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping electoral competition, introducing novel capabilities for both political engagement and participation, on the one hand, and for the production and amplification of mis-and disinformation, on the other. These developments pose significant risks to electoral integrity. This article argues that generative AI manufactures uncertainty for democratic elections. After evaluating AI's pros and cons in electoral contexts, it proposes a theoretical and regulatory framework grounded in Dahl's polyarchy and Beck's risk society to better safeguard democratic institutions and electoral processes. A Dahlian perspective identifies contestation and inclusiveness as the twin pillars of durable democracies, highlighting how AI technologies can simultaneously enhance participation and pluralism or undermine informed public reasoning. Beck's theory of risk society illuminates the inherent dangers of deploying high-dimensional, stochastically uncertain, and multi-agential AI systems without sufficient precaution or oversight, revealing how the unintended consequences of technological innovation threaten institutional trust and electoral stability. Integrating insights from contemporary discourse on AI ethics and democratic theory (including the works of Amartya Sen, Frances McCall Rosenbluth, Ian Shapiro, and Hélène Landemore) this article examines generative AI's opportunities and risks for electoral integrity. It concludes by evaluating emerging regulatory responses in the United States, Canada, and the European Union, arguing for the creation of transparency mandates and oversight bodies capable of preserving democratic resilience in the age of generative AI.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI通过制造不确定性重塑选举竞争，既增强政治参与又放大虚假信息，威胁选举完整性。文章提出基于达尔多元政体和贝克风险社会的理论监管框架，建议建立透明度要求和监督机构来保护民主韧性。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何影响选举完整性？如何构建理论框架和监管措施来应对AI对民主选举带来的机遇和风险？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在重塑选举竞争，既带来政治参与的新能力，又加剧虚假信息的产生和传播，对选举完整性构成重大风险。需要系统分析AI对民主选举的影响并制定应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 达尔多元政体理论：强调竞争性和包容性是民主的两大支柱，分析AI如何同时增强参与和多元化或削弱公共理性
2. 贝克风险社会理论：揭示高维度、随机不确定、多主体AI系统在没有充分预防和监督下的固有危险
3. 结合AI伦理和民主理论（森、罗森布鲁斯、夏皮罗、兰德莫尔等）的当代论述
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建：综合评估AI在选举环境中的利弊，整合多元理论视角，分析生成式AI对选举完整性的机遇和风险，并评估现有监管回应。
AI.findings:
1. 生成式AI为选举制造不确定性，既可能增强政治参与和多元化，也可能破坏知情公共理性
2. AI技术的意外后果威胁制度信任和选举稳定性
3. 当前监管回应需要加强，特别是在透明度要求和监督机构建设方面
AI.theory_contributions:

2. 提出"AI制造选举不确定性"的核心论点
3. 整合AI伦理与民主理论，为理解技术-民主关系提供新视角

2. 提出建立透明度要求和监督机构的具体政策建议

title: Block-Level Urban Socioeconomic Characterization using Satellite Imagery and Points of Interest: The Case of Lima, Peru

detail.title: Block-Level Urban Socioeconomic Characterization using Satellite Imagery and Points of Interest: The Case of Lima, Peru

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses exclusively publicly available secondary geospatial data.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Understanding which observable urban characteristics explain socioeconomic status is essential for evidence-based policy, yet this question remains understudied at fine spatial scales. We develop an Urban Deprivation Index (UDI) for Metropolitan Lima, Peru, leveraging complete ground truth data for 102,368 census blocks to identify the geospatial features most strongly associated with official INEI socioeconomic stratification. Our approach integrates Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar, VIIRS nighttime lights, and 40,826 Points of Interest (POIs) from OpenStreetMap. Using a Random Forest model with 20 parsimoniously selected features, we achieve a Pearson correlation of r = 0.786 ± 0.050 and mean absolute error of 0.24 strata under rigorous spatial cross-validation (500 splits across 50 districts). The model correctly estimates 88.8% of blocks within ±0.5 strata of official classifications. Notably, SHAP analysis reveals that only two features-green space accessibility and urban remoteness-dominate 79% of individual predictions. However, the model demonstrates robustness: removing these two top features reduces performance by only 2.05%, indicating that information is redundantly distributed among the remaining variables. These findings suggest that socioeconomic segregation in Lima is fundamentally structured by environmental amenities and centrality. Unlike prior work focused on predicting poverty in data-scarce contexts, our methodology leverages complete ground truth data to answer a different question: not whether remote sensing can predict socioeconomic status, but which observable features characterize it. This interpretable approach offers direct implications for urban planning and social policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用遥感数据和兴趣点信息，开发了利马城市贫困指数(UDI)，通过随机森林模型识别与官方社会经济分层最相关的城市特征，发现绿色空间可达性和城市偏远性是主要影响因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些可观测的城市特征最能解释秘鲁大都市利马的社会经济状况？
AI.motivation: 理解可观测城市特征与社会经济状况之间的关系对于基于证据的政策制定至关重要，但在精细空间尺度上这一问题尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市贫困理论、社会经济分层理论、地理空间分析框架
AI.method: 使用随机森林模型，整合Sentinel-2多光谱影像、Sentinel-1合成孔径雷达、VIIRS夜间灯光数据和40,826个OpenStreetMap兴趣点，对102,368个普查区块进行空间交叉验证（50个区的500次分割）。
AI.findings: 模型达到Pearson相关系数r=0.786±0.050，平均绝对误差0.24个层级，88.8%的区块预测误差在±0.5个层级内。SHAP分析显示绿色空间可达性和城市偏远性主导79%的个体预测，但移除这两个特征仅使性能下降2.05%，表明信息在剩余变量中冗余分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 不同于以往在数据稀缺背景下预测贫困的研究，本研究利用完整地面实况数据回答"哪些可观测特征表征社会经济状况"的问题，揭示了利马社会经济隔离主要由环境便利设施和中心性结构决定。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划和公共政策提供直接启示，提供可解释的方法识别关键城市特征，有助于制定针对性的干预措施改善社会经济不平等。

title: Magnificent, but Not Extraordinary: Market Concentration in the US and Beyond
affiliations: , BI Norwegian Business School and Tilburg University

detail.title: Magnificent, but Not Extraordinary: Market Concentration in the US and Beyond
detail.abstract: We examine equity market concentration using a long US time series and a broad cross-section of developed markets. The current index weights of the largest firms align with historical and international patterns. Valuation concentration moves with earnings concentration. A standard geometric Brownian motion economy with firmspecific shocks reproduces observed concentration, with idiosyncratic volatility as the key driver. These results bound pure multiple stories and behavioral mechanisms. In this economy, the market portfolio remains optimal. High concentration, by itself, is thus not a reason to deviate from market weights or pursue breakup policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了股票市场集中度，发现当前最大公司的指数权重符合历史和国际模式。估值集中度与盈利集中度同步变化。标准几何布朗运动模型能够复现观察到的集中度，其中特质波动率是关键驱动因素。这些结果限制了纯粹倍数故事和行为机制的解释空间。在此经济中，市场组合仍然是最优的，高集中度本身不应成为偏离市场权重或实施拆分政策的理由。
AI.research_question: 股票市场集中度的驱动因素是什么？高集中度是否意味着市场组合不再是最优选择，或者需要政策干预？
AI.motivation: 当前市场集中度引发关注，人们担心少数大公司主导市场可能带来风险，并质疑市场组合是否仍然有效，以及是否需要政策干预来分散市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何布朗运动模型（GBM）与公司特定冲击；资产定价理论；市场组合最优性理论
AI.method: 使用美国长期时间序列数据和发达国家广泛横截面数据进行分析；构建标准几何布朗运动经济模型进行模拟
AI.findings: 1. 当前指数权重与历史和国际模式一致；2. 估值集中度与盈利集中度同步变化；3. 特质波动率是市场集中度的关键驱动因素；4. 标准GBM模型能够复现观察到的集中度模式
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为市场集中度提供了基于基本面的理论解释；2. 限制了纯粹倍数故事和行为机制的解释空间；3. 在存在高集中度的情况下，支持市场组合的最优性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 投资者不应仅因市场集中度高而偏离市场权重；2. 政策制定者不应仅因市场集中度高而实施公司拆分政策；3. 提供了评估市场集中度的实证基准

title: When Pairs Trading Fails: Parameter Instability Near the Unit Root Bayesian Estimation and Regime Detection for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Models

detail.title: When Pairs Trading Fails: Parameter Instability Near the Unit Root Bayesian Estimation and Regime Detection for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper shows that standard Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-based pairs trading strategies fail systematically due to parameter non-identifiability near the unit root. The transformation θ =-ln(ϕ)/∆ amplifies small estimation errors in the autoregressive coefficient into large errors in the mean-reversion rate, precisely when accurate estimates matter most. In simulations calibrated to classic equity pairs (XOM/CVX, KO/PEP, GLD/GDX), we find that 33% of strategy losses occur during just 25% of trading time-periods we classify as "lowidentifiability regimes." The Sharpe ratio drops from +0.79 in high-identifiability periods to-0.29 in low-identifiability periods. We propose two solutions: (1) a real-time identifiability score for position sizing, and (2) a Bayesian estimation framework with informative half-life priors and Hidden Markov Model regime detection. Code is available. For a $10M pairs book, avoiding low-identifiability regimes reduces drawdowns by approximately $28k annually.

AI.tldr: 基于标准Ornstein-Uhlenbeck模型的配对交易策略在单位根附近因参数不可识别而系统性地失败。作者提出实时可识别性评分和贝叶斯估计框架来改善策略表现。
AI.research_question: 标准Ornstein-Uhlenbeck配对交易策略为何会系统性失败？如何通过改进参数估计方法来提升策略表现？
AI.motivation: 传统配对交易策略在实际应用中表现不佳，特别是在某些时期出现系统性亏损。作者发现这是由于在单位根附近参数估计存在不可识别性问题，导致均值回归率估计误差被放大。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程、配对交易理论、时间序列分析、单位根理论、参数识别理论、贝叶斯统计、隐马尔可夫模型
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：展示参数变换θ=-ln(ϕ)/∆如何放大估计误差；2) 模拟研究：使用经典股票对（XOM/CVX, KO/PEP, GLD/GDX）进行校准模拟；3) 提出解决方案：实时可识别性评分和贝叶斯估计框架（包含信息性半衰期先验和隐马尔可夫模型机制检测）
AI.findings: 1) 33%的策略亏损发生在仅25%的"低可识别性机制"交易时段；2) 高可识别性时期的夏普比率为+0.79，低可识别性时期降至-0.29；3) 对于1000万美元的配对交易组合，避免低可识别性机制每年可减少约2.8万美元的回撤
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了标准Ornstein-Uhlenbeck配对交易策略系统性失败的根本原因——单位根附近的参数不可识别性；2) 提出了参数估计误差放大的理论机制；3) 建立了配对交易中参数可识别性的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了实时可识别性评分系统用于头寸规模调整；2) 提出了贝叶斯估计框架，包含信息性半衰期先验和隐马尔可夫模型机制检测；3) 提供了可操作的代码实现；4) 量化了改进方法的经济效益

title: The Tailoring Premium: AI Design, Behavioral Engagement, and Human Capital Formation

detail.title: The Tailoring Premium: AI Design, Behavioral Engagement, and Human Capital Formation
detail.abstract: The productivity of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in education depends critically on technology adoption and user effort. In a large-scale randomized controlled trial with 2,440 students, we estimate the causal returns to a "curriculum-tailored'' chatbot versus a "general-purpose'' generative AI model. While the generic model yields learning outcomes indistinguishable from traditional instruction, the tailored tool increases immediate human capital accumulation by 0.126 standard deviations. We identify endogenous effort as the driving mechanism: the tailored design solves a critical participation constraint, increasing task completion by 13.2 percentage points, whereas the generic tool fails to elicit effort. For "compliers'' induced to engage by the tailored design, long-term knowledge retention increases by 0.309 standard deviations. These findings suggest that the returns to AI depend less on the underlying model's sophistication and more on design choices that address human behavioral constraints.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过大规模随机对照试验发现，针对课程定制的AI聊天机器人比通用生成式AI模型更能提升学习效果，关键在于定制设计能解决参与约束、激发学生努力，而非模型本身的复杂程度。
AI.research_question: 课程定制的AI聊天机器人与通用生成式AI模型在教育中的因果回报有何差异？
AI.motivation: AI在教育中的生产力取决于技术采纳和用户努力，但现有研究对不同类型的AI工具如何影响学习效果缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术采纳理论、行为经济学中的参与约束理论，以及人力资本积累理论。
AI.method: 在2,440名学生中进行大规模随机对照试验，比较"课程定制"聊天机器人与"通用"生成式AI模型的效果。
AI.findings: 通用模型的学习结果与传统教学无差异，而定制工具使人力资本积累提高0.126个标准差；定制设计解决了参与约束，任务完成率提高13.2个百分点；对"遵从者"而言，长期知识保留提高0.309个标准差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI回报更多取决于解决人类行为约束的设计选择，而非底层模型的复杂程度；强调内生努力作为关键机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育AI设计提供指导：应优先考虑课程定制化以激发用户参与，而非追求模型复杂性；为教育技术投资决策提供实证依据。

title: Are We Studying "Climate Refugees"? Some Methodological Challenges Identifying Environmental Drivers of Human Mobility in Central America's Northern Triangle
affiliations: American University - Center for Latin American  & Latino Studies (CLALS), Universidad de Oriente and American University

detail.title: Are We Studying "Climate Refugees"? Some Methodological Challenges Identifying Environmental Drivers of Human Mobility in Central America's Northern Triangle

declarations.funderStatement: This research was carried out as part of a USAID-supported Cooperative Agreement (Number 72051918CA00002) with the Universidad del Oriente titled "Civil Society and Democracy in the Eastern Region," for which American University's Center for Latin American and Latino Studies was also a partner. Any errors or omissions are solely our own.

publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Latin American & Latino Studies (CLALS) Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This article offers a meta-analysis of a survey designed and implemented to explore the sociodemographic characteristics of potential migrants from the Eastern part of El Salvador. Because the survey was also intended to investigate the role of climate change as a possible driver of migration, it presents an opportunity to identify some methodological challenges in nascent research on the climate-migration nexus in Central America’s Northern Triangle. Examining our survey design and results, we draw attention to the following issues for researchers hoping to better understand climatic factors as drivers of migration: 1. how climatic factors can fall out of survey results, 2. the value of using available data sources in advance to determine climate affected populations as research subjects, 3. challenges of step migration and avoiding recency bias, 4. accounting for slow-onset climate impacts, 5. benefits of eliciting complete personal migration histories, 6. the value of rapid
ethnography to incorporate local discourses about the environment as a part of survey design.

AI.tldr: 本文对萨尔瓦多东部潜在移民的社会人口特征调查进行元分析，探讨气候变化作为移民驱动因素的研究方法挑战，提出六项改进建议。
AI.research_question: 如何更好地理解气候变化作为中美洲北部三角地区移民驱动因素的研究方法挑战？
AI.motivation: 气候变化与移民关系的研究在中美洲北部三角地区尚处于起步阶段，现有调查方法存在局限性，需要识别和改进研究方法以更准确地理解气候因素对移民的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变化与移民关系理论、环境移民理论、调查方法论、元分析方法论。
AI.method: 元分析方法，对萨尔瓦多东部潜在移民调查的设计和结果进行分析，识别研究方法挑战。
AI.findings: 识别出六项关键研究方法挑战：1) 气候因素在调查结果中可能被忽略；2) 需要预先使用可用数据确定受气候影响人群；3) 阶梯式移民和避免近期偏误的挑战；4) 考虑缓慢发生的气候影响；5) 收集完整个人移民历史的好处；6) 快速民族志方法在调查设计中的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为气候变化与移民关系研究提供了方法论框架，提出了改进调查设计的理论指导，丰富了环境移民研究的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了六项具体可行的调查设计建议，帮助更准确地识别气候因素对移民的影响，提高研究质量和政策相关性。

title: Constitutional Stewardship: Executive Power, Legitimacy, and Institutional Durability in an Era of Permanent Crisis

detail.title: Constitutional Stewardship: Executive Power, Legitimacy, and Institutional Durability in an Era of Permanent Crisis
detail.abstract: Contemporary democratic executives govern in conditions of persistent crisis, declining public trust, accelerated information warfare, and heightened judicial scrutiny. Existing theories of executive power-ranging from strong executive models to procedural minimalism-struggle to reconcile decisiveness with legitimacy, adaptability with restraint, and crisis action with constitutional durability. This article introduces Constitutional Stewardship as a governing philosophy that reconceptualizes executive power as custodial responsibility for constitutional legitimacy, institutional continuity, and democratic consent-especially under conditions of crisis and uncertainty. Drawing on constitutional law, democratic legitimacy theory, public administration ethics, crisis governance research, and decision science, the article articulates a set of design principles that operationalize restraint, learning, and legitimacy as enforceable features of executive governance. Constitutional Stewardship offers a framework for evaluating executive action beyond outcomes alone and provides a system-level response to recurring patterns of executive failure in modern democracies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"宪法管家"作为新的行政权力治理哲学，将行政权力重新概念化为对宪法合法性、制度连续性和民主同意的监护责任，特别关注危机和不确定性条件下的治理。
AI.research_question: 在当代民主国家面临持续危机、公众信任下降、信息战加剧和司法审查加强的背景下，如何重新概念化行政权力，以平衡决断力与合法性、适应性与克制、危机行动与宪法持久性？
AI.motivation: 现有行政权力理论（从强行政模式到程序最小主义）难以调和决断力与合法性、适应性与克制、危机行动与宪法持久性之间的矛盾，需要新的治理哲学来应对现代民主国家面临的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法管家理论，融合宪法法律、民主合法性理论、公共行政伦理、危机治理研究和决策科学。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，通过整合多学科理论资源，提出宪法管家作为治理哲学，并阐述其设计原则。
AI.findings: 宪法管家将克制、学习和合法性操作化为行政治理的可执行特征，提供了一个超越单纯结果评估的行政行动评估框架，并为现代民主国家反复出现的行政失败模式提供了系统层面的回应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了宪法管家作为新的行政权力治理哲学；2. 重新概念化行政权力为监护责任；3. 提供了平衡决断力与合法性的理论框架；4. 整合了多学科理论资源。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为行政行动评估提供了超越结果的框架；2. 为现代民主国家的行政失败提供了系统解决方案；3. 提供了可操作的设计原则；4. 有助于提升危机条件下的治理质量。

title: Prosperity, Status Signal Inflation, and the Moralized Decline of Complex Societies

detail.title: Prosperity, Status Signal Inflation, and the Moralized Decline of Complex Societies
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a micro-founded theoretical model to explain the internal and gradual decline of complex societies at high levels of prosperity and security. Existing accounts often rely on macro-structural variables or teleological narratives and lack a clear linkage between individual motivations and systemic outcomes. The model integrates insights from status competition, sexual selection, and political sociology. It argues that when key status signals-material wealth for men and reproductive success for women-lose their differential value under conditions of widespread prosperity, individuals adapt their behavior in ways that unintentionally transform moral norms, political incentives, and institutional capacities. The resulting dynamics include the migration of status competition toward moral signaling, the rise of care-centered ethics and moral universalism, redistributive populism, fiscal stress, identity delegitimation, and declining internal and external security. These processes are not treated as ideological projects but as emergent outcomes of aggregated individual responses to changing incentives. The model is stress-tested through comparative references to the late Roman Empire, imperial China, and other historical cases, as well as through partial counterexamples. The paper does not offer deterministic predictions but identifies conditional mechanisms that generate recurrent vulnerabilities in prosperous civilizations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个微观基础理论模型，解释复杂社会在高度繁荣和安全水平下的内部渐进式衰落。模型整合地位竞争、性选择和政治社会学见解，认为当关键地位信号（男性物质财富和女性生殖成功）在普遍繁荣条件下失去差异价值时，个体会调整行为，无意中改变道德规范、政治激励和制度能力，导致道德信号化、关怀伦理兴起、再分配民粹主义、财政压力、身份合法性下降和安全衰退等动态过程。
AI.research_question: 复杂社会在高度繁荣和安全水平下为何会经历内部渐进式衰落？个体行为如何通过地位竞争和性选择机制转化为系统性社会变迁？
AI.motivation: 现有解释多依赖宏观结构变量或目的论叙事，缺乏个体动机与系统结果之间的清晰联系。需要建立微观基础理论模型来填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合地位竞争理论、性选择理论和政治社会学。核心理论框架包括：地位信号理论（物质财富作为男性地位信号，生殖成功作为女性地位信号）、激励结构变化理论、道德规范演化理论、制度能力衰退理论。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与历史案例比较分析。通过构建微观基础理论模型，结合罗马帝国晚期、中华帝国等历史案例进行压力测试，并使用部分反例进行验证。
AI.findings: 当普遍繁荣使关键地位信号失去差异价值时，个体行为调整导致：地位竞争向道德信号迁移、关怀中心伦理和道德普遍主义兴起、再分配民粹主义、财政压力、身份合法性下降、内外安全衰退。这些过程是个人对变化激励的聚合反应，而非意识形态项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了连接个体动机与系统社会变迁的微观基础理论模型；2）整合了地位竞争、性选择和政治社会学跨学科见解；3）提出了繁荣社会衰落的非目的论解释机制；4）识别了产生重复性脆弱性的条件机制而非确定性预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者识别繁荣社会的系统性风险提供分析框架；2）帮助理解当代社会面临的类似挑战（如身份政治、财政压力、安全衰退）；3）为历史比较研究提供新的解释工具；4）强调激励结构设计对社会长期稳定的重要性。

title: Adaptive Recursive Dimensional Compression (ARDC): A Scaling Law for Emergent Efficiency

detail.title: Adaptive Recursive Dimensional Compression (ARDC): A Scaling Law for Emergent Efficiency

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, patient data, or participant interaction. All analyses are conducted on synthetic data, publicly available benchmark datasets, or simulated systems. As such, no ethics approval or informed consent was required.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Adaptive Recursive Dimensional Compression (ARDC): a measurable efficiency relation for controlled recursion in learning and decision systems. ARDC models the tradeoff between redundancy removal and information decay by defining efficiency E(n) = 2−(n−1)MnC2 n Kn µn , (1) where n is recursion depth, Mn is informational mass (effective dimension), Cn is clarity (bounded coherence proxy), Kn is knowledge integrity (retained task relevant performance), and µn is uncertainty load (strictly positive risk/entropy proxy). The key claim is operational: recursion should be audited and stopped when marginal efficiency gains are exhausted under integrity constraints, rather than pushed deeper by default. Empirical results and controller demonstrations show a consistent crossover behavior: when redundancy removal dominates information decay, recursion transitions from destructive compression to adaptive abstraction, yielding higher performance-per-cost. ARDC therefore acts as a falsifiable stopping law that links information structure, computational cost, and governed recursion depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应递归维度压缩（ARDC）：一种用于学习和决策系统中受控递归的可测量效率关系。ARDC通过定义效率公式E(n)来建模冗余消除与信息衰减之间的权衡，并提出递归应在边际效率增益耗尽时停止，而非默认深入递归。实证结果显示，当冗余消除主导信息衰减时，递归会从破坏性压缩转变为自适应抽象，从而提高性能成本比。
AI.research_question: 在学习和决策系统中，如何确定最优的递归深度，以平衡冗余消除与信息衰减，实现效率最大化？
AI.motivation: 当前递归系统通常默认深入递归，缺乏对递归效率的量化评估，导致可能过度压缩信息而损害性能。需要一种可测量的方法来指导递归深度选择，确保在保留任务相关性能的同时最大化效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应递归维度压缩（ARDC）理论框架，基于信息论和计算效率概念，定义效率函数E(n) = 2−(n−1)MnC2 n Kn µn，其中包含信息质量（Mn）、清晰度（Cn）、知识完整性（Kn）和不确定性负载（µn）四个关键维度。
AI.method: 提出ARDC效率关系作为可测量的停止法则，通过实证研究和控制器演示验证交叉行为：当冗余消除主导信息衰减时，递归从破坏性压缩转变为自适应抽象。
AI.findings: 实证结果显示一致的交叉行为：当冗余消除主导信息衰减时，递归深度达到最优点，此时性能成本比最高。递归不应无限深入，而应在边际效率增益耗尽时停止。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出首个可测量的递归效率关系ARDC；2. 建立信息结构、计算成本和递归深度之间的理论联系；3. 提供可证伪的停止法则，为递归系统设计提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为学习和决策系统提供实用的递归深度选择方法；2. 帮助系统设计者避免过度递归导致的性能下降；3. 提高计算资源利用效率，实现更高的性能成本比；4. 为递归控制器设计提供量化依据。

title: Nexus Between Economic Development, Energy Poverty and ICT in Bangladesh

detail.title: Nexus Between Economic Development, Energy Poverty and ICT in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This paper examines the correlation between energy poverty, population, and internet use and the economic development of Bangladesh based on data in the World Bank between 2000 and 2019. Unit root test and Granger Causality test were used to determine whether these factors affect each other. Despite the fact that the GDP of Bangladesh has been increasing substantially, the access to electricity has been sporadic. It has become universal and hence is reliable and affordable, but this has been a challenge. The internet is being used by more people but the mobile towers require a constant supply of electricity and this has become a challenge to businesses and even to the homes. The outcome reveals that GDP has an impact on the access to electricity and the number of internet users has an impact on the access to electricity.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2000-2019年世界银行数据，研究了孟加拉国能源贫困、人口和互联网使用与经济发展的相关性。研究发现GDP影响电力获取，互联网用户数量也影响电力获取。
AI.research_question: 能源贫困、人口和互联网使用如何影响孟加拉国的经济发展？这些因素之间是否存在相互影响关系？
AI.motivation: 尽管孟加拉国GDP大幅增长，但电力供应仍然不稳定且不可靠。互联网使用增加但需要稳定电力供应，这对企业和家庭构成挑战。需要理解这些因素之间的相互关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济发展理论、能源贫困理论、数字鸿沟理论、基础设施与经济增长关系理论
AI.method: 使用2000-2019年世界银行数据，采用单位根检验和格兰杰因果关系检验分析变量间的相互影响关系
AI.findings: 1. GDP对电力获取有显著影响；2. 互联网用户数量对电力获取有显著影响；3. 尽管GDP增长，但电力供应仍然不稳定；4. 互联网普及受电力供应限制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了经济发展与能源基础设施的因果关系；2. 揭示了数字技术普及与能源供应的相互依赖关系；3. 为发展中国家能源-数字-经济三角关系提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为孟加拉国政策制定者提供电力基础设施投资依据；2. 强调同步发展能源和数字基础设施的重要性；3. 为其他类似发展中国家提供可借鉴的经验

title: The Legitimacy Divergence Diagnostic (LDD): A Preventive Framework for Detecting Institutional Drift in Legal Systems

detail.title: The Legitimacy Divergence Diagnostic (LDD): A Preventive Framework for Detecting Institutional Drift in Legal Systems
detail.abstract:
Across common law jurisdictions, legal reform demonstrates a recurring tendency toward reactivity, emerging after tragedy, public scandal, or visible system failure rather than through preventive institutional assessment. This paper introduces the Legitimacy Divergence Diagnostic (LDD), a non-justiciable, limitation-aware framework designed to identify early divergence between procedural legal order and lived justice outcomes before institutional legitimacy erosion becomes externally visible.

The LDD operates as a meta-legal diagnostic tool rather than a doctrine of law, regulatory instrument, or adjudicative standard. It does not assess individual guilt, adjudicative correctness, or institutional intent, nor does it attribute fault to specific actors. Instead, it examines how cumulative asymmetries—between authority and accountability, order and mercy, and abstraction and lived experience—can gradually hollow institutional legitimacy despite sustained formal compliance with legal standards.

Drawing on law-and-society research, institutional burnout literature, and comparative justice reform analysis, the paper argues that legitimacy erosion is often detectable well in advance of crisis, yet remains structurally unaddressed due to the absence of early-warning diagnostics within legal governance frameworks.

To ground the framework empirically, the paper foregrounds a proposed New South Wales youth justice pilot program, focusing on remand overuse and the overrepresentation of Aboriginal youth. The pilot outlines a controlled, evaluative application of the LDD as a preventive legitimacy assessment tool, integrating diversionary pathways, institutional self-audit indicators, and measurable outcome metrics, including recidivism, remand duration, practitioner wellbeing, and community trust. The pilot is explicitly falsifiable: if no measurable improvement is observed relative to matched control cohorts, the LDD hypothesis is subject to revision or rejection.

The paper concludes that the LDD offers legal institutions a disciplined method for preventive self-correction that preserves institutional legitimacy while reducing long-term harm. By enabling reform prior to crisis, the framework seeks to strengthen—not undermine—the ethical resilience, public confidence, and adaptive capacity of the rule of law.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"合法性分歧诊断(LDD)"框架，用于在制度合法性侵蚀变得外部可见之前，早期识别程序法律秩序与实际司法结果之间的分歧，旨在实现预防性改革而非危机后反应。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个早期预警诊断框架，在制度合法性侵蚀变得外部可见之前，识别程序法律秩序与实际司法结果之间的分歧？
AI.motivation: 普通法司法管辖区存在"反应性"法律改革倾向，总是在悲剧、公共丑闻或明显系统失败后才进行改革，缺乏预防性制度评估机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与社会研究、制度倦怠文献、比较司法改革分析，重点关注权威与问责、秩序与仁慈、抽象与生活经验之间的累积不对称性。
AI.method: 提出LDD作为元法律诊断工具，通过新南威尔士州青少年司法试点项目进行实证检验，包括分流途径、制度自我审计指标和可衡量的结果指标。
AI.findings: 合法性侵蚀通常在危机发生前就可检测到，但由于法律治理框架中缺乏早期预警诊断工具而未被解决；LDD提供了预防性自我纠正的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个非可诉的、限制意识的理论框架，用于早期检测合法性分歧；将法律与社会研究、制度倦怠理论整合到法律改革分析中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律机构提供预防性自我纠正的纪律方法；通过新南威尔士州青少年司法试点项目展示实际应用；包含可证伪的评估机制。

title: Customer-Facing Technologies and Banks' Macroeconomic Information Production
affiliations: HKUST Business School, Harvard Business School, Columbia University - Columbia Business School and

detail.title: Customer-Facing Technologies and Banks' Macroeconomic Information Production

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Accounting & Management Unit Working Paper No. 25-057

detail.abstract: We examine whether technologies deployed in banks’ customer-facing functions improve their ability to produce information about future macroeconomic conditions. Although primarily adopted to enhance customer engagement, these technologies, such as web analytics and behavioral tracking software, allow banks to collect timely and granular data from a broad base of customers that inform assessments of local economic conditions. Using a novel measure of customer-facing technology adoption derived from banks’ website source code, we find that banks with greater adoption produce loan loss provisions that are more informative about future regional economic activity. This effect is driven by technologies that collect macro-relevant data and is stronger for banks with larger and more digitally engaged customer bases, for banks operating in more economically volatile regions, and for banks with greater data-related human capital. We further find that banks with greater adoption of customer-facing technologies experience smaller increases in nonperforming loans following adverse macroeconomic changes and disclose more macroeconomic content in regulatory filings and conference calls. Overall, our findings highlight a distinct informational role of customer-facing technologies in banks’ forecasting, risk management, and financial reporting.

AI.tldr: 研究发现银行面向客户的技术（如网络分析和行为跟踪软件）能够收集及时、细粒度的客户数据，帮助银行更好地预测未来宏观经济状况，从而改善贷款损失准备的信息含量、风险管理和财务报告。
AI.research_question: 银行面向客户的技术是否提高了它们预测未来宏观经济状况的能力？
AI.motivation: 银行主要为了增强客户参与度而采用面向客户的技术，但这些技术（如网络分析和行为跟踪软件）使银行能够从广泛的客户群中收集及时、细粒度的数据，这些数据可能有助于评估当地经济状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息生产理论、技术采纳与信息优势理论、银行风险管理理论
AI.method: 使用从银行网站源代码提取的新型客户面技术采纳度量，分析技术采纳程度与贷款损失准备对未来区域经济活动预测能力之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 技术采纳程度更高的银行产生的贷款损失准备对未来区域经济活动更具信息含量；2. 这种效应由收集宏观相关数据的技术驱动；3. 对拥有更大、更数字化客户群的银行、在经济波动更大地区运营的银行以及拥有更多数据相关人力资本的银行效应更强；4. 技术采纳程度高的银行在宏观经济不利变化后不良贷款增加较少，并在监管文件和电话会议中披露更多宏观经济内容。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了面向客户技术在银行信息生产中的独特作用；2. 扩展了技术采纳对金融机构信息优势影响的理论；3. 为银行技术投资与宏观经济预测能力之间的关系提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行投资面向客户技术提供了经济合理性；2. 帮助监管机构理解技术如何影响银行的风险管理和报告实践；3. 为投资者评估银行的信息质量和风险管理能力提供了新视角。

title: Addressing the “Chicken-and-Egg” Dilemma: Pension Reform, Market Coordination, and Policy Design
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Addressing the “Chicken-and-Egg” Dilemma: Pension Reform, Market Coordination, and Policy Design
detail.abstract: Why do domestic stock markets in many emerging market economies fail to develop, even in the presence of high savings rates? We argue this can be a “chicken-and-egg” problem, which we formalize as a market coordination failure. In this paper, we first develop a stylized game-theoretical model showing that when long-term equity investment is subject to network externalities, the Pareto-optimal, high-investment equilibrium is not robust to noise. Individual investors, fearing defection by others, will rationally choose a low-investment (or “run”) strategy, trapping the market in a state of underdevelopment. We then show how a specific institutional design—a fully-funded, individually-owned, collectively-managed, mandatory/incentivized (FICMI) pension scheme—can act as a credible coordination device and explore the welfare implications in a tractable three-period model. By providing a guaranteed, patient source of capital, FICMI changes investor expectations and makes the high-investment, high-welfare equilibrium robust and achievable. This paper provides a new theoretical justification for funded pension systems, not as a tool to correct individual myopia, but as a public-finance institution designed to solve a collective action problem in financial market development.

AI.tldr: 本文认为新兴市场股市不发达是一个"鸡生蛋蛋生鸡"的协调失败问题。作者建立博弈模型显示，由于网络外部性，帕累托最优的高投资均衡对噪声不稳健，投资者会理性选择低投资策略。提出FICMI养老金制度作为可信协调机制，通过提供耐心资本改变投资者预期，实现高投资高福利均衡。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多新兴市场经济体在国内储蓄率较高的情况下，国内股票市场仍然无法发展？
AI.motivation: 许多新兴市场国家存在高储蓄率与股市不发达并存的现象，传统理论难以解释这一矛盾。作者认为这是市场协调失败问题，需要从集体行动角度理解金融市场发展障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、网络外部性理论、协调失败理论、集体行动理论、制度经济学
AI.method: 1. 建立简化的博弈论模型分析长期股权投资的网络外部性；2. 构建三时期模型分析FICMI养老金制度的福利影响
AI.findings: 1. 由于网络外部性，帕累托最优的高投资均衡对噪声不稳健；2. 个体投资者担心他人背叛会理性选择低投资策略；3. FICMI养老金制度作为可信协调机制，通过提供耐心资本改变投资者预期；4. 使高投资高福利均衡变得稳健且可实现
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为新兴市场股市不发达提供新的协调失败理论解释；2. 将养老金制度重新概念化为解决金融市场集体行动问题的公共财政机构；3. 扩展了网络外部性在金融发展中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计养老金改革提供理论依据；2. 提出FICMI养老金制度作为促进股市发展的具体制度方案；3. 强调制度设计在解决市场协调失败中的关键作用
