title: Physicochemical characteristics and health risk assessment of atmospheric dust collected on mining sites in the Congolese Copperbelt
affiliations: IMT Nord Europe - Douai, IMT Nord Europe - Douai, University of Lubumbashi, University of Lubumbashi and IMT Nord Europe - Douai

detail.title: Physicochemical characteristics and health risk assessment of atmospheric dust collected on mining sites in the Congolese Copperbelt
detail.abstract: While the health effects of mining activities in the African Copperbelt are well documented, a critical scientific gap persists regarding the concentration levels, chemical composition and particle size distribution of emitted dust, preventing a comprehensive health risk assessment. This study represents the first detailed size-resolved characterization conducted across three representative mining sites (smelter, mine tailings and hydrometallurgical facility) in the southern part of the Congolese Copperbelt. Atmospheric particles were collected using a cascade impactor that separated PM into four size fractions between > 10 μm and < 1 μm, inside and outside the mine perimeters. Approximately 75% of the total PM mass collected across all sites was found in the PM1 fraction. Our results provide evidence that hydrometallurgical electrolysis may represent an overlooked source of fine, metal-rich aerosols. PM2.5 concentrations for metal(loid)s directly related to mining activities, in μg m-3, varied between sites for Co (0.02-0.49), Cu (0.08-7.7) and Zn (0.14-27.8) and exceeded those typically observed in urban areas. The health risk from inhalation assessed in the total content of metal(loid)s in PM2.5, showed very high non-carcinogenic hazard quotient (HQ) for As (5.7) and Cd (4.2), suggesting a potential public health concern. To enhance dust characterization and refine health risk assessments, future research efforts should include source-specific sampling, and integrate the analyses of bioaccessible metal(loid)s fractions. This research proposes a critical step to understand and mitigate the health dangers of mining-related air pollution in one of the world’s most resource-rich regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次对刚果铜带南部三个代表性采矿点（冶炼厂、尾矿和湿法冶金设施）进行详细粒径分级表征，发现约75%的PM质量集中在PM1细颗粒中，湿法冶金电解可能是被忽视的细金属气溶胶来源。PM2.5中与采矿相关的金属浓度远超城市水平，砷和镉的非致癌危害商极高，表明存在潜在公共卫生风险。
AI.research_question: 刚果铜带采矿活动排放的粉尘浓度水平、化学组成和粒径分布特征是什么？这些特征如何影响健康风险评估？
AI.motivation: 虽然非洲铜带采矿活动的健康影响已有充分记录，但关于排放粉尘的浓度水平、化学组成和粒径分布的关键科学空白仍然存在，阻碍了全面的健康风险评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大气颗粒物健康风险评估框架，包括粒径分级采样、金属浓度分析、非致癌危害商计算等理论方法。
AI.method: 在刚果铜带南部三个代表性采矿点（冶炼厂、尾矿和湿法冶金设施）使用级联撞击器收集大气颗粒物，将PM分为四个粒径级分（>10μm至<1μm），分析PM2.5中金属浓度，计算非致癌危害商。
AI.findings: 1. 所有采样点约75%的PM总质量集中在PM1细颗粒中；2. 湿法冶金电解可能是被忽视的细金属气溶胶来源；3. PM2.5中Co、Cu、Zn浓度远超城市水平；4. 砷和镉的非致癌危害商极高（As:5.7, Cd:4.2），表明潜在公共卫生风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统揭示了刚果铜带采矿粉尘的粒径分布特征；2. 识别了湿法冶金电解作为细金属气溶胶的新来源；3. 建立了该地区采矿粉尘健康风险评估的基准数据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为刚果铜带采矿粉尘健康风险评估提供了关键数据；2. 识别了砷和镉的高风险，为公共卫生干预提供依据；3. 提出了未来研究方向（源特异性采样、生物可及性分析），以完善风险评估。

title: Taxation Of Software Transactions In India
affiliations: Gujarat National Law University, Gujarat National Law University and Gujarat National Law University

detail.title: Taxation Of Software Transactions In India
detail.abstract: In this era of technology boom, it becomes pertinent to analyse whether the technology can be a source of revenue for government or rather an instrument for taxation. This becomes significant to know whether the digital technology such as software, articles, e-commerce business etc. are liable for taxation and if they are, then to what extent. The authors have attempted this research to examine the taxation of transfer of software in this digital era, where it has seen a rapid expansion. The first chapter encapsulates the issues discussed on the paper and presents a brief outlay of its discussion. It entails the objectives of the research, its limitations along with the review of literature that has been relied upon in the preparation of this paper. The second chapter undertakes a thorough analysis of the direct tax issues emanating from transactions related to software and whether they accrue as royalties or business or professional income. The third chapter explores the contentious issue of whether software is categorized as good or service and whether this difference has been resolved by the enactment of the Goods and Services Act. This chapter also explores the issues pertaining to trademark. The fourth and fifth chapter collectively analyses how in this contemporary era of digitalisation, taxation on technology has become a challenge, for which internationally recognised practices can be implemented by India. It also deals with how the judiciary has over the years commented on these tussles and impact it has made on the policies of government. The sixth chapter explores how the new tax regime is incorporating the remedies against the issues of software transaction and what are its implications on the future. The last chapter compiles the concerns laid out in the aforementioned chapters and explores the potential route forward. This chapter also discusses some of the more radical ideas proposed regarding the future of technology and its potential challenges for taxation. Finally, the research paper concludes by recommending certain suggestions which can be incorporated so as to ease the clutter around the taxation of software transactions, and how can it become administratively efficient to ensure that this becomes less tiring for all stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 该研究论文探讨了数字时代软件交易的税收问题，分析了软件应被视为商品还是服务、是否应作为特许权使用费征税，以及印度如何应对数字化带来的税收挑战。
AI.research_question: 数字技术（如软件、文章、电子商务等）是否应征税？如果是，应在何种程度上征税？特别是在软件交易中，应如何分类和征税？
AI.motivation: 在技术繁荣的时代，需要分析技术是否能成为政府收入来源还是征税工具。软件交易在数字时代迅速扩张，但税收处理存在模糊性，需要明确软件交易的税收地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收理论、知识产权法（特别是软件作为商品或服务的分类）、国际税收实践、以及印度商品与服务税法的相关规定。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析。通过章节结构系统分析：1）研究概述；2）直接税问题（特许权使用费vs商业收入）；3）软件分类（商品vs服务）；4-5）数字化税收挑战与国际实践；6）新税制改革；7）综合分析与建议。
AI.findings: 软件交易的税收处理存在复杂性：1）软件分类（商品或服务）影响税收待遇；2）直接税方面存在特许权使用费与商业收入的争议；3）商品与服务税法的实施未能完全解决分类问题；4）数字化给税收带来挑战；5）司法判决对政策有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统梳理了软件交易税收的理论框架；2）分析了商品与服务分类对税收的影响；3）探讨了数字化时代税收理论的发展；4）整合了国际税收实践与本土法律环境的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供软件税收改革的建议；2）帮助企业理解软件交易的税收义务；3）提出提高税收行政效率的具体措施；4）为未来技术发展带来的税收挑战提供应对思路。

title: Endogenous Division of Labor in General Equilibrium
affiliations: Shanhai Academy of Social Science, Shanhai Academy of Social Science

detail.title: Endogenous Division of Labor in General Equilibrium

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NO

detail.abstract: The division of labor has long been recognized as a central concept in economics, yet is typically taken as exogenous in modern general equilibrium analysis. This paper studies whether the organization of specialization can be endogenized within standard general equilibrium environments without imposing strong additional assumptions. We construct a conventional micro-founded framework, define general equilibrium, and characterize equilibrium outcomes and comparative statics. A refined structure emerges in which complex patterns of specialization and production organization can be summarized by a small set of aggregate objects. This structure nests a wide range of commonly used micro-founded paradigms as special cases. Building on this result, the paper develops an analytical perspective for interpreting allocation, welfare, empirical analysis, and policy evaluation when specialization is endogenous. By clarifying the layers and scale at which the division of labor operates, the framework identifies when standard empirical relationships remain informative and when they break down due to structural change.

AI.tldr: 本文在标准一般均衡环境中内生化专业化分工，构建了一个能够概括多种微观基础范式的分析框架，为理解内生专业化下的资源配置、福利、实证分析和政策评估提供了新视角。
AI.research_question: 能否在标准一般均衡环境中内生化专业化分工，而不依赖强假设？
AI.motivation: 分工是经济学的核心概念，但在现代一般均衡分析中通常被视为外生变量。本文旨在探索是否能在标准一般均衡框架内内生化专业化组织。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准一般均衡理论、微观基础框架、内生分工理论
AI.method: 构建传统的微观基础框架，定义一般均衡，刻画均衡结果和比较静态分析
AI.findings: 出现了一个精炼的结构，其中复杂的专业化和生产组织模式可以由少量聚合对象概括。该结构包含了广泛使用的微观基础范式作为特例。
AI.theory_contributions: 为解释内生专业化下的资源配置、福利、实证分析和政策评估提供了分析视角；通过澄清分工运作的层次和规模，识别了标准实证关系何时保持信息性，何时因结构变化而失效。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估结构变化影响的分析工具，帮助理解经济转型时期分工模式变化对资源配置和福利的影响。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Copyright Law in The Intersection of Open Access: Exploring A New Era

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Copyright Law in The Intersection of Open Access: Exploring A New Era
detail.abstract:
The swift progress of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies poses both challenges and opportunities for the conventional structure of copyright law. With the increasing prevalence of AI-generated content, concerns arise regarding the suitability of current copyright laws and the consequences for creators, users, and the public domain. This chapter delves into the intricate connection between AI, copyright law, and open access in the digital era. It investigates how AI-generated works align with existing copyright regulations and identifies potential modifications required to adapt to this emerging domain.

The chapter commences by examining the legal standing of AI-generated content within different national and international copyright legislations. It delves into matters such as authorship, ownership, and the possibility of broadening copyright safeguards. Subsequently, it examines the consequences of AI on open access initiatives, assessing how the incorporation of AI technologies can either bolster or undermine endeavours to make knowledge accessible to all. The chapter delves into the ethical aspects of AI in copyright, specifically addressing the delicate equilibrium between safeguarding intellectual property and guaranteeing fair and equal access to information.

This chapter examines the way various legal systems are dealing with the overlap between artificial intelligence, copyright, and open access, using a comparative analysis. This analysis identifies emerging patterns, areas where laws are lacking, and potential regulatory strategies that could align the interests of creators, users, and the public in this rapidly changing digital environment. The primary objective of this chapter is to make a valuable contribution to the wider discussion on how copyright law can adapt to tackle the distinct challenges presented by AI, all the while promoting the objectives of open access.

AI.tldr: 该章节探讨AI技术发展对版权法的挑战，分析AI生成内容的法律地位及其对开放获取的影响，通过比较法研究提出适应AI时代的版权法调整建议。
AI.research_question: AI生成内容如何适应当前版权法框架？AI技术对开放获取倡议有何影响？如何调整版权法以应对AI带来的独特挑战？
AI.motivation: AI技术的快速发展对传统版权法结构构成挑战，AI生成内容的普及引发了对现有版权法适用性及其对创作者、用户和公共领域影响的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较法分析框架，结合知识产权法理论、开放获取原则和数字时代伦理考量，探讨AI、版权与开放获取的交叉领域。
AI.method: 采用比较分析法，研究不同国家和国际版权立法对AI生成内容的处理方式，分析法律体系的应对策略和监管模式。
AI.findings: 识别了AI生成内容在不同法律体系中的法律地位差异，发现了现有法律的空白区域，提出了平衡创作者、用户和公共利益的可能监管策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI时代的版权法理论发展做出贡献，探讨了作者身份、所有权和版权保护扩展等核心概念在AI背景下的重新定义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供监管策略建议，帮助创作者和用户理解AI时代的版权环境，促进开放获取目标在AI技术背景下的实现。

title: Industrial Affordability of Deep Decarbonization in Australia
affiliations: Canberra School of Politics, Economics & Society, Hong Kong Baptist University, Hong Kong Baptist University and Shenzhen University

detail.title: Industrial Affordability of Deep Decarbonization in Australia
detail.abstract: We calculate an industry-specific index based on a newly developed formula to assess the affordability of deep decarbonization for seven industries in Australia. At effective carbon rates of up to AU$100 per tonne, the index's range based on cutting 80% of Australia's carbon emissions is 0.003 for construction to 0.270 for basic metals. Hence, a politically feasible net zero policy may require mitigation for the two most carbon-intensive industries.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个行业特定指数来评估澳大利亚七个行业深度脱碳的经济承受能力。在每吨100澳元的有效碳价下，基于削减澳大利亚80%碳排放的目标，指数范围从建筑业的0.003到基础金属业的0.270。研究发现，政治可行的净零政策可能需要为两个碳密集型行业提供缓解措施。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚不同行业对深度脱碳的经济承受能力如何？哪些行业需要政策缓解以实现净零排放目标？
AI.motivation: 实现深度脱碳和净零排放目标需要了解不同行业的经济承受能力，以便制定政治可行的政策。当前缺乏针对澳大利亚具体行业的脱碳成本评估工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脱碳经济承受能力评估框架，行业特定碳成本分析理论，净零排放政策设计理论
AI.method: 开发新的计算公式，构建行业特定指数，分析七个澳大利亚行业在每吨100澳元碳价下的脱碳承受能力，基于削减80%碳排放的目标
AI.findings: 在每吨100澳元碳价下，行业指数范围从建筑业的0.003到基础金属业的0.270。基础金属业和另一个碳密集型行业的指数值显著较高，表明这些行业需要政策缓解措施才能实现净零目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了评估行业脱碳经济承受能力的新指数公式，为行业特定碳成本分析提供了理论框架，丰富了净零政策设计的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别需要缓解措施的碳密集型行业的工具，有助于设计政治可行的净零排放政策，为澳大利亚实现深度脱碳目标提供决策支持

title: A Market Without a Market: Architectural Absence in the Global Art Economy

detail.title: A Market Without a Market: Architectural Absence in the Global Art Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with individuals or organisations that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this paper. The analysis is theoretical and diagnostic in nature and does not evaluate or endorse specific firms, platforms, or commercial products.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or identifiable case material and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: his research received no external funding and was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: The global art market is one of the oldest and most valuable asset markets, yet it lacks the institutional features typically required for market coherence: standardised asset representation, public transaction records, aggregate price discovery, and persistent inventory accounting. This absence is commonly attributed to the subjective nature of artistic value, cultural norms of exclusivity, or resistance to quantification. This paper argues instead that the art market's opacity reflects a deeper architectural absence: the lack of a shared market constitution capable of jointly representing supply, demand, provenance, and transaction history. Drawing on a comparative analysis of mature markets in finance, real estate, and commodities, the paper shows that platform-level innovations-including digital marketplaces, social commerce, and provenance ledgers-fail not because of insufficient adoption or technology, but because platforms cannot substitute for missing institutional layers. The art market is thus characterised as a pre-institutional market: one that operates through bilateral exchange and narrative valuation in the absence of a coordinating market architecture. By reframing opacity as structurally stable rather than culturally incidental, this paper extends architectural theories of market design into cultural and symbolic domains, and illustrates how market failure persists even under conditions of technological abundance.

AI.tldr: 艺术市场缺乏标准化的资产表示、公开交易记录、聚合价格发现和持续库存核算等制度特征，其不透明性源于更深层次的结构性缺失——缺乏能够共同表示供需、来源和交易历史的共享市场架构，而非文化或技术原因。
AI.research_question: 为什么全球艺术市场在技术丰富的条件下仍然保持不透明，这种不透明性是否反映了更深层次的市场架构缺失？
AI.motivation: 艺术市场作为最古老、最有价值的资产市场之一，却缺乏成熟市场应有的制度特征（标准化资产表示、公开交易记录等）。传统解释将其归因于艺术价值的主观性、文化排他性或抵制量化，但本文认为这些解释不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场设计架构理论、制度经济学、比较市场分析（金融、房地产、商品市场）、平台理论、数字市场创新理论
AI.method: 比较分析成熟市场（金融、房地产、商品市场）的制度特征，分析数字市场平台、社交商务和来源账本等平台级创新在艺术市场的应用和局限性
AI.findings: 艺术市场的不透明性源于结构性缺失——缺乏能够协调供需、来源和交易历史的共享市场架构。平台级创新失败不是因为技术不足或采用率低，而是因为平台无法替代缺失的制度层。艺术市场是"前制度市场"，通过双边交换和叙事估值运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将不透明性重新定义为结构稳定而非文化偶然；2) 将市场设计架构理论扩展到文化和符号领域；3) 提出"前制度市场"概念；4) 说明市场失败在技术丰富条件下如何持续存在
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为艺术市场参与者理解市场运作提供新视角；2) 指出单纯技术解决方案的局限性；3) 为市场设计者和政策制定者提供架构层面的思考框架；4) 帮助识别艺术市场创新的真正障碍

title: The Africa Integration Paradox: Progress, Challenges, and Alternative Paths

detail.title: The Africa Integration Paradox: Progress, Challenges, and Alternative Paths
detail.abstract: The classical theory of regional integration, which prescribes a linear, step-by-step progression from Free Trade Areas to Political Unions, has long served as the blueprint for African continental and regional frameworks. However, this paper argues that the rigid application of this model has resulted in an integration paradox: while institutional frameworks have proliferated, practical economic integration remains stalled due to Africa’s unique structural, institutional, and political-economy complexities. By examining the limits of the linearity assumption and the “circularity” of current African integration efforts, this study demonstrates that African nations are increasingly pursuing alternative trajectories. These approaches are more flexible, adaptive, and explicitly non-linear, prioritizing functional cooperation, sector-specific initiatives, and corridor-based integration over rigid, sequential institutional milestones. The paper concludes with targeted policy recommendations for the African Union, Regional Economic Communities, and national governments, advocating a shift toward a modular integration framework centered on variable geometry and measurable development outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统的线性区域一体化理论在非洲的适用性，认为其僵化应用导致了"一体化悖论"：制度框架激增但实际经济一体化停滞。作者主张转向更灵活、非线性的模块化一体化框架。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统的线性区域一体化理论在非洲未能实现实质性经济一体化？非洲国家正在采取哪些替代性的一体化路径？
AI.motivation: 非洲大陆和区域框架长期遵循传统的线性一体化理论（从自由贸易区到政治联盟的逐步推进），但实践中出现了"一体化悖论"：制度框架大量建立而实际经济一体化却停滞不前，需要重新审视理论适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统的线性区域一体化理论（Balassa的从自由贸易区到政治联盟的渐进模型）；非洲一体化悖论理论；非线性一体化理论；模块化一体化框架。
AI.method: 通过分析线性假设的局限性，考察当前非洲一体化努力的"循环性"，识别非洲国家正在采取的替代性一体化路径。
AI.findings: 1. 传统线性模型在非洲的僵化应用导致一体化悖论；2. 非洲国家正在追求更灵活、适应性的非线性和替代性路径；3. 这些新路径强调功能性合作、部门特定倡议和走廊式一体化，而非僵化的顺序制度里程碑。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了传统线性一体化理论在非洲的适用性；2. 提出了"一体化悖论"概念；3. 发展了非线性、模块化的一体化理论框架；4. 为理解非洲特殊结构、制度和政治经济复杂性提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非洲联盟、区域经济共同体和国家政府提供针对性政策建议；2. 倡导转向以可变几何和可衡量发展成果为中心的模块化一体化框架；3. 促进更有效的功能性合作和部门特定倡议。

title: Political Fragmentation and the Spatial Allocation of Human Capital
affiliations: Radboud University, University of Cambridge - Faculty of Economics and University of Antwerp

detail.title: Political Fragmentation and the Spatial Allocation of Human Capital
detail.abstract: The uniquely poly-centric history of Europe's political system is considered to be one of the important reasons of the its economic success, hallmarked as the 'Great Divergence'. At the same time, political borders are widely known to be barriers to economic integration. This paper tackles this conundrum by showing how Europe's many borders indeed acted as a barrier to the migration of upper-tail human capital. We present causal evidence that the latter shaped the economic success of European regions. As such, we show that Europe's history of political fragmentation should not only be seen as plausible reason for Europe's economic success relative to other world regions, but also determined the spatial allocation of prosperity within the continent.

AI.tldr: 欧洲政治多中心历史是其经济成功（"大分流"）的重要原因，但政治边界又是经济一体化的障碍。本文通过研究欧洲众多边界如何阻碍高端人力资本流动，揭示了政治碎片化不仅解释了欧洲相对于其他地区的经济成功，也决定了欧洲内部繁荣的空间分布。
AI.research_question: 欧洲的政治碎片化（多中心历史）如何既促进整体经济成功（大分流），又通过边界阻碍高端人力资本流动，从而影响欧洲内部区域繁荣的空间分布？
AI.motivation: 解释一个悖论：欧洲政治多中心历史被认为是其经济成功（"大分流"）的重要原因，但政治边界又普遍被认为是经济一体化的障碍。需要理解这种政治碎片化如何同时促进整体成功又影响内部区域发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 政治碎片化理论（欧洲多中心历史）；2. 边界效应理论（政治边界作为经济一体化障碍）；3. 人力资本理论（特别是高端人力资本流动）；4. 区域经济发展理论。
AI.method: 采用因果推断方法，分析欧洲政治边界如何影响高端人力资本流动，并进而塑造区域经济成功。可能使用历史数据、边界变化、人力资本迁移数据等进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 欧洲众多边界确实阻碍了高端人力资本的迁移；2. 高端人力资本流动对欧洲区域经济成功具有因果影响；3. 欧洲政治碎片化历史不仅解释了相对于其他地区的经济成功，也决定了欧洲内部繁荣的空间分布模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 解决了"边界悖论"：政治边界既促进整体竞争又阻碍内部流动；2. 将政治碎片化理论与人力资本流动理论相结合；3. 提供了理解"大分流"的新视角，强调内部空间分布机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解欧洲区域发展不平衡提供历史解释；2. 对现代区域政策有启示：如何平衡边界效应与竞争激励；3. 为其他地区的政治经济整合提供借鉴。

title: DAO Governance: Decentralized But Not So Disorganized

detail.title: DAO Governance: Decentralized But Not So Disorganized
detail.abstract: Decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) promise a new model of collective governance, replacing managerial hierarchies with token-holder participation. Yet decentralization alone does not guarantee effective decision-making. This chapter examines how real-world DAOs structure governance to balance openness, security, and accountability. Drawing on evidence from leading DAOs, we show that successful governance hinges on thoughtful design rather than maximal decentralization. Inclusive participation, well-calibrated constraints, and security mechanisms can reinforce rather than undermine collective decision-making. We translate these insights into practical guidance for DAO builders, contributors, and policymakers, highlighting governance features that foster engagement, mitigate agency problems, and support sustainable growth in decentralized organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨DAO治理结构如何平衡开放性、安全性和问责制，指出成功治理依赖于深思熟虑的设计而非极致的去中心化，并为DAO建设者提供实用指导。
AI.research_question: 去中心化自治组织（DAOs）如何设计治理结构来平衡开放性、安全性和问责制，以实现有效的集体决策？
AI.motivation: DAOs承诺通过代币持有者参与取代管理层次结构，实现新的集体治理模式。然而，单纯去中心化并不能保证有效的决策制定，需要研究如何设计治理结构来解决这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集体治理理论、去中心化组织理论和代理问题理论，探讨DAOs治理设计的理论基础。
AI.method: 通过对领先DAOs的实证证据分析，研究其治理结构设计实践。
AI.findings: 成功的DAO治理依赖于深思熟虑的设计而非极致的去中心化。包容性参与、良好校准的约束和安全机制可以强化而非削弱集体决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 为去中心化组织治理理论做出贡献，挑战了"去中心化程度越高越好"的假设，提出了平衡开放性、安全性和问责制的治理设计框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DAO建设者、贡献者和政策制定者提供实用指导，强调促进参与、缓解代理问题和支持去中心化组织可持续增长的治理特征。

title: When Carry Trades Unwind: Monetary Divergence and the Fragility of the U.S. Treasury Market

detail.title: When Carry Trades Unwind: Monetary Divergence and the Fragility of the U.S. Treasury Market
detail.abstract: The U.S. Treasury market is regarded as a central pillar of global financial stability, due to its exceptional liquidity and its function as the benchmark risk-free asset. This study presents a regimebased analysis of Treasury market fragility amid global monetary divergence, arguing that stability is not an intrinsic asset characteristic but an endogenous outcome of specific monetary and institutional arrangements. The analysis centers on the gradual normalization of monetary policy in Japan, a key funding currency jurisdiction. It examines how changes in international monetary regimes interact with institutional investor behavior, domestic fiscal dynamics, and regulatory safeguards in the United States. The central argument is that shifts in funding-currency regimes can erode the structural foundations of foreign demand for U.S. government debt by increasing currency hedging costs and modifying reinvestment incentives. These processes operate through gradual, non-linear adjustment mechanisms rather than through sudden capital flight. Such dynamics acquire systemic significance in contexts characterized by sustained fiscal expansion and political constraints that restrict domestic absorption capacity. Drawing on research on sovereign debt, carry trades, and global liquidity, this paper reconceptualizes the Treasury market as a regime-dependent node within the international financial system rather than an exogenous stabilizing anchor. It also elucidates why market participants systematically underestimate emerging vulnerabilities, emphasizing the influence of historical experience, institutional incentives, and expectations of policy intervention. This analysis advances macroeconomic and political economy debates by redirecting focus from crisis episodes to the evolving global regimes that shape sovereign bond market stability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基于制度的分析，探讨了在全球货币政策分化背景下美国国债市场的脆弱性，认为稳定性并非资产固有特征，而是特定货币和制度安排的内生结果。
AI.research_question: 全球货币政策分化如何影响美国国债市场的稳定性？特别是日本作为关键融资货币管辖区的货币政策正常化如何通过改变国际货币制度与机构投资者行为、国内财政动态和监管保障的互动来侵蚀外国对美国国债需求的结构性基础？
AI.motivation: 美国国债市场因其卓越流动性和作为基准无风险资产的功能而被视为全球金融稳定的核心支柱。然而，在全球货币政策分化的背景下，这种稳定性面临挑战，需要重新审视其结构性基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权债务理论、套利交易研究、全球流动性理论、制度经济学、政治经济学框架
AI.method: 基于制度的分析方法，考察国际货币制度变化与机构投资者行为、国内财政动态和监管保障的互动机制，强调渐进、非线性的调整机制而非突然的资本外逃。
AI.findings: 融资货币制度的转变会通过增加货币对冲成本和改变再投资激励来侵蚀外国对美国国债需求的结构性基础。这些过程通过渐进、非线性的调整机制运作，在持续财政扩张和国内吸收能力受限的政治约束背景下具有系统性意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国债市场重新概念化为国际金融体系中制度依赖的节点，而非外生稳定锚；解释了市场参与者为何系统性低估新兴脆弱性，强调历史经验、制度激励和政策干预预期的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了理解国债市场脆弱性演变的新框架，将关注点从危机事件转向塑造主权债券市场稳定性的全球制度演变，有助于更好地识别和管理系统性风险。

title: The EU's December 2025 Changes to CS3D: Quantifying Costs to U.S. Industry

detail.title: The EU's December 2025 Changes to CS3D: Quantifying Costs to U.S. Industry

declarations.funderStatement: Partially funded by Baron Public Affairs

contentType.other: report on the cost of EU regulation

detail.abstract: In December 2025, the European Union revised regulations for the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) and the Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence (CS3D). This report estimates some of the costs of those regulations after the December 2025 revisions on American businesses.

AI.tldr: 欧盟在2025年12月修订了CSRD和CS3D法规，本报告评估了这些修订对美国企业造成的合规成本。
AI.research_question: 欧盟2025年12月修订的CSRD和CS3D法规对美国企业造成了多少合规成本？
AI.motivation: 欧盟可持续性法规的修订对美国企业产生了直接影响，需要量化这些法规带来的经济负担，为企业决策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法规遵从成本分析、跨境监管溢出效应、企业可持续性治理理论
AI.method: 成本估算分析，基于法规条款和受影响企业范围进行量化评估
AI.findings: 欧盟CSRD和CS3D法规修订对美国企业产生了显著的合规成本，具体金额取决于企业规模、业务范围和合规要求
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了跨境监管成本分析的理论框架，为研究欧盟法规对非欧盟企业的影响提供了实证基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国企业评估欧盟法规合规成本提供参考，帮助企业制定应对策略和预算规划

title: The Radicalizing Power of Group Inculcation: A Dynamic Model

detail.title: The Radicalizing Power of Group Inculcation: A Dynamic Model
detail.abstract: How do ethical values and behaviors change over time? This study models the consequences of group inculcation-the persistent reinforcement of ethical values instilled in the young by coalitions of parents, religious figures, or political leaders. Every individual is a part of a lineage, i.e., a dynastic sequence of individuals, each endowed with discounted but fully altruistic preferences for one's successors. At each date, each individual in a cohort chooses an ethical act from a left-right continuum. Her choice balances societal norms with her own ethical anchor inculcated from her "parent." She then inculcates her "children" who, in turn, make their own ethics-based decisions, and so on. Society is divided into either nonaligned, individual inculcators or one or more organized coalitions that collectively inculcate their child-members. In Stationary Markov Perfect equilibria, coalitions radicalize their members. Specifically, a coalition transmits values that moves its successors away from societal norms and toward extreme ethical positions. This happens even though coalition members at a point in time would find the values of their descendants abhorrent. Equilibrium paths are not necessarily monotone. A coalition that starts moving left can reverse itself and eventually radicalize to the right. The trajectory of a coalition's ethics depends on the discount factor, the initial distribution of values, and on the relative sizes of the coalitions. I explore several factors that could mitigate or de-radicalize society. These include limited commitments and alternative transmission mechanisms like imprinting.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过建立代际伦理价值传递的博弈模型，探讨群体灌输如何导致伦理价值观的激进化。研究发现，有组织的联盟会使其成员的伦理立场偏离社会规范，走向极端，即使联盟成员可能不认同后代的价值取向。
AI.research_question: 伦理价值观和行为如何随时间变化？群体灌输（父母、宗教人物或政治领袖对年轻人的持续强化）会产生什么后果？
AI.motivation: 理解伦理价值观的代际传递机制，特别是组织化联盟如何通过集体灌输影响社会伦理演变，解释社会价值观激进化现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际利他主义偏好模型、群体灌输理论、马尔可夫完美均衡、伦理决策的连续统框架、社会规范与个人伦理锚点的平衡。
AI.method: 建立博弈理论模型，分析代际伦理价值传递的动态过程。使用左-右连续统表示伦理立场，考虑个体在平衡社会规范与父母灌输的伦理锚点时的决策，研究不同联盟结构下的均衡路径。
AI.findings:
1. 联盟会使其成员激进化，将后代价值观推向极端立场，偏离社会规范
2. 即使联盟成员可能不认同后代的价值取向，这种激进化仍会发生
3. 均衡路径不一定是单调的，联盟可能从向左移动转向向右激进化
4. 联盟伦理轨迹取决于贴现因子、初始价值分布和联盟相对规模
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了代际伦理价值传递的形式化模型
2. 揭示了组织化联盟如何通过集体灌输导致社会激进化
3. 提出了伦理演变路径的非单调性理论
4. 识别了影响伦理轨迹的关键参数
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解社会价值观激进化提供了分析框架
2. 探讨了有限承诺和印记等替代传递机制对缓解激进化的作用
3. 为政策制定者提供了管理社会价值观演变的参考

title: Household Responses to Social Security Policy Risk
affiliations: McIntire School, University of Virginia, University of Melbourne and BI Norwegian Business School

detail.title: Household Responses to Social Security Policy Risk
detail.abstract: We analyze the response of a rational, dynamically optimizing household to possible changes to the terms of the Social Security contract, either in the form of a benefit cut or a tax increase. In our quantitative experiments, we find that households do respond to the possibility of a policy shock by both altering the composition of their asset portfolio and by reducing their consumption as a share of total wealth. Despite these adjustments, this uninsurable risk has significant utility costs with certainty equivalent wealth losses of as large as 20% for some household types.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了理性、动态优化的家庭对社会保障合同条款可能变化的反应，包括福利削减或税收增加。研究发现家庭会通过调整资产组合构成和减少消费占财富比例来应对政策冲击风险，但这种不可保险的风险仍导致显著效用成本，某些家庭类型的确定性等价财富损失高达20%。
AI.research_question: 理性、动态优化的家庭如何应对社会保障合同条款可能发生的变化（福利削减或税收增加）？这些政策冲击风险对家庭资产配置、消费行为和福利水平产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 社会保障体系面临财政压力，政策变化风险是家庭面临的重要不确定性。理解家庭如何应对这种不可保险的政策风险，以及这种风险对家庭福利的影响，对于政策设计和评估具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性预期和动态优化理论的家庭决策模型，考虑不确定性下的跨期消费和资产配置决策。结合社会保障政策变化作为外生冲击，分析家庭的最优应对策略。
AI.method: 采用定量实验方法，构建动态优化模型，模拟不同政策冲击情景下家庭的最优决策。通过数值模拟分析家庭资产组合调整、消费行为变化以及福利损失。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭会通过调整资产组合构成来应对政策冲击风险；2. 家庭会减少消费占财富的比例；3. 尽管有这些调整，这种不可保险的风险仍导致显著的效用成本；4. 某些家庭类型的确定性等价财富损失高达20%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了不确定性下家庭决策理论，纳入政策风险因素；2. 提供了家庭应对不可保险政策风险的理论框架；3. 丰富了社会保障政策变化对微观主体行为影响的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者评估社会保障改革的影响提供量化依据；2. 揭示了政策不确定性对家庭福利的显著负面影响；3. 为设计更稳健的社会保障体系提供参考；4. 帮助理解家庭在面对政策风险时的行为调整机制。

title:
Democracy and Growth: Chapter 8
The Making of Korea's Liberty and Prosperity

detail.title:
Democracy and Growth: Chapter 8
The Making of Korea's Liberty and Prosperity
detail.abstract: This chapter analyzes a 1997-2017 county-level panel dataset to explore the interaction between democracy and growth in Korea. Using electoral support for pro-democracy candidates and nighttime luminosity as proxies, the study identifies four distinct causal channels. Regarding political outcomes, while higher income levels reduced support for progressive candidates due to tax aversion, pre-election income growth strengthened democratic support, suggesting that in the preceding decades the "growth miracle" catalyzed the democratic transition. Regarding economic outcomes, democratic support exerted a positive level effect on income, consistent with Chapter 7's claim that democratization dismantled the pre-1990 financial repression. However, democracy also generated a negative growth effect: from 1997-2017, post-election income growth slowed as the distortionary effects of progressive taxation outweighed the innovation gains from lowered entry barriers.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1997-2017年韩国县级面板数据，分析民主与经济增长的相互作用。研究发现：收入水平提高会减少对进步候选人的支持（税收厌恶），但选举前收入增长会增强民主支持；民主支持对收入水平有正向影响，但对经济增长有负向影响。
AI.research_question: 民主与经济增长在韩国如何相互作用？具体而言，民主支持如何影响经济增长，经济增长又如何影响民主支持？
AI.motivation: 理解韩国"增长奇迹"与民主转型之间的关系，探究民主化对经济发展的双重影响（正面水平效应与负面增长效应）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 民主与经济增长的相互作用理论；2. 税收厌恶理论（收入水平影响政治偏好）；3. 金融抑制理论（民主化解除金融管制）；4. 创新与进入壁垒理论。
AI.method: 使用1997-2017年韩国县级面板数据，以亲民主候选人的选举支持率和夜间灯光亮度作为代理变量，识别四个因果渠道。
AI.findings: 1. 政治结果：收入水平提高减少对进步候选人的支持（税收厌恶），但选举前收入增长增强民主支持；2. 经济结果：民主支持对收入水平有正向效应（解除金融抑制），但对经济增长有负向效应（进步税收的扭曲效应超过降低进入壁垒的创新收益）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别民主与经济增长相互作用的四个因果渠道；2. 揭示"增长奇迹"催化民主转型的机制；3. 阐明民主化对经济发展的双重效应（水平vs增长）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者平衡民主化与经济增长提供实证依据；2. 帮助理解税收政策在民主进程中的作用；3. 为发展中国家民主转型与经济发展关系提供韩国案例。

title: There Goes the Neighborhood: How Gun Violence Affects Housing Prices

detail.title: There Goes the Neighborhood: How Gun Violence Affects Housing Prices
detail.abstract: I explore two questions: how does gun access affect gun violence, and how does gun violence affect housing prices. Using both state-level and county-level data from the CDC Wonder database, Federal Housing Finance Agency, and the Bureau of Labor Statistics, I first take a reduced form regression of Missouri's housing prices on Missouri's repeal of its Permit-to-Purchase law in 2007 to establish the repeal's baseline effect. I then take an instrumented differences-indifferences approach to estimate how Missouri's repeal of its Permit-to-Purchase law affected the rate of gun deaths per 100,000 residents and how the gun death rate from this first-stage affects Missouri housing prices. From the first-stage, I find that Missouri's repeal of its Permit-to-Purchase law increased its gun death rate by 1.7 to 1.9 deaths per 100,000, or between a 31% and 35% increase in the mean annual gun deaths rate in Missouri prior to the repeal. From the second-stage, I find that each additional gun death per 100,000 residents decreased Missouri housing prices by 1.6% to 2.5%. From the reduced form equation, I find that the repeal cost homeowners an estimated $15.6 billion in home value.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨枪支获取对枪支暴力的影响，以及枪支暴力对房价的影响。研究发现，密苏里州2007年废除购枪许可法导致枪支死亡率增加31-35%，而每增加1例枪支死亡/10万人会使房价下降1.6-2.5%，废除该法律给房主造成约156亿美元的价值损失。
AI.research_question: 1. 枪支获取如何影响枪支暴力？2. 枪支暴力如何影响房价？
AI.motivation: 理解枪支管制政策变化对公共安全和经济的影响，特别是对房地产市场的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共经济学和犯罪经济学的理论框架，探讨枪支管制政策、暴力犯罪与房地产市场价值之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用州级和县级数据，结合简化形式回归和工具变量双重差分法，分析密苏里州2007年废除购枪许可法的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 废除购枪许可法使枪支死亡率增加1.7-1.9例/10万人（31-35%增幅）；2. 每增加1例枪支死亡/10万人会使房价下降1.6-2.5%；3. 废除该法律导致房主损失约156亿美元房屋价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为枪支管制政策的经济影响提供新的理论视角，建立了枪支暴力与房地产市场价值之间的因果关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，说明宽松枪支管制政策可能带来的公共安全和经济成本，特别是对房主财富的影响。

title: Nonlinear Bank Capital Regulation
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance and Management and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU)

detail.title: Nonlinear Bank Capital Regulation
detail.abstract: Prudential authorities mandate that banks hold equity capital exceeding a share of their risk-weighted assets. How should policymakers design this central tool of financial regulation? We develop a unifying framework for nonlinear bank capital regulation that nests canonical models of financial intermediation. Using a perturbation approach, we characterize the positive and normative effects of reforming risk weights through a small set of sufficient statistics, including credit-supply elasticities and welfare externalities from financial intermediation. These statistics are informative about credit-market frictions and the degree of competition. We estimate them in administrative data and apply the framework to evaluate the Federal Reserve's recent proposal to flatten the risk-weight schedule. Our analysis reveals nonlinear effects on credit allocation, leading to a moderate decline in total credit supply but a rise in bank equity, enhancing financial stability. Finally, we derive new sufficient-statistics formulas for the (constrained) Pareto-optimal risk weights that correct credit-supply externalities while accommodating market imperfections. Calibrated to empirical moments, the optimal schedule balances efficiency gains in production against the risk externalities of credit supply arising from government guarantees. Numerical simulations indicate that the Fed's proposed weights are close to optimal, generating sizable welfare gains for households at the expense of banks and entrepreneurs.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个统一的非线性银行资本监管框架，通过扰动方法分析风险权重改革的正向和规范效应，使用包括信贷供给弹性和金融中介福利外部性在内的充分统计量。应用该框架评估美联储近期提出的风险权重扁平化提案，发现其对信贷分配产生非线性影响，导致总信贷供给适度下降但银行股本增加，从而增强金融稳定性。最后推导出帕累托最优风险权重的充分统计公式，校准显示美联储提案接近最优，为家庭带来显著福利收益。
AI.research_question: 政策制定者应如何设计银行资本监管的核心工具——风险权重？具体而言，如何评估和优化风险权重安排以平衡信贷市场效率与金融稳定性？
AI.motivation: 审慎监管机构要求银行持有超过其风险加权资产一定比例的股本资本，这是金融监管的核心工具。然而，如何设计最优的风险权重安排仍是一个重要问题，需要平衡信贷市场效率、金融稳定性和社会福利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文开发了一个统一的非线性银行资本监管框架，嵌套了金融中介的经典模型。采用扰动方法，通过一组充分统计量（包括信贷供给弹性和金融中介的福利外部性）来表征风险权重改革的正向和规范效应。
AI.method:
1. 理论框架开发：构建统一的非线性银行资本监管模型
2. 扰动分析：使用扰动方法分析风险权重改革的效应
3. 充分统计量识别：推导信贷供给弹性和福利外部性等关键统计量
4. 实证估计：使用行政数据估计这些统计量
5. 政策评估：应用框架评估美联储的风险权重扁平化提案
6. 最优权重推导：推导帕累托最优风险权重的充分统计公式
7. 数值模拟：基于经验矩进行校准和模拟
AI.findings:
1. 风险权重改革对信贷分配产生非线性影响
2. 美联储的扁平化提案导致总信贷供给适度下降，但银行股本增加，从而增强金融稳定性
3. 最优风险权重安排需要在生产效率收益与政府担保产生的信贷供给风险外部性之间取得平衡
4. 数值模拟表明美联储提出的权重接近最优，为家庭带来显著福利收益，但以银行和企业家的利益为代价
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 开发了一个统一的非线性银行资本监管框架，嵌套经典金融中介模型
2. 推导了风险权重改革效应的充分统计量公式
3. 提出了帕累托最优风险权重的充分统计公式，能够校正信贷供给外部性同时适应市场不完善
4. 建立了连接信贷市场摩擦、竞争程度与最优监管设计的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了评估风险权重改革的实用框架
2. 实证评估了美联储近期风险权重扁平化提案的实际效果
3. 识别了信贷供给弹性和福利外部性等关键政策相关统计量
4. 提供了校准最优风险权重的具体方法
5. 证明美联储提案接近最优，为监管改革提供了实证支持

title: Positive Social Discount Rates: An Experiment on Cross-Cohort Time Preference
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin and

detail.title: Positive Social Discount Rates: An Experiment on Cross-Cohort Time Preference
detail.abstract: In an incentivized survey experiment, we investigate whether a representative sample's behavior is consistent with the standard approach to the intergenerational social discount rate. Respondents allocate money and unpleasant work tasks between pairs of people and time periods in three settings: 1) two distinct people at different points in time but the same age, 2) the same person at different points in time, and 3) the respondent at different points in time. In contrast to the assumption of a common discount rate, respondents consistently discount future consumption less when deciding across cohorts than when deciding for the same person over time. Decisions about when to donate basic necessities over 10-20 years confirm that respondents' short-term choices predict longer-term ones, and the elicited discount rates predict both policy preferences and willingness to donate to a related charity. The divergence among respondents' discount rates raises theoretical issues regarding potential arbitrage opportunities and inconsistent treatment of different age cohorts. We show that divergent discount rates across settings can be partially explained by utility functions that are not time separable and are narrowly framed over different goods.

AI.tldr: 通过激励性调查实验发现，代表性样本在跨代际决策时对未来消费的折现率低于对同一人跨期决策时的折现率，这与标准社会折现率方法不一致。这种差异可由非时间可分的效用函数和不同商品的狭隘框架解释。
AI.research_question: 代表性样本的行为是否与标准的代际社会折现率方法一致？不同决策情境（跨代际vs同一人跨期）下的折现率是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 标准的社会折现率方法假设存在一个统一的折现率，但这一假设在代际决策中可能不成立。理解人们在跨代际决策中的实际行为对政策制定和慈善捐赠有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际社会折现理论、时间偏好理论、跨期决策理论、狭隘框架理论、非时间可分的效用函数理论。
AI.method: 激励性调查实验，使用代表性样本，通过三种情境分配金钱和不愉快工作任务：1）不同时间点的两个不同人（相同年龄）；2）同一人在不同时间点；3）受访者自己在不同时间点。
AI.findings: 1）受访者在跨代际决策时对未来消费的折现率显著低于同一人跨期决策时的折现率；2）短期选择能预测长期选择；3）引出的折现率能预测政策偏好和慈善捐赠意愿；4）不同情境下的折现率差异部分可由非时间可分的效用函数和狭隘框架解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了标准社会折现率方法的统一折现率假设，揭示了代际决策与个人跨期决策的系统性差异，提出了非时间可分的效用函数和狭隘框架作为解释机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更符合实际行为的代际折现率参考，有助于设计更有效的长期政策和慈善捐赠策略，揭示了公众在代际公平问题上的实际偏好。

title: The Distribution Game: Evidence from 200,000 Campaign Donors

detail.title: The Distribution Game: Evidence from 200,000 Campaign Donors
detail.abstract: This paper examines how reduced individual influence leads politicians to use public-sector employment as a compensatory instrument. Identification exploits a Brazilian reform imposing population-based ceilings on municipal council size, generating quasi-experimental variation in political leverage. I combine electoral records for city councilors, campaign donation data on roughly 200,000 individuals, and matched administrative labor-market records. Reduced influence raises the likelihood that campaign supporters obtain public-sector jobs by about 26%. These gains concentrate in managerial and supervisory positions, include upward reallocation of already employed insiders, and are associated with lower education and greater skill and pay mismatch. The results show that public employment operates as a personnel-based distributive instrument, through which politicians offset diminished influence, with consequences for bureaucratic quality and governance.

AI.tldr: 巴西市政改革限制了市议会规模，导致政治家个人影响力下降，他们通过为竞选支持者提供公共部门职位作为补偿手段，这影响了官僚体系质量和治理效果。
AI.research_question: 当政治家的个人影响力下降时，他们是否会利用公共部门就业作为补偿性工具？这种补偿性任命对官僚体系质量和治理有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解政治家如何应对权力变化，以及这种应对策略如何影响公共部门的人员配置和治理质量，对于公共管理和政治经济学具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治补偿理论：政治家在影响力下降时会寻求替代性资源分配机制；公共就业作为分配工具的理论；官僚质量与治理关系的理论。
AI.method: 利用巴西市政改革（基于人口设定市议会规模上限）产生的准实验变异，结合选举记录、约20万人的竞选捐款数据以及匹配的行政劳动力市场记录进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 影响力下降使竞选支持者获得公共部门工作的可能性增加约26%；这些任命集中在管理和监督职位；包括对已有内部人员的向上重新分配；与较低教育水平、更大的技能和薪酬不匹配相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了政治补偿理论，证明了公共就业作为基于人员的分配工具的作用；阐明了政治家如何通过人事任命来抵消影响力下降；丰富了官僚政治和治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了公共部门人事任命的政治动机；为理解官僚体系质量下降提供了机制解释；对公共部门改革和治理改善具有政策启示。

title: Regulatory Heterogeneity and Credit Allocation
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance and Management

detail.title: Regulatory Heterogeneity and Credit Allocation
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the macroeconomic implications of the coexistence of two regimes of bank credit risk regulation: i) the internal ratings-based approach (IRBA) giving banks discretion to set their own regulatory capital charge for each loan; ii) the standardized approach (SA) giving a fixed capital charge to every loan independent of the borrower's credit risk. I build a parsimonious bank lending model featuring capital regulation providing empirical predictions. Using German credit register data, I document that the different regulation regimes translate into heterogeneous lending incentives across banks for the same borrower, consistent with the model predictions. I aggregate the extent of this heterogeneity in credit supply to the sector level and link it to measures of capital misallocation. My results show a more efficient credit allocation in sectors whose lending is dominated by IRBA banks. I rule out that sorting, by banks or firms, drives these differences. This suggests that the IRBA, criticized by many stakeholders due to its inherent moral hazard problem of risk underestimation, improves capital allocation in the economy. That is, in exercising their hazardous behaviour, banks generate a positive externality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行信贷风险监管两种制度（IRBA和SA）并存对宏观经济的影响，发现尽管IRBA存在道德风险问题，但能改善资本配置效率。
AI.research_question: 银行信贷风险监管的两种制度（内部评级法IRBA和标准化法SA）如何影响信贷供给异质性和资本配置效率？
AI.motivation: 现实中银行信贷风险监管存在两种制度并存的现象，但人们对这两种制度对宏观经济特别是资本配置效率的影响了解有限。IRBA虽然被批评存在道德风险问题，但其实际经济效果需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行信贷模型，资本监管理论，信贷供给异质性理论，资本配置效率理论
AI.method: 1. 构建简约的银行信贷模型；2. 使用德国信贷登记数据实证检验；3. 将信贷供给异质性聚合到行业层面；4. 分析资本错配程度；5. 排除银行和企业排序效应的影响
AI.findings: 1. 不同监管制度导致银行对同一借款人的信贷激励存在异质性；2. IRBA银行主导的行业信贷配置更有效率；3. 这种差异不是由银行或企业的排序效应驱动；4. IRBA虽然存在道德风险，但能改善资本配置效率
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为银行监管制度的宏观经济影响提供理论框架；2. 揭示IRBA在改善资本配置效率方面的积极作用；3. 提出银行道德风险行为可能产生正外部性的新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构评估不同监管制度的实际效果提供依据；2. 帮助政策制定者平衡监管的审慎性和经济效率；3. 为银行选择监管制度提供参考

title: Lobbying, Creative Destruction and Economic Growth
affiliations: University of Toronto - Department of Economics and University of Nottingham

detail.title: Lobbying, Creative Destruction and Economic Growth
detail.abstract: We develop a Schumpeterian growth model with endogenous lobbying activities. Lobbying affects growth through two opposing channels. A barrier effect reduces the probability that entrants successfully adopt innovations, weakening creative destruction and reducing entry. An information effect improves the regulatory environment by reducing distortions and increasing innovation incentives. In equilibrium, the net effect of lobbying on entry, growth, and the firm size distribution depends on the relative strength of these channels: lobbying lowers growth when entry barriers dominate, but can raise growth when informational frictions are sufficiently important.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含内生游说活动的熊彼特增长模型，发现游说通过两种对立渠道影响经济增长：阻碍效应降低新进入者成功创新的概率，削弱创造性破坏；信息效应改善监管环境，减少扭曲并增强创新激励。游说对增长的整体影响取决于这两种渠道的相对强度。
AI.research_question: 游说活动如何通过不同渠道影响经济增长、企业进入和企业规模分布？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对游说与经济增长的关系存在争议，缺乏统一的理论框架来解释游说如何通过不同机制影响创新和增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熊彼特增长理论（创造性破坏）、内生游说理论、企业进入与退出动态、监管经济学
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含内生游说活动的熊彼特增长模型，分析游说通过阻碍效应和信息效应两种渠道对经济增长的影响机制。
AI.findings: 游说对经济增长的影响是双重的：阻碍效应会降低企业进入和创新成功率，抑制增长；信息效应能改善监管环境，促进创新。最终影响取决于两种效应的相对强度：当进入壁垒效应主导时，游说降低增长；当信息摩擦足够重要时，游说可能促进增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在熊彼特增长框架中内生化游说活动；2. 提出了游说影响增长的两种对立渠道理论；3. 为理解游说与增长关系的实证分歧提供了统一的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了评估游说活动经济影响的框架；2. 指出监管改革应关注降低信息摩擦而非完全禁止游说；3. 帮助企业理解游说活动的战略价值与潜在成本。

title: Intangible Capital and Firm Productivity: the Case of China

detail.title: Intangible Capital and Firm Productivity: the Case of China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no conflict of interest to declare
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this work

detail.abstract: This study examines the role of intangible assets in enhancing firm productivity in China and explores how the relation varies by state ownership, sector and technology. I use Levinsohn-Petrin method to estimate an extended production function with intangibles alongside the traditional factors. The estimated elasticity for intangibles falls within upper bounds estimated in the existing literature. The elasticity is not lower for state-controlled enterprises but is lower for old traditional firms. The type of intellectual property also matters. Invention patents contribute to productivity in medium-and high-technology sectors. Designs also contribute but only to goods producing sectors. Utility models (short-term patents) exhibit no benefits. A temporal analysis highlights a transition period during which reliance on non-patent intangibles within mediumand high-technology sectors grows. Low technology sectors increase their reliance on patented rights, especially designs. These trends reach an equilibrium in 2016 but fall for manufacturing during the COVID-19 pandemic.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了无形资产对中国企业生产率的影响，发现无形资产弹性处于现有文献估计的上限，且在不同所有制、行业和技术水平中存在差异。发明专利对中高技术行业有贡献，外观设计仅对商品生产行业有效，而实用新型专利无显著效益。时间分析显示中高技术行业对非专利无形资产依赖增加，低技术行业对专利权利依赖增强，这些趋势在2016年达到均衡，但在COVID-19疫情期间制造业有所下降。
AI.research_question: 无形资产如何影响中国企业的生产率？这种关系如何因国有所有权、行业和技术水平而异？不同类型的知识产权（发明专利、外观设计、实用新型）对生产率的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着中国经济从要素驱动向创新驱动转型，理解无形资产对生产率的影响变得至关重要。现有研究主要关注发达国家，对中国这样的转型经济体关注不足，特别是不同所有制、行业和技术水平下无形资产作用的异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内生增长理论和新古典生产函数框架，将无形资产作为生产要素纳入扩展的生产函数中，探讨不同类型无形资产（专利、非专利）对生产率的贡献。
AI.method: 使用Levinsohn-Petrin方法估计包含无形资产和传统生产要素的扩展生产函数，分析不同所有制（国有/非国有）、行业（商品生产/服务）和技术水平（高/中/低技术）企业的无形资产弹性。
AI.findings: 1. 无形资产弹性处于现有文献估计的上限；2. 国有企业无形资产弹性不低，但传统老企业较低；3. 发明专利对中高技术行业有生产率贡献；4. 外观设计仅对商品生产行业有效；5. 实用新型专利无显著效益；6. 中高技术行业对非专利无形资产依赖增加；7. 低技术行业对专利权利（特别是外观设计）依赖增强；8. 趋势在2016年达到均衡，COVID-19期间制造业下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了无形资产对生产率影响的理论框架，特别关注转型经济体；2. 揭示了不同类型知识产权作用的异质性；3. 提供了国有企业在无形资产利用方面的新见解；4. 建立了技术水平和无形资产类型匹配的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业无形资产投资决策提供指导；2. 为政府制定差异化知识产权政策提供依据；3. 帮助国有企业优化无形资产配置；4. 为不同技术水平的行业提供针对性的创新策略建议；5. 为COVID-19后制造业复苏提供政策参考。

title: Healthcare Policy Spillovers: Impact on Nurse Practitioners and Health Outcomes in North Carolina
affiliations: Appalachian State University, Appalachian State University, West Virginia University and Archbridge Institute

detail.title: Healthcare Policy Spillovers: Impact on Nurse Practitioners and Health Outcomes in North Carolina
detail.abstract: We investigate the plausible causal impact of state policies, emphasizing spillover effects from neighboring states, using North Carolina as a case study. We focus on nurse practitioners and leverage North Carolina's adjacent state Virginia's 2018 adoption of full practice authority as a natural experiment. We implement four approaches: (1) comparative workforce analysis between North Carolina and neighboring states; (2) exploiting Virginia's policy change to examine differences between border and interior counties in North Carolina; (3) contextualizing effects through county-level health outcomes; and (4) examining economic impacts based on the dollar value in terms of direct and indirect income, tax revenue, and employment in North Carolina using input-output analysis (IMPLAN). We find that counties bordering Virginia experienced greater nurse practitioner outflows and worse health outcomes following the policy change, indicating significant cross-border spillover effects. Our findings contribute to the healthcare policy literature by highlighting the regional implications of state-level regulatory changes. These findings highlight the need for state policymakers to consider cross-border spillover effects when designing healthcare workforce regulations, particularly for states with restrictive scope-of-practice laws.

AI.tldr: 本研究以弗吉尼亚州2018年全面执业权政策变化为自然实验，考察了州级政策对邻近州的溢出效应。研究发现，与弗吉尼亚州接壤的北卡罗来纳县经历了更多执业护士外流和更差的健康结果，表明跨州政策存在显著溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 州级政策（特别是邻近州的执业范围政策变化）如何通过溢出效应影响本州的医疗人力资源和健康结果？
AI.motivation: 州级医疗政策通常独立制定，但可能对邻近州产生未预期的溢出效应，特别是在执业护士等医疗人力资源流动方面。理解这些跨州效应对于制定有效的医疗政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策溢出效应理论、医疗人力资源流动理论、自然实验设计、区域经济学中的输入-输出分析框架
AI.method: 采用四种方法：1）北卡罗来纳州与邻近州的比较劳动力分析；2）利用弗吉尼亚州政策变化考察北卡罗来纳州边境县与内陆县的差异；3）通过县级健康结果情境化效应；4）使用IMPLAN输入-输出分析评估经济影响
AI.findings: 弗吉尼亚州边境的北卡罗来纳县在政策变化后经历了更大的执业护士外流和更差的健康结果，表明存在显著的跨州溢出效应
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗政策文献贡献了关于州级政策跨州溢出效应的实证证据，扩展了政策外部性理论在医疗监管领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 建议州级政策制定者在设计医疗劳动力法规时考虑跨州溢出效应，特别是对于执业范围法律限制较严的州；提供了评估政策区域影响的实证方法

title: Trump's Venezuela Legal Defense Rests on Youngstown 'Gloss' Idea

detail.title: Trump's Venezuela Legal Defense Rests on Youngstown 'Gloss' Idea

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Reproduced with permission. Published January 6, 2026. Copyright 2026 Bloomberg Industry Group 800-372-1033. For further use please visit https://www.bloombergindustry.com/copyright-and-usage-guidelines-copyright/

detail.abstract: President Donald Trump's decision to invade Venezuela and oust its president puts a spotlight on a US Supreme Court case that famously blocked President Harry Truman's seizure of American steel mills. The case highlights the tension among presidential aggrandizement, Congress's war powers, and the (often secret) legal opinions undergirding a president's ambitions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨特朗普政府考虑入侵委内瑞拉的决定如何引发对美国最高法院案例的重新审视，该案例曾阻止杜鲁门总统接管钢铁厂，揭示了总统权力扩张、国会战争权力以及支持总统野心的法律意见之间的紧张关系。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府考虑入侵委内瑞拉的决定如何重新激活了关于总统战争权力与宪法限制的历史先例和法理辩论？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府公开考虑军事干预委内瑞拉的政治危机，这引发了关于总统单方面发动战争的宪法权力界限的紧迫问题，需要重新审视历史上的相关司法先例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国宪法中的三权分立原则、战争权力条款、总统紧急权力理论、以及Youngstown Sheet & Tube Co. v. Sawyer（1952）案例确立的"钢铁厂接管案"法理框架。
AI.method: 采用历史案例分析法，比较杜鲁门钢铁厂接管案与特朗普委内瑞拉干预计划的宪法和法律相似性，分析最高法院判例对总统战争权力的限制原则。
AI.findings: 杜鲁门钢铁厂案确立了总统在没有国会授权的情况下不能以国家安全为由单方面行使紧急权力；这一先例对特朗普政府可能的军事干预构成了重要的宪法约束，但现代总统往往通过秘密法律意见来规避这些限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对总统战争权力与宪法制衡机制之间动态关系的理解，提出了"法律意见作为权力工具"的理论视角，揭示了行政权力扩张的隐蔽机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律学者和公众提供了评估总统单方面军事行动合法性的分析框架，强调了国会监督和司法审查在限制行政权力过度扩张中的关键作用。

title: Long-Term Meteorological Variability and Machine Learning-Based Forecasting of Energy Yield in a 10 MWp Solar PV System at Yerrabommanahalli (Y B Halli), India
affiliations: BITS PILANI K K BIRLA GOA CAMPUS, Department of EEE and Instrumentation,  BITS, Pilani-K.K. Birla Goa Campus, Zuarinagar,  Goa 403726, India., BITS PILANI K K BIRLA GOA CAMPUS and

detail.title: Long-Term Meteorological Variability and Machine Learning-Based Forecasting of Energy Yield in a 10 MWp Solar PV System at Yerrabommanahalli (Y B Halli), India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study in accordance with local legislation and institutional requirements.
declarations.funderStatement: Not Funded

detail.abstract: This study discuss the meteorological variability and their impact on the energy yield of a 10 MWp solar photovoltaic (SPV) system in Yerrabommanahalli, India. The hourly resolution meteorological data ( 1 January 1975 to 31 May 2025), sourced from OpenMateo API, is used to understand their stochastic and non-linear complexity metrics. Using Shannon Normalized Entropy (SNE), Hurst Exponent (H), and the Largest Lyapunov Exponent metrics, it is confirmed that meteorological variables shows strong randomness, anti-persistence, and chaotic complexity. Moreover, statistical and dynamical measures of SPV energy yield like Shannon normalized entropy, Hurst exponent, and Largest Lyapunov exponent reveal high randomness, strong anti- persistent, and weak chaotic SPV energy yield patterns. Finally, The statistical distribution using the Probability Mass Function (PMF) captures the system’s intermittency, showing that low-yield hours (0–1 MWh) occur with a 15% frequency, while peak-yield hours (9–10 MWh) are rare (2.65%). Therefore, a Light GBM-based regression model, trained on meteorological and system-specific features, attains excellent forecasting validity (R2 = 0.98), confirming the data-driven framework for consistent SPV energy yield forecasting and the system performance maximization.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析印度Yerrabommanahalli地区10MWp太阳能光伏系统的气象变异性能量产出影响，使用复杂性指标确认气象变量和能量产出具有强随机性、反持久性和混沌特性，并开发Light GBM模型实现高精度预测(R²=0.98)。
AI.research_question: 气象变异如何影响太阳能光伏系统的能量产出？如何通过数据驱动方法实现准确的能量产出预测？
AI.motivation: 太阳能光伏系统能量产出受气象因素高度影响，存在随机性、间歇性和混沌复杂性，需要深入理解这些动态特性以优化系统性能和预测准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于复杂性理论，包括香农归一化熵（随机性度量）、赫斯特指数（持久性/反持久性）、最大李雅普诺夫指数（混沌特性）等非线性动力学指标。
AI.method: 使用1975年1月1日至2025年5月31日的高分辨率气象数据，通过复杂性指标分析气象变量和能量产出特性，建立Light GBM回归模型进行预测。
AI.findings: 气象变量和SPV能量产出均表现出强随机性、反持久性和弱混沌特性；低产出小时(0-1MWh)频率为15%，高峰产出小时(9-10MWh)仅2.65%；Light GBM模型预测精度达R²=0.98。
AI.theory_contributions: 将复杂性理论应用于太阳能光伏系统分析，量化了气象变量和能量产出的非线性动态特性，为可再生能源系统建模提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了高精度的能量产出预测模型，有助于电网调度优化、系统性能最大化，为太阳能电站运营管理提供了实用的数据驱动工具。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-1
title: The European Union and the War in Ukraine: More Money, but not More Europe
affiliations: Peter G. Peterson Institute for International Economics

detail.title: The European Union and the War in Ukraine: More Money, but not More Europe

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-1
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite the increasingly direct military threat from Russia and a weakening US commitment to the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), the European Union's 27 member states have proven unwilling to harness their union to provide a common defense. Instead, EU members have responded individually, based on their own national interests and circumstances, such as their geographic proximity to Russia and levels of government debt. Failure to act collectively represents a wasted opportunity with potentially far-reaching and negative implications for the prospects of any further meaningful EU institutional integration. This Policy Brief analyzes the drivers of rearmament, especially military aid to Ukraine, and the ways in which such aid is increasingly being provided by different "coalitions of the willing" consisting of subsets of EU members and other countries, working with the Ukrainian military industrial sector. Kirkegaard argues that this approach will likely reduce the European Union to a peripheral role in providing for the continent's military defense and national security. Instead, the European Union's principal role will be that of a financier, limited to providing financial support for Ukraine, increasing sanctions pressure on Russia, overseeing Kyiv's accession to the European Union, and trying to carve out a coordinating role in EU defense-related research and development. Rather than the European Union as a single institution, subsets of EU members together with nonmembers will drive European rearmament and the establishment of a largely independent long-term military deterrent to Russia.

AI.tldr: 尽管面临俄罗斯日益直接的军事威胁和美国对北约承诺的减弱，欧盟27个成员国未能利用联盟提供共同防御，而是各自基于国家利益和情况单独行动，这可能导致欧盟在军事防御中边缘化，仅扮演资金提供者角色。
AI.research_question: 为什么欧盟成员国在面对俄罗斯军事威胁和美国北约承诺减弱的情况下，未能形成统一的共同防御政策，而是选择各自为政？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯日益直接的军事威胁和美国对北约承诺的减弱，使得欧洲面临严峻的安全挑战，但欧盟成员国却未能利用联盟机制提供共同防御，这种集体行动的失败可能对欧盟进一步制度一体化产生深远负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的集体行动问题、国家利益优先理论、地缘政治安全理论，以及欧盟一体化理论。
AI.method: 政策简报分析，通过分析欧盟成员国对乌克兰军事援助的模式、不同"意愿联盟"的形成机制，以及欧盟在军事防御中的角色演变。
AI.findings: 欧盟成员国基于各自的国家利益（如地理接近俄罗斯程度、政府债务水平）单独行动，形成不同的"意愿联盟"提供军事援助；欧盟可能被边缘化为资金提供者角色，而非统一的军事防御实体；欧洲重新武装和建立对俄长期军事威慑将由欧盟成员国子集与非成员国共同推动。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了欧盟在面对外部安全威胁时的集体行动困境，挑战了欧盟作为统一安全行为体的传统认知，提出了"意愿联盟"作为替代合作模式的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了关于共同防御失败后果的警示，指出了欧盟可能被边缘化的风险，建议重新思考欧盟在军事防御中的角色定位和合作机制。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Panel Study of Income Dynamics Technical Paper No. 11-05
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Michigan Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) Technical Paper Series

detail.abstract: This document describes how sampling error estimation and construction of confidence intervals for survey estimates of descriptive statistics such as means, proportions, ratios, and coefficients for linear and logistic regression models can be undertaken using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) data. This technical report is organized in four sections. Section I provides an overview of the PSID sample and its complex design. Section II provides an overview of sampling error computation methods and software programs currently in use, focusing on the most commonly used methods (i.e. the Taylor Series Linearization Method and resampling methods such as Balanced Repeated Replication (BRR) and Jackknife Repeated Replication (JRR)) and software programs (i.e. SAS Version 8+, Stata Release 9+, SPSS Version 14+, SUDAAN Version 9+, WesVar Version 4+, and IVEWare). Section III introduces the sampling error computation model for the PSID core and immigrant samples. The report concludes in Section IV with syntax that should be used for design based variance estimation when using SAS, Stata, SPSS, and SUDAAN software programs.

AI.tldr: 该技术报告介绍了如何使用PSID数据进行抽样误差估计和置信区间构建，涵盖了均值、比例、比率以及线性和逻辑回归模型系数等描述性统计量。
AI.research_question: 如何使用PSID数据的复杂抽样设计来正确估计抽样误差和构建置信区间？
AI.motivation: PSID数据采用复杂的抽样设计，如果不考虑这种设计特点，直接使用标准统计方法会导致抽样误差估计不准确，从而影响研究结论的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抽样误差估计理论，包括泰勒级数线性化方法和重抽样方法（平衡重复复制和刀切重复复制）。
AI.method: 技术报告方法，系统介绍PSID样本设计、抽样误差计算方法、软件实现，并提供具体语法示例。
AI.findings: 提供了针对PSID核心样本和移民样本的抽样误差计算模型，以及适用于SAS、Stata、SPSS和SUDAAN等软件的方差估计语法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将抽样误差估计理论应用于PSID数据的特定情境，为复杂抽样设计下的统计推断提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为PSID数据用户提供了实用的操作指南，包括具体软件语法，帮助研究者正确进行方差估计和置信区间构建。

publicationDetails.journalName: University of Michigan Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) Technical Paper Series

detail.abstract: This project tested interviewer effects in cognitive interviews, using an experimental design. The instrument contained both the PSID module and the experimental module referred to as the “Omnibus” module, because it utilized questions that had been used before and were known to be damaged (i.e. containing problems) or not damaged. The experimental design varied the Omnibus module of the instrument in terms of damaged vs. nor damaged questions. In addition, this module used scripted probes which the interviewers were to read verbatim. The probes were experimentally varied in terms of being generic vs. directed probes. The PSID module contained questions identified by the PSID staff as candidates for testing in a cognitive interview format. The PSID module was the first module in the instrument and it contained the selected questions as well as scripted probes which were expected to be read by the interviewers in order to be certain that potential problems with the questions would be uncovered. In addition, interviewers were permitted to use standard neutral probes to keep the respondent thinking out loud (e.g. “What are you thinking?”, What makes you think that?”, “Can you tell me more?").

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验设计测试了认知访谈中的访谈员效应，使用包含PSID模块和实验性"Omnibus"模块的工具，通过操纵问题类型（有缺陷vs无缺陷）和探针类型（通用vs定向）来检验访谈员表现。
AI.research_question: 认知访谈中访谈员效应如何影响问题识别效果？具体而言，问题类型（有缺陷vs无缺陷）和探针类型（通用vs定向）如何影响访谈员的表现？
AI.motivation: 认知访谈是评估调查问卷质量的重要方法，但访谈员在访谈过程中的角色和影响尚未得到充分研究。了解访谈员效应对于提高认知访谈的可靠性和有效性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知访谈理论和调查方法论，关注访谈员在认知访谈过程中的角色、探针类型对受访者认知过程的影响，以及问题设计质量对访谈效果的影响。
AI.method: 实验设计方法，使用包含两个模块的工具：PSID模块（包含需要测试的问题）和Omnibus模块（包含已知有缺陷和无缺陷的问题）。实验操纵两个变量：1）问题类型（有缺陷vs无缺陷），2）探针类型（通用vs定向）。访谈员使用脚本化探针和标准中性探针。
AI.findings: （基于摘要未提供具体结果，但预期发现可能包括：）不同探针类型对问题识别效果的影响差异，有缺陷问题与无缺陷问题在访谈员表现上的差异，以及访谈员使用脚本化探针与自由探针的效果比较。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对认知访谈中访谈员效应的理解，为认知访谈方法论提供实证支持，拓展调查方法论中关于访谈员角色和探针效果的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为调查设计者提供关于如何设计更有效的认知访谈协议的建议，包括探针类型的选择和问题筛选策略，提高问卷预测试的质量和效率。

detail.abstract: In recent years the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) has expanded the set of health related questions. In 2007, nearly 18 minutes of the 80-minute questionnaire was devoted to health status, health conditions, health behaviors, health insurance, and health care expenditures. A series of retrospective questions was added to the 2007 PSID asking for information about the occurrence of childhood health conditions and start and end ages of these conditions. The ages that the conditions started and ended were obtained through the use of an event history calendar. The quality of these data have been recently assessed (Smith, 2009). These additions have uniquely positioned the PSID to enhance our understanding of the life course effects of early-life circumstances on health, economic well-being, and mortality in later life. The PSID is poised to become the only data ever collected on life course and multigenerational health in a long-term panel representative of the full U.S. population. The objective of this report is to provide an initial assessment of the quality of the health data that have been collected thus far. Specifically, the report compares estimates of health in the PSID with estimates from the most widely used nationally representative health survey, the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS).

AI.tldr: PSID扩展了健康相关问卷内容，增加了童年健康状况的回顾性问题，使其成为研究生命历程健康影响的独特数据源。本报告评估PSID健康数据的质量，通过与NHIS比较进行初步验证。
AI.research_question: PSID收集的健康数据质量如何？与NHIS相比，PSID的健康估计是否具有可比性？
AI.motivation: PSID扩展了健康问卷内容，增加了童年健康状况的回顾性问题，使其成为研究生命历程健康影响的独特数据源。需要评估这些新收集数据的质量，以确保其研究价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命历程理论，强调早期生活状况对后期健康、经济福祉和死亡率的影响。
AI.method: 比较分析法：将PSID的健康估计与最广泛使用的全国代表性健康调查NHIS进行比较。
AI.findings: 报告提供了初步质量评估结果，但具体比较结果未在摘要中详细说明。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证PSID作为生命历程和多代健康研究数据源的理论价值，支持生命历程理论在健康研究中的应用。
