title: Overcoming Corporate Separateness: The Early Origins of Group Liability for Workers and Beyond

detail.title: Overcoming Corporate Separateness: The Early Origins of Group Liability for Workers and Beyond

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 895/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This Article documents and examines Brazil’s pioneering imposition of joint and several liability for labor obligations on parent companies since 1937, complicating existing narratives about the German origins of group law. We uncover evidence that nationalism and resistance to foreign corporate groups contributed significantly to this legal development. Central to Brazil’s groundbreaking 1937 reform holding parent companies liable for subsidiaries’ labor obligations was the concern about protecting local workers from foreign groups attempting to evade legal responsibilities through separate legal entities. This innovation has shown remarkable durability and contemporary relevance. A 2024 decision by the Brazilian Supreme Court applied the economic group doctrine to enforce its orders against X (formerly Twitter) by freezing the assets of the Brazilian subsidiaries of Starlink, also controlled by Elon Musk.

Our comparative analysis reveals a gradual, if contested, trend toward eroding corporate separateness to protect workers across jurisdictions. Moreover, this development appears to be more common in the Global South, with Portugal standing as the sole Global North country examined to converge with Brazil’s comprehensive statutory approach—and only after a 70-year delay. These findings suggest that challenges in state capacity and the geographic divide between capital and labor, often pronounced along North-South lines, can shape the evolution of limited liability and corporate separateness doctrines in ways that challenge conventional narratives in corporate and comparative law.

AI.tldr: 巴西自1937年起开创性地对母公司施加连带责任，要求其为子公司的劳动义务负责，这比德国集团法更早，源于民族主义和对跨国企业逃避责任的担忧。该制度具有持久影响力，2024年巴西最高法院应用经济集团理论冻结了马斯克旗下公司的资产。比较研究发现，全球南方国家更倾向于侵蚀公司独立性以保护工人，挑战了传统公司法叙事。
AI.research_question: 巴西1937年开创的母公司对子公司劳动义务承担连带责任的法律制度是如何形成和发展的？这种制度在全球范围内的传播模式如何挑战传统的公司法和比较法叙事？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将德国视为集团法的起源，但本文发现巴西早在1937年就开创了母公司对子公司劳动义务承担连带责任的制度，这挑战了传统叙事。研究旨在揭示巴西这一创新制度的起源、动因及其全球影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 公司集团理论；2. 公司独立性原则与有限责任理论；3. 比较公司法；4. 全球南北差异理论；5. 国家能力理论；6. 资本与劳动力地理分割理论
AI.method: 历史法律分析（追溯巴西1937年法律改革）、比较法分析（考察多个司法管辖区）、案例研究（2024年巴西最高法院对X/Twitter和Starlink的判决）、文献分析
AI.findings: 1. 巴西1937年改革源于民族主义和对跨国企业通过独立法人逃避责任的担忧；2. 该制度具有持久性，2024年最高法院应用经济集团理论冻结马斯克旗下公司资产；3. 全球南方国家更倾向于侵蚀公司独立性保护工人；4. 葡萄牙是唯一与巴西趋同的北方国家，且晚了70年；5. 国家能力不足和资本-劳动力地理分割是重要影响因素
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了德国集团法起源的传统叙事；2. 揭示了全球南北差异在公司法发展中的重要性；3. 提出了国家能力和资本-劳动力地理分割影响公司法演变的理论框架；4. 丰富了比较公司法理论，特别是关于公司独立性侵蚀的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家设计保护工人的公司集团责任制度提供参考；2. 为法院处理跨国公司逃避劳动责任案件提供法律依据；3. 为政策制定者理解不同司法管辖区公司集团责任差异提供洞见；4. 展示了巴西创新制度的实际应用价值（如2024年最高法院判决）

title: 대손충당금 변화가 은행대출에 미치는 영향(The Effect of Changes in the Loan Loss Provision on Bank Loans)

detail.title: 대손충당금 변화가 은행대출에 미치는 영향(The Effect of Changes in the Loan Loss Provision on Bank Loans)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation (KDIC) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study dynamically examines the impact of changes in domestic banks' loan loss provisions on corporate and household loans using the Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression Models with Exogenous Variables (TVP-VARX). Empirical analysis reveals that the effect of changes in loan loss provisions on loans fluctuates over time. In addition, these structural changes appear to be similar to the timing of changes in the standards for accumulating loan loss provisions due to changes in IFRS standards(2007, 2014), domestic introduction(2011, 2018), and responses to the COVID-19 pandemic. On average, an increase in loan loss provisions is associated with a reduction in corporate loan growth, while household loan growth tends to increase. In other words, domestic banks appear to focus more on household lending as risk levels rise. When categorized into commercial banks, regional banks, and specialized banks, regional banks show a preference for risk-taking in their lending strategies, contrary to commercial banks. This suggests that policy support may be needed to prevent adverse selection of regional banks. Specialized banks, in contrast, appear to supply loans to address imbalances in the lending market. Additionally, the recent decrease in the base interest rate is expected to gradually, rather than immediately, alter banks' lending behavior in response to changes in market interest rates.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用TVP-VARX模型动态分析国内银行贷款损失准备变化对企业与家庭贷款的影响，发现影响随时间波动且与IFRS准则变化、国内引入时间及疫情应对时点相似。平均而言，贷款损失准备增加会减少企业贷款增长，但增加家庭贷款增长，显示银行在风险上升时更关注家庭贷款。地区银行相比商业银行更偏好风险承担，需要政策支持防止逆向选择，而专业银行则旨在解决贷款市场失衡。
AI.research_question: 国内银行贷款损失准备的变化如何动态影响企业和家庭贷款？这种影响是否随时间变化，并与会计准则变化、疫情应对等结构性变化时点相关？不同类型银行（商业银行、地区银行、专业银行）的贷款行为有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解银行贷款损失准备政策变化对信贷供给的动态影响，特别是考虑到IFRS准则变化（2007、2014）、国内引入（2011、2018）以及COVID-19疫情应对等结构性变化时点，对于评估银行风险管理和信贷政策效果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险承担理论、信贷供给理论和动态宏观经济模型，结合时间变化参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VARX）框架，分析贷款损失准备与信贷供给的动态关系。
AI.method: 使用时间变化参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VARX）进行动态实证分析，考虑外生变量影响，研究贷款损失准备变化对企业贷款和家庭贷款的时变影响。
AI.findings: 1. 贷款损失准备变化对贷款的影响随时间波动，且波动时点与IFRS准则变化（2007、2014）、国内引入（2011、2018）及疫情应对时点相似；2. 平均而言，贷款损失准备增加会减少企业贷款增长，但增加家庭贷款增长；3. 地区银行相比商业银行更偏好风险承担；4. 专业银行旨在解决贷款市场失衡；5. 基准利率下降对银行贷款行为的影响是渐进的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了贷款损失准备与信贷供给动态关系的时变证据；2. 揭示了不同类型银行在风险承担行为上的系统性差异；3. 将会计准则变化等结构性因素纳入银行信贷行为分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供政策建议，特别是针对地区银行的风险承担偏好可能需要政策支持防止逆向选择；2. 帮助银行管理者理解贷款损失准备政策变化对信贷组合的影响；3. 为货币政策传导机制提供微观基础，特别是利率变化对银行贷款行为的渐进影响。

title: Digital Technology Diffusion and Occupational Diversity: Evidence from China
affiliations: Tongji University - School of Economics and Management, Tongji University, University of International Business and Economics (UIBE) - Business School and Tongji University

detail.title: Digital Technology Diffusion and Occupational Diversity: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: Digital technologies act as general-purpose technologies that drive the development of digital economy, and digital technology diffusion (DTD) exerts broad influences on firms' digitally enabled innovation. While prior research has primarily examined firms' innovation activities following digital technology adoption, limited attention is paid to how DTD reshapes the structure of firms' labor demand within regional innovation ecosystems. Using panel data on 286 Chinese city-level regional innovation ecosystems from 2012 to 2021, we empirically examine how within-ecosystem DTD reshapes firms' labor demand structures. We show that higher levels of DTD significantly enhance occupational diversity in firms' labor demand, with firms' innovation capabilities serving as a key underlying mechanism. Moreover, this effect varies with the ecosystem's innovation resource endowment: it is stronger in ecosystems with more abundant industrial resources but weaker in those with richer human resources. We further show that the positive impact of DTD on occupational diversity emerges primarily during the advanced stage of digital economy development, suggesting that the labor market implications of DTD are contingent on ecosystem maturity. Spatial analyses reveal that, in this advanced stage, DTD generates positive spillovers among ecosystems with similar levels of digital economy development, while such spillovers are absent in earlier stages. By linking DTD to structural changes in labor demand, this study advances innovation and technology management research and extends dynamic capabilities theory by shifting attention from firmlevel capability building to ecosystem-level capability aggregation. It also contributes to regional innovation ecosystem research by explicitly incorporating workers as important stakeholders and beneficiaries during the process of DTD. The findings offer implications for digitally transforming firms, highlighting the importance of reconfiguring workforce strategies in response to DTD-induced occupational diversification.

AI.tldr: 数字技术扩散通过提升企业创新能力，显著增加企业对多样化职业的需求，这一效应在产业资源丰富的创新生态系统中更强，在人力资源丰富的生态系统中较弱，且主要在数字经济高级发展阶段显现。
AI.research_question: 数字技术扩散如何重塑区域创新生态系统中企业的劳动力需求结构？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注企业采用数字技术后的创新活动，但忽视了数字技术扩散如何改变区域创新生态系统中企业的劳动力需求结构，这一研究空白对于理解数字经济对劳动力市场的影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（从企业层面能力建设扩展到生态系统层面能力聚合）、区域创新生态系统理论、数字技术扩散理论
AI.method: 使用2012-2021年中国286个城市级区域创新生态系统的面板数据，实证检验数字技术扩散对企业劳动力需求结构的影响，并分析创新能力的调节机制和生态系统特征的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 数字技术扩散显著增强企业劳动力需求的职业多样性；2. 企业创新能力是核心中介机制；3. 效应在产业资源丰富的生态系统中更强，在人力资源丰富的生态系统中较弱；4. 积极影响主要在数字经济高级发展阶段显现；5. 在高级阶段，数字技术扩散在相似发展水平的生态系统间产生正向溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将数字技术扩散与劳动力需求结构变化联系起来，推进创新与技术管理研究；2. 扩展动态能力理论，从企业层面能力建设转向生态系统层面能力聚合；3. 为区域创新生态系统研究做出贡献，明确将员工作为重要利益相关者和受益者纳入分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为数字化转型企业提供启示，强调重新配置劳动力战略以应对数字技术扩散带来的职业多样化；2. 帮助政策制定者理解数字技术扩散对劳动力市场的差异化影响；3. 为企业管理者提供指导，优化人力资源配置以适应数字技术扩散带来的变化。

title: The New Environmental Licensing Framework After the Veto Override: Regulatory Rationality, Institutional Capacity, and Systemic Adjustments

detail.title: The New Environmental Licensing Framework After the Veto Override: Regulatory Rationality, Institutional Capacity, and Systemic Adjustments
detail.abstract: This article examines, from a strictly technical and constitutionally grounded perspective, Brazil's new environmental licensing framework following the congressional override of presidential vetoes on November 27, 2025. It analyzes the institutional reconfiguration of licensing instruments-particularly the License by Adhesion and Commitment (LAC) and the Corrective Operating License (LOC)-and evaluates their compatibility with the principles of prevention, precaution, proportionality, administrative efficiency, the polluter-pays principle, and the prohibition of environmental retrogression. The study argues that the revised framework does not weaken environmental protection; rather, it restructures procedural mechanisms while preserving the constitutional core of environmental safeguards and strengthening monitoring capacity. It further addresses the expected judicialization of the matter and the role of cooperative federalism in shaping Brazil's regulatory landscape. The article concludes that the constitutionality and effectiveness of the new provisions will depend less on abstract legislative design and more on their technically qualified implementation by environmental authorities.

AI.tldr: 本文从技术和宪法角度分析巴西2025年11月27日国会推翻总统否决后通过的新环境许可框架，评估其与环境保护原则的兼容性，认为新框架未削弱环境保护，而是重构程序机制并强化监管能力。
AI.research_question: 巴西新的环境许可框架（特别是LAC和LOC许可工具）是否符合宪法原则和环境保护基本原则？
AI.motivation: 分析巴西2025年11月27日国会推翻总统否决后通过的新环境许可框架，从技术和宪法角度评估其制度重构的正当性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防原则、预防性原则、比例原则、行政效率原则、污染者付费原则、禁止环境退化原则、合作联邦主义。
AI.method: 严格的技术和宪法基础分析，制度重构分析，原则兼容性评估。
AI.findings: 修订后的框架并未削弱环境保护，而是重构了程序机制，同时保留了环境保护的宪法核心并加强了监测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境许可制度的宪法分析提供理论框架，强调程序重构与实质保护的区分，提出"宪法核心"保护概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西环境许可实施提供指导，预测可能的司法化问题，强调技术合格实施的重要性，为合作联邦主义下的监管提供建议。

title: Real-Time and Adaptive Project Management

detail.title: Real-Time and Adaptive Project Management
detail.abstract: As modern industries contend with unprecedented volatility, uncertainty, and technological disruption, project management practices are undergoing a transformative shift. Real-time and adaptive project management (RAPM) has emerged as a critical evolution, prioritizing flexibility, rapid responsiveness, and continuous alignment with dynamic business needs. Unlike traditional project management frameworks that rely on fixed scopes, timelines, and rigid plans, adaptive approaches-such as Agile, Scrum, and Lean-embrace iterative development, decentralized decision-making, and real-time data integration to enable informed adjustments throughout the project lifecycle. This paper explores the theoretical underpinnings, technological enablers, and practical implementations of RAPM. Drawing on current academic literature, enterprise case studies, and industry research, it analyzes how RAPM contributes to improved stakeholder engagement, faster time-to-value, and enhanced risk mitigation-particularly in high-velocity sectors like technology, fintech, and healthcare. The study also discusses barriers to adoption, such as organizational resistance, tool complexity, and change fatigue, offering a roadmap for successful transition to adaptive paradigms. The findings underscore that RAPM is not merely a methodology but a strategic capability that aligns project execution with the realities of modern business ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了实时自适应项目管理（RAPM）的理论基础、技术推动因素和实践应用，分析了其在提高利益相关者参与度、缩短价值实现时间和增强风险缓解方面的作用，特别是在高科技、金融科技和医疗等高速变化行业中的价值。
AI.research_question: 实时自适应项目管理（RAPM）如何通过灵活性、快速响应和持续对齐动态业务需求来应对现代产业中的波动性、不确定性和技术颠覆？
AI.motivation: 现代产业面临前所未有的波动性、不确定性和技术颠覆，传统项目管理框架（依赖固定范围、时间表和刚性计划）已无法适应快速变化的商业环境，需要向更灵活、响应更快的管理方式转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应项目管理理论（如敏捷、Scrum、精益方法）、迭代开发理论、分散决策理论、实时数据整合理论，以及项目管理与战略能力对齐的理论框架。
AI.method: 综合文献综述法（分析当前学术文献）、案例研究法（企业案例研究）、行业调研法（行业研究），采用定性分析方法探讨RAPM的理论基础、技术推动因素和实践实施。
AI.findings: RAPM能够显著提高利益相关者参与度、缩短价值实现时间、增强风险缓解能力；在技术、金融科技和医疗等高速度行业特别有效；但面临组织阻力、工具复杂性和变革疲劳等采纳障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将RAPM从方法论提升为战略能力的概念框架；阐明了自适应项目管理与动态商业生态系统对齐的理论机制；提出了RAPM成功转型的理论路线图。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了向自适应项目管理转型的实施路线图；识别了采纳障碍并提供了解决方案；展示了RAPM在不同行业（特别是高科技、金融科技、医疗）的实际应用案例和最佳实践。

title: Centralization and Stability in Formal Constitutions

detail.title: Centralization and Stability in Formal Constitutions
detail.abstract: Consider a social-choice function (SCF) is chosen to decide votes in a formal system, including votes to replace the voting method itself. Agents vote according to their ex-ante preference between the incumbent SCF and the suggested replacement. The existing SCF then aggregates the agents' votes and arrives at a decision of whether it should itself be replaced. An SCF is self-maintaining if it can not be replaced in such fashion by any other SCF. Our focus is on the implications of self-maintenance for centralization. We present results considering optimistic, pessimistic and i.i.d. approaches w.r.t. agent beliefs, and different tie-breaking rules. To highlight two of the results, (i) for the i.i.d. unbiased case with arbitrary tie-breaking, we prove an "Arrow-Style" Theorem for Dynamics: We show that only a dictatorship is self-maintaining, and any other SCF has a path of changes that arrives at a dictatorship. (ii) If we take into account wisdom of the crowd effects, for a society with a variable size of ruling elite, we demonstrate how the stable elite size is decreasing in both how extractive the economy is, and the quality of individual decision-making. All in all we provide a basic framework and body of results for centralization dynamics and stability, applicable for institution design, especially in formal "De-Jure" systems, such as Blockchain Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs).

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了社会选择函数(SCF)在正式系统中的自我维持特性，特别是当SCF被用于决定是否替换自身时。研究发现，在i.i.d.无偏情况下，只有独裁制是自我维持的，其他SCF最终都会演变为独裁制。同时考虑了精英统治规模如何受经济剥削程度和个人决策质量影响。
AI.research_question: 社会选择函数(SCF)在决定是否替换自身时的自我维持特性对集中化动态有什么影响？在何种条件下SCF能够保持稳定不被替换？
AI.motivation: 研究正式系统（如区块链去中心化自治组织DAOs）中制度设计的稳定性问题。在这些系统中，投票机制本身可能被投票替换，需要理解何种制度设计能够保持稳定，避免无限循环或不稳定状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会选择理论，特别是Arrow不可能定理的扩展。引入"自我维持"概念，分析SCF在决定是否替换自身时的稳定性。考虑乐观、悲观和i.i.d.三种代理人信念模型，以及不同的平局处理规则。
AI.method: 理论分析方法，通过形式化模型和数学证明。考虑三种不同的代理人信念假设：乐观、悲观和独立同分布(i.i.d.)。分析不同平局处理规则下的结果。使用"动态Arrow定理"类比来证明主要结果。
AI.findings: 1. 在i.i.d.无偏情况下，只有独裁制是自我维持的，任何其他SCF都存在一条演化路径最终到达独裁制（动态Arrow定理）。2. 考虑群体智慧效应时，稳定精英规模随着经济剥削程度增加而减少，也随着个人决策质量提高而减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"自我维持"SCF的新概念框架。2. 证明了"动态Arrow定理"，扩展了传统社会选择理论。3. 建立了集中化动态和稳定性的基本分析框架。4. 将社会选择理论应用于制度设计和动态演化分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为正式系统（特别是区块链DAOs）的制度设计提供理论指导。2. 帮助理解投票机制自我修改时的稳定性问题。3. 为设计抗操纵和稳定的治理机制提供洞见。4. 揭示了经济剥削程度和个人决策质量如何影响精英统治的稳定性。

title: From Par to Pressure

detail.title: From Par to Pressure

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Fiat-backed stablecoins are expanding, and their issuers may attain systemic relevance as reserve portfolios grow and as they become increasingly intertwined with financial markets. This paper analyzes the resulting risks and the design choices that can mitigate them. A detailed financial-economics discussion forms the core of the paper. It is paired with a model that captures the feedback loop between a systemic stablecoin and financial markets: redemptions deplete reserves, may prompt asset sales, depress bond market prices, thereby erode a stablecoin issuer’s solvency, and in turn amplify further redemptions. The model links design dials—capital and liquidity buffers, reserve composition, redemption gates, and others—to outcomes such as run frequency, fire sale intensity, and bond market volatility. The economics discussion and model analysis conclude that robust prudential design can substantially stabilize stablecoins and their surrounding market environment.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了法币支持的稳定币在规模扩大后可能产生的系统性风险，通过模型揭示了稳定币与金融市场之间的反馈循环机制，并探讨了通过资本缓冲、流动性要求等设计选择来降低风险的方法。
AI.research_question: 系统性稳定币如何与金融市场形成反馈循环，以及哪些设计选择能够有效缓解由此产生的风险？
AI.motivation: 法币支持的稳定币规模不断扩大，其发行方可能因储备资产增长以及与金融市场的紧密联系而获得系统性重要性，这带来了新的金融风险需要研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融经济学理论，特别是系统性风险、银行挤兑理论和资产定价理论，用于分析稳定币与金融市场之间的反馈机制。
AI.method: 结合详细的金融经济学讨论与数学模型分析，模型捕捉了系统性稳定币与金融市场之间的反馈循环：赎回消耗储备、引发资产抛售、压低债券市场价格、侵蚀稳定币发行方偿付能力，进而放大进一步赎回。
AI.findings: 模型显示稳定币设计参数（资本缓冲、流动性缓冲、储备构成、赎回限制等）与结果（挤兑频率、抛售强度、债券市场波动性）之间存在明确联系。稳健的审慎设计可以显著稳定稳定币及其周边市场环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统性稳定币与金融市场之间反馈循环的理论框架，将稳定币设计参数与金融稳定结果联系起来，丰富了数字资产风险管理的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和稳定币发行方提供了具体的审慎设计建议，包括资本要求、流动性缓冲、储备资产多样化、赎回限制等措施，以降低系统性风险和维护金融稳定。

title: Fintech Competition and Banks’ Shrinking Margins in Brazil

detail.title: Fintech Competition and Banks’ Shrinking Margins in Brazil

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The rise of fintech lenders has intensified competition in the banking industry. This study utilizes Brazilian bank-level data to examine the causal impact of increased competition on commercial banks’ lending rates and profitability. Employing a bank-specific Bartik exposure, constructed from comprehensive credit and balance sheet information across all Brazilian banks and fintech lenders, the analysis reveals that commercial banks sustained their loan portfolios primarily by lowering lending rates. Specifically, a one standard deviation increase in fintech competition exposure corresponds to a 3.7 percentage point reduction in average lending rates at commercial banks. Banks’ operational efficiency increased due to heightened competition, but their net interest margins narrowed, adversely affecting overall profitability. Between 2018 and 2024, fintech competition is estimated to have lowered banks’ average lending rates by 2.7 percentage points and reduced traditional banks' net interest margins by 0.9 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用巴西银行数据，通过构建银行特定的Bartik暴露指标，发现金融科技竞争加剧导致商业银行主要通过降低贷款利率来维持贷款组合，降低了银行的净息差和整体盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 金融科技竞争加剧对商业银行贷款利率和盈利能力有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 金融科技贷款机构的兴起加剧了银行业竞争，但缺乏关于这种竞争如何具体影响商业银行贷款利率和盈利能力的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行业竞争理论、金融科技对传统银行的冲击效应、Bartik工具变量方法
AI.method: 使用巴西银行层面数据，构建银行特定的Bartik暴露指标（基于所有巴西银行和金融科技贷款机构的全面信贷和资产负债表信息），进行因果效应分析
AI.findings: 1. 金融科技竞争暴露每增加一个标准差，商业银行平均贷款利率降低3.7个百分点；2. 商业银行主要通过降低贷款利率来维持贷款组合；3. 竞争提高了银行运营效率，但净息差收窄，整体盈利能力受损；4. 2018-2024年间，金融科技竞争使银行平均贷款利率降低2.7个百分点，传统银行净息差减少0.9个百分点
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了金融科技竞争对传统银行影响的因果证据；2. 揭示了银行应对竞争的具体机制（降低利率而非减少贷款）；3. 丰富了银行业竞争理论在金融科技背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行管理者提供应对金融科技竞争的策略参考；2. 为监管机构制定金融科技政策提供实证依据；3. 帮助投资者理解金融科技竞争对银行盈利的影响

title: Services Inflation and the Exchange Rate in Türkiye
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Services Inflation and the Exchange Rate in Türkiye

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Inflation in Türkiye has been high since 2021. This paper investigates the sources of this inflation and the impact of mitigating exchange rate volatility. Two main findings emerge. First, there has been a significant divergence in inflation dynamics across CPI components since late 2021—in particular, services inflation has exhibited more inertia than goods inflation, a result that stands out in both historical and cross-country contexts. The persistence in services inflation has been generally broad-based, with rental services playing an important role. Second, exchange rate shocks are estimated to have a smaller impact on services inflation than on goods inflation. The peak services inflation response to a nominal exchange rate shock is estimated to be fairly muted, at just one-tenth the size of the shock. Indeed, since mid-2023, there has been an unusually sharp rise in the relative price of services, as goods inflation has been more sensitive to exchange rate movements. These findings suggest that when inflation persistence—especially in services—is relatively high, inflation stabilization may require complementary policies to break inertia beyond a stable currency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了土耳其2021年以来高通胀的根源，特别关注不同CPI组成部分的通胀动态差异以及汇率波动缓解措施的影响。研究发现服务业通胀比商品通胀更具惯性，且汇率冲击对服务业通胀的影响远小于对商品通胀的影响。
AI.research_question: 土耳其2021年以来高通胀的根源是什么？缓解汇率波动对通胀有何影响？不同CPI组成部分（商品vs服务）的通胀动态有何差异？
AI.motivation: 土耳其自2021年以来持续高通胀，需要深入理解其驱动因素和通胀动态特征，特别是不同经济部门对汇率冲击的响应差异，为制定有效的通胀稳定政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀动态理论、汇率传递理论、部门通胀差异理论、通胀惯性理论、相对价格调整理论
AI.method: 实证分析、时间序列分析、部门通胀分解、汇率冲击响应估计、历史比较和跨国比较
AI.findings: 1. 自2021年底以来，CPI各组成部分的通胀动态出现显著分化，服务业通胀比商品通胀更具惯性，这在历史和跨国背景下都很突出。2. 汇率冲击对服务业通胀的影响远小于对商品通胀的影响，汇率冲击对服务业通胀的峰值响应仅为冲击规模的十分之一。3. 2023年中以来，服务业相对价格异常大幅上升，因为商品通胀对汇率变动更敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了通胀动态的部门异质性，特别是服务业通胀的强惯性特征。2. 提供了汇率传递在不同经济部门中差异性的实证证据。3. 拓展了高通胀环境下通胀稳定政策需要考虑部门特征的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为土耳其央行和政策制定者提供了针对性的通胀稳定策略建议。2. 指出当服务业通胀惯性较高时，仅靠稳定汇率可能不足以控制通胀，需要补充性政策来打破通胀惯性。3. 为其他面临类似通胀问题的经济体提供了政策参考。

title: Government Spending Multipliers in Ghana: A Local Projections Approach

detail.title: Government Spending Multipliers in Ghana: A Local Projections Approach
detail.abstract:
Research on fiscal multipliers in Sub-Saharan Africa is a largely unexplored topic, with few country-specific studies. Consequently, it has typically been assumed that the region has low fiscal multipliers, based on evidence from other developing countries rather than direct empirical analysis. This paper aims to address this literature gap, by estimating and analyzing the cumulative fiscal multipliers for government consumption and government investment in Ghana, using quarterly data from 2006Q1 to 2024Q4. The local projections methodology is employed. 
Results show that the economy of Ghana can be highly responsive to fiscal stimuli: the one-year multiplier for government consumption is 1.02, reaching 1.42 over a two-year horizon. In contrast, the multiplier for government investment is lower, resulting at 0.78 at one year and non-significant afterwards, a difference largely attributable to a higher import content of investments. Furthermore, we found the multipliers to be state-dependent, resulting higher during periods of economic slack.

AI.tldr: 本文通过本地投影方法估计加纳的财政乘数，发现政府消费乘数较高（1年1.02，2年1.42），而政府投资乘数较低（1年0.78），且乘数在经济低迷时期更高。
AI.research_question: 加纳的财政乘数（政府消费和政府投资）是多少？这些乘数是否具有状态依赖性？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区的财政乘数研究很少，通常基于其他发展中国家的证据假设该地区乘数较低，缺乏直接实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政乘数理论，特别是关于发展中国家财政政策有效性的理论，以及状态依赖的财政乘数理论。
AI.method: 使用本地投影方法，基于2006年第一季度至2024年第四季度的季度数据估计加纳的财政乘数。
AI.findings: 1. 政府消费乘数较高：1年乘数1.02，2年乘数1.42；2. 政府投资乘数较低：1年乘数0.78，之后不显著；3. 投资乘数较低主要由于进口含量较高；4. 乘数具有状态依赖性，在经济低迷时期更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了撒哈拉以南非洲地区财政乘数研究的空白，提供了加纳的具体实证证据，验证了状态依赖的财政乘数理论在非洲国家的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳政府制定财政政策提供实证依据，建议在经济低迷时期优先使用政府消费刺激经济，考虑投资项目的进口含量对乘数效应的影响。

title: Financial Inclusion, Credit Booms, and Financial Stability Risk
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Western Hemisphere Department,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Financial Inclusion, Credit Booms, and Financial Stability Risk

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Economic benefits of financial inclusion, meaning a broadening access of the population tofinancial services, have been studied extensively, but less is known about its potential effects on financial stability. We explore the complementarity between credit booms and episodes of rapid expansion of the borrower base, or “credit inclusion,” and find that the confluence of both helps to predict future financial distress. Rapid credit inclusion on its own does not usually portend future instability, but it is much more likely to do so when combined with a credit boom. These results can help to enhance the policymaker’s early warning toolbox.

AI.tldr: 金融包容性（扩大金融服务覆盖）本身通常不会导致金融不稳定，但当与信贷繁荣同时发生时，会显著增加未来金融危机的风险。
AI.research_question: 金融包容性（特别是信贷包容性）与信贷繁荣的交互作用如何影响金融稳定性？
AI.motivation: 虽然金融包容性的经济效益已被广泛研究，但其对金融稳定的潜在影响尚不明确，需要探索信贷扩张与借款人基础扩大之间的互补关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、信贷周期理论、金融稳定预警理论
AI.method: 实证分析，探索信贷繁荣与借款人基础快速扩张（信贷包容性）之间的互补关系，检验两者结合对未来金融困境的预测能力
AI.findings:
1. 单独的快速信贷包容性通常不会预示未来不稳定
2. 但当信贷包容性与信贷繁荣同时发生时，会显著增加未来金融危机的风险
3. 两者的结合能有效预测未来金融困境
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了金融包容性与金融稳定之间的复杂关系
2. 提出了信贷繁荣与信贷包容性交互作用的理论框架
3. 丰富了金融稳定预警理论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了改进的早期预警工具
2. 建议监管机构应同时监测信贷增长和借款人基础扩张
3. 有助于制定更精准的金融稳定政策

title: AI: Fluency Without Understanding: Why Modern “Artificial Intelligence” is Pattern Recognition and Pattern Completion, Not Epistemic Intelligence

detail.title: AI: Fluency Without Understanding: Why Modern “Artificial Intelligence” is Pattern Recognition and Pattern Completion, Not Epistemic Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. Ethics approval and informed consent were therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modern AI systems demonstrate extraordinary task performance, yet they do not possess epistemic intelligence-the capacity to discriminate truth, ground claims, and bear responsibility. Contemporary systems labeled as artificial intelligence operate through large-scale statistical pattern recognition and pattern completion rather than grounded understanding. Mislabeling these systems creates authority bias, misplaced trust, and accountability gaps. Accurate conceptual framing is therefore essential for responsible governance and safe deployment.

AI.tldr: 现代AI系统虽然任务表现卓越，但缺乏认知智能——辨别真理、建立主张基础、承担责任的能力。当前被标记为"人工智能"的系统实际上是通过大规模统计模式识别和模式补全运作，而非基于理解。这种错误标记导致权威偏见、不当信任和问责缺失，准确的概念框架对负责任治理和安全部署至关重要。
AI.research_question: 现代AI系统是否真正具备认知智能（辨别真理、建立主张基础、承担责任的能力）？
AI.motivation: 当前被标记为"人工智能"的系统实际上是通过统计模式识别运作，而非真正的理解，这种概念混淆导致权威偏见、不当信任和问责缺失，需要准确的概念框架来指导负责任治理和安全部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知智能理论（辨别真理、建立主张基础、承担责任的能力）；统计模式识别与真正理解的区别；概念框架对技术治理的重要性。
AI.method: 概念分析/哲学分析，通过理论论证区分统计模式识别与认知智能的本质差异。
AI.findings: 现代AI系统缺乏认知智能，只是通过统计模式识别运作；错误标记为"人工智能"导致权威偏见、不当信任和问责缺失；准确的概念框架对负责任治理至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了"人工智能"与"统计模式识别系统"的概念区别；提出了认知智能的核心特征（辨别真理、建立主张基础、承担责任）；为AI伦理和治理提供了概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者、技术开发者和公众正确理解AI系统的本质；减少权威偏见和不当信任；促进更负责任的AI治理和安全部署；为AI问责机制提供理论基础。

title: Behavioral Factors Influencing Tax Compliance in Developing Countries

detail.title: Behavioral Factors Influencing Tax Compliance in Developing Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: Building on existing empirical and conceptual work, this study is an analysis of the behavioural, psychological, social, and institutional factors influencing the phenomena of tax compliance in developing countries. It is essential to examine tax compliance through the lens of behavioural economics in the developing world as opposed to the mainstream orthodox view, which is primarily enforcement-driven from an economics perspective. It is the consideration of the behavioural factors as the focus to build a conceptual analysis of compliance and non-behavioural compliance in the cross-section of developing nations. Respondents' perception of procedural and distributive equity, social trust in state institutions, social norms, educational attainment, and social diffused threat of punishment are interrelated in a complex, systemic, and contextual rather than independent social phenomena, impacting compliance. In particular, the factors of trust and weak institutional legitimacy undermined the positive social compliance in the domain of punishment as well as the voluntary positive compliance in low administrative capacity environments. In the developing world, in order to enhance tax compliance, developing countries need to shift from solely relying on the social auditor framework, demonstrate equity in tax administration, and build institutional credibility. Such an integrated approach is more likely to produce sustainable improvements in compliance behaviour over time.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了发展中国家税收遵从的行为、心理、社会及制度因素，主张应从行为经济学视角而非传统执法驱动视角来理解税收遵从，强调信任、制度合法性、社会规范等系统性因素对税收遵从的影响。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家税收遵从行为受到哪些行为、心理、社会及制度因素的影响？如何通过行为经济学视角而非传统执法驱动视角来理解这些因素？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要从经济学执法驱动视角分析税收遵从，忽视了发展中国家的行为、心理和社会因素。需要从行为经济学视角理解发展中国家税收遵从的复杂性，特别是信任、制度合法性等系统性因素的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论、社会信任理论、制度合法性理论、社会规范理论、程序公平与分配公平理论、惩罚威慑理论。
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建，基于现有实证和概念研究，分析发展中国家税收遵从的行为、心理、社会及制度因素的系统性关系。
AI.findings: 1. 税收遵从是复杂、系统性和情境化的社会现象，而非独立因素简单叠加；2. 程序公平、分配公平、对政府机构的信任、社会规范、教育程度和惩罚威胁相互关联影响遵从行为；3. 信任缺失和制度合法性薄弱会削弱惩罚领域的积极社会遵从和低行政能力环境下的自愿遵从；4. 发展中国家需要超越单纯的社会审计框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了发展中国家税收遵从的行为经济学分析框架；2. 强调了系统性、情境化因素而非独立因素的重要性；3. 挑战了传统执法驱动的税收遵从理论；4. 整合了信任、制度合法性等社会心理因素到税收遵从理论中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议发展中国家从单纯依赖社会审计框架转向综合方法；2. 强调税收管理中的公平性；3. 提出建立制度可信度的必要性；4. 为可持续税收遵从改进提供政策建议。

title: Simulating Team Psychological Safety with Large Language Models

detail.title: Simulating Team Psychological Safety with Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Background: Psychological safety-the belief that one can speak up without fear of negative consequences-is fundamental to team learning and performance, yet controlled experimental research is constrained by practical and ethical limitations. Objective: This study validates large language model (LLM) agents as a methodological tool for simulating team psychological safety dynamics by comparing AI-simulated teams against human teams across identical experimental scenarios. Methods: We conducted parallel experiments with 5,280 AI teams (26,400 agent interactions across 5 LLM architectures) and 249 human teams (1,245 participants; final analytic sample: 247 teams, 1,235 participants after quality screening) using a 2×2 factorial design manipulating leader inclusiveness (High/Low) and error management culture (Learning/Blaming). Teams completed realistic work scenarios while we measured psychological safety perceptions, learning behaviors, team performance, and moderating effects of demographic diversity. A comprehensive validation framework assessed convergent validity (main effects, moderation patterns, mediation pathways), discriminant validity (falsification tests), and measurement properties. Results: AI simulations demonstrated strong convergent validity for main effects: leader inclusiveness effect size (AI: d = 2.21, 95% CI [2.13, 2.29]; Human: d = 1.58, 95% CI [1.42, 1.74]), error culture effect (AI: d = 1.39, 95% CI [1.32, 1.46]; Human: d = 0.97, 95% CI [0.82, 1.12]). AI effects were consistently larger than human effects across all relationship types. Main effects showed calibration ratio = 1.42× (95% CI [1.37×, 1.49×]), with precision-weighted calibration across all 14 effect comparisons = 1.38× (95% CI [1.32×, 1.44×]). This systematic inflation requires effect size adjustment when extrapolating to human teams: multiply main effects by ≈0.70, correlations by ≈0.88, with typespecific calibration detailed for different relationship types.AI effects were consistently larger (mean ratio = 1.40×), suggesting a systematic calibration factor. Mediation pathways showed parallel structure (AI: 77.7% mediated, 95% CI [73.2%, 82.2%]; Human: 90.7%, 95% CI [83.8%, 97.6%]), with bootstrap difference test indicating proportions do not differ significantly (p = .182) despite narrowly non-overlapping individual confidence intervals. Moderator convergence varied: demographic composition effects showed lower pattern correlations (r = .43, 95% CI [.09, .68]) compared to main effects (r = .97, 95% CI [.89, .99]). Eight falsification tests confirmed discriminant validity: AI teams showed theoretically appropriate null effects in control scenarios (8/8 tests supported predictions after theoretical refinement). Cross-model consistency was high (ICC = .79, 95% CI [.73, .84]), with calibration factors stable across architectures (SD = 0.04), indicating systematic rather than model-specific inflation. GPT-4 and Claude-3.5 showed closest absolute alignment to human effect magnitudes. Conclusions: LLM-based simulations offer valid approximations of psychological safety dynamics for theory testing, with predictable calibration requirements (effect size multiplier ≈ 0.70). These tools enable hypothesis testing at scales and experimental control infeasible with human participants, though current limitations in capturing complex moderator interactions and precise effect magnitude warrant continued validation. This methodology significantly expands the experimental toolkit for team science research.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了大型语言模型（LLM）代理作为模拟团队心理安全动态的方法工具，通过比较AI模拟团队与人类团队在相同实验场景中的表现。研究发现AI模拟在主要效应上表现出强收敛效度，但效应量系统性地大于人类团队，需要约0.70的校准因子调整。该方法为团队科学研究提供了可扩展的实验工具。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理能否作为模拟团队心理安全动态的有效方法工具？
AI.motivation: 心理安全对团队学习和绩效至关重要，但传统实验研究受到实践和伦理限制。需要开发新的方法来大规模研究团队动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 团队心理安全理论、领导包容性理论、错误管理文化理论、团队学习理论
AI.method: 平行实验设计：5,280个AI团队（26,400次代理交互，5种LLM架构）vs 249个人类团队（1,245名参与者）。采用2×2因子设计操纵领导包容性（高/低）和错误管理文化（学习/责备）。测量心理安全感知、学习行为、团队绩效和人口多样性调节效应。
AI.findings: AI模拟在主要效应上表现出强收敛效度：领导包容性效应量（AI: d=2.21; 人类: d=1.58），错误文化效应（AI: d=1.39; 人类: d=0.97）。AI效应量系统性地大于人类效应（平均比率=1.40×），需要约0.70的校准因子调整。中介路径结构相似，调节效应收敛性较低。8项证伪测试支持判别效度。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了LLM作为团队心理安全研究的方法工具的有效性；建立了AI模拟效应的校准框架；扩展了团队科学研究的实验方法学。
AI.practical_contributions: 为团队研究提供了可扩展的实验工具；使大规模假设检验成为可能；为组织实践中的团队动态研究提供了新方法；建立了效应量校准的具体指导。

title: Technology and Economic Development
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, University of Chicago - Department of Economics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Entrepreneurship Center

detail.title: Technology and Economic Development

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This chapter presents a tractable framework for the study of technology adoption and diffusion in the context of economic development. Firms in countries behind the world technology frontier can rapidly adopt new techniques from the world frontier. Lower absorptive capacity (because of weak education systems, poor management practices, or barriers to technology adoption), institutional distortions, mismatch between frontier technologies and the needs of firms in the country (i.e., “inappropriate technology”), and credit market frictions slow down technology adoption and cause the economy in question to have a greater distance to the frontier and thus lower income per capita — although the long-run growth rate of the country still remains equal to that of the frontier. This framework is extended to study the choice between innovation and imitation, as well as the role of selection for higher-productivity and higher-absorptive capacity firms during the process of economic development. We illustrate the main comparative statics of our framework with a number of correlations based on cross-country and firm-level data. The tractability of the framework makes it amenable to a range of additional extensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个研究技术采纳与扩散的可处理框架，特别关注发展中国家企业如何从世界技术前沿采纳技术。框架识别了影响技术采纳速度的四个关键障碍：吸收能力低、制度扭曲、技术不匹配和信贷市场摩擦，这些因素导致国家与前沿距离更大、人均收入更低，但长期增长率仍与前沿相同。框架还扩展用于研究创新与模仿的选择，以及高生产率、高吸收能力企业在经济发展过程中的选择作用。
AI.research_question: 在经济发展背景下，哪些因素影响发展中国家企业采纳世界技术前沿技术的速度？这些因素如何影响国家与前沿的距离、人均收入以及长期增长？创新与模仿的选择以及企业选择在技术扩散过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么一些国家能够快速采纳前沿技术而其他国家落后，对于解释国家间收入差异和制定促进经济发展的政策至关重要。现有研究需要更系统的框架来分析技术采纳障碍及其对经济发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术采纳与扩散理论，结合吸收能力理论、制度经济学、技术匹配理论和信贷市场理论，构建了一个综合框架来分析技术采纳障碍对经济发展的影响。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与比较静态分析，辅以跨国和企业层面数据的相关性分析来验证框架的主要预测。
AI.findings: 1. 吸收能力低（教育系统薄弱、管理实践差、技术采纳障碍）、制度扭曲、技术不匹配和信贷市场摩擦会减缓技术采纳速度；2. 这些障碍导致国家与前沿距离更大、人均收入更低；3. 长期增长率仍与世界前沿相同；4. 高生产率、高吸收能力企业在技术扩散过程中发挥关键选择作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个可处理的技术采纳与扩散综合框架；2. 系统识别了影响技术采纳的四大障碍；3. 扩展了创新与模仿选择的分析；4. 引入了企业选择在技术扩散中的作用；5. 框架具有可扩展性，适用于多种延伸研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了识别技术采纳障碍的分析工具；2. 强调了改善教育系统、管理实践和制度环境的重要性；3. 指出了解决技术不匹配和信贷约束的政策方向；4. 为企业技术采纳决策提供了理论指导；5. 有助于设计促进技术扩散和经济发展的具体政策。

title: The Evolution of U.S. Educational Mobility over the 20th Century and the Role of Public Education
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics, Northeastern University and

detail.title: The Evolution of U.S. Educational Mobility over the 20th Century and the Role of Public Education

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We construct two new large-scale datasets to measure relative and upward educational mobility by sex, race, class, and childhood county of residence for cohorts born in 1910–1919 and 1982–1997. We show that both relative and upward educational mobility rose over the 20th century, with historically disadvantaged groups experiencing the largest gains. We also document substantial geographic convergence over the 20th century: both within and across regions, where children live matters much less for their educational mobility today than it did at midcentury. Using a state-border design, we show that greater public investments in primary and secondary education were an important driver of upward educational mobility in the early and late 20th century, but public investments in postsecondary education emerged as a similarly important determinant in the late 20th century.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了两个大规模数据集，测量了1910-1919年和1982-1997年出生队列中按性别、种族、阶级和童年居住县划分的相对和向上教育流动性。研究发现20世纪教育流动性显著提升，历史上弱势群体获益最大，地理差异大幅收敛，公共教育投资是重要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 20世纪美国教育流动性如何变化？哪些因素影响了教育流动性的提升？不同人口群体（性别、种族、阶级、地区）的教育流动性差异如何演变？
AI.motivation: 理解教育流动性如何随时间演变，特别是历史上弱势群体的教育机会变化，以及公共教育投资对不同时期教育流动性的影响，对于制定促进教育公平的政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育流动性理论、社会流动理论、教育投资理论、地理差异理论、历史制度分析框架
AI.method: 构建两个大规模历史数据集（1910-1919年和1982-1997年出生队列），采用定量分析方法测量相对和向上教育流动性，使用州边界设计（state-border design）识别公共教育投资对教育流动性的因果效应
AI.findings: 1. 20世纪相对和向上教育流动性均显著提升；2. 历史上弱势群体（性别、种族、阶级）获益最大；3. 地理差异大幅收敛，居住地对教育流动性的影响减弱；4. 公共基础教育投资在20世纪早期和晚期都是向上教育流动性的重要驱动因素；5. 高等教育投资在20世纪晚期成为同等重要的决定因素
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了教育流动性长期演变的历史证据；2. 揭示了不同人口群体教育流动性差异的收敛模式；3. 阐明了公共教育投资在不同时期对教育流动性的差异化影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育政策制定者提供了促进教育流动性的实证依据；2. 强调了基础教育投资的重要性；3. 指出了高等教育投资在当代教育流动性中的关键作用；4. 为减少地区教育不平等提供了政策启示

title: Geospatial Heterogeneity in Inflation: A Market Concentration Story

detail.title: Geospatial Heterogeneity in Inflation: A Market Concentration Story

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how inflation varies across regions with different income levels and the role of retailer market structure. Using NielsenIQ Retail Scanner and Business Dynamics Statistics data, we document new stylized facts of spatial heterogeneity in food inflation and retailer market structure. From 2006 to 2020, poorer metropolitan statistical areas experienced annualized food inflation that was 0.46 percentage points higher than that of richer ones—amounting to a cumulative difference of 8.8 percentage points over the period. Poorer areas also had fewer goods, fewer retailers, and higher market concentration. Using a triple-difference estimator during the 2014–15 bird flu outbreak, we identify a causal link between market concentration and inflation.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，2006-2020年间，美国较贫困都市区的食品通胀率比富裕地区高0.46个百分点，累计差异达8.8个百分点。贫困地区商品种类少、零售商数量少、市场集中度高。通过2014-15年禽流感爆发的三重差分分析，证实了市场集中度与通胀之间的因果关系。
AI.research_question: 通胀如何在不同收入水平的地区间变化？零售商市场结构在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀的空间异质性及其对不平等的影响，特别是食品通胀对低收入家庭的冲击，以及市场结构在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场集中度理论、价格歧视理论、区域经济学理论，以及市场结构与通胀关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用NielsenIQ零售扫描数据和商业动态统计数据，采用描述性统计分析空间异质性，并利用2014-15年禽流感爆发作为自然实验，采用三重差分法识别市场集中度对通胀的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 贫困地区食品通胀率显著高于富裕地区；2. 贫困地区商品种类少、零售商数量少、市场集中度高；3. 市场集中度与通胀存在因果关系，集中度高的地区通胀更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为通胀的空间异质性提供了实证证据；2. 建立了市场集中度与通胀的因果联系；3. 丰富了区域不平等与市场结构关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了缓解区域不平等的新视角；2. 提示反垄断政策需要考虑区域差异；3. 为消费者保护政策提供了依据。

title: Comparative Analysis of Withholding Tax Regimes in Emerging Economies

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Withholding Tax Regimes in Emerging Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: The collection of withholding tax (WHT) appears to be a cornerstone for revenue generation within an economy, as it allows for early tax collection, helps to mitigate tax evasion, and reinforces a government's revenue-generating capacity, given the administrative and compliance challenges that are often present in developing tax systems (Soos 107). This study is a comparative qualitative and doctrinal examination of the WHT systems that are present in several selected developing countries, and attempts to analyze particular elements of the WHT systems that pertain to policy frameworks, mechanisms of enforcement, and the various levels of compliance that are evident within the jurisdictions in question, from both a statutory and administrative perspective (Rumasukun and Noch 102).

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较定性分析，探讨发展中国家预扣税制度在政策框架、执行机制和合规水平方面的差异，旨在为完善税收征管提供参考。
AI.research_question: 不同发展中国家预扣税制度在政策框架、执行机制和合规水平方面存在哪些差异？这些差异如何影响税收征管效果？
AI.motivation: 预扣税作为早期税收征管工具，对发展中国家财政收入至关重要，但面临行政和合规挑战。需要系统比较各国制度以识别最佳实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收征管理论、合规理论和制度经济学框架，分析预扣税作为税收征管工具的有效性。
AI.method: 采用比较定性研究和法理分析方法，对多个选定发展中国家的预扣税制度进行系统比较。
AI.findings: 不同发展中国家在预扣税政策设计、执行机制和合规水平上存在显著差异，这些差异直接影响税收征管效率和财政收入能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家税收征管理论，特别是预扣税作为早期征管工具的理论框架，为制度比较研究提供方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供预扣税制度设计的实践指导，帮助识别有效执行机制和合规策略，提升税收征管效率。

title: Taxpayer Education and Voluntary Compliance among SMEs

detail.title: Taxpayer Education and Voluntary Compliance among SMEs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are essential to providing growth to any developing economy; however, providing public revenue is solely dependent on voluntary tax compliance (Soos 107; Rumasukun & Noch 102). This is the comparative taxpayer education program study undertaken in some of the developing economies to elicit the appreciation of taxpayer education on voluntary compliance with tax (Machogu & Amayi, 2016; Gitaru, 2017). The evidence suggests that voluntary compliance, as an appreciation of taxpayer education, is highly influenced by the taxpayer education program that incorporates digital outreach to SMEs. The outreach digital program is sustained by digital outreach to SMEs. The outreach of education programs is to some extent controlled by advanced systems of governance and/or weak structural factors pertaining to audits, legal frameworks and overall governance (Njunwa & Batonda 2023; Amaning et al 2021; Lubua 2014). The programs in question appear to confirm that it is not the gap of taxpayer education contributing to the lack of voluntary compliance appreciation programs; it is the sustained gap created by the lack of effective modern enforcement frameworks. The study concludes by providing policymakers with an SME education program that is digitally centred; it requires further research on SME education programs that are digitally centred to develop the institutional framework designed to sustain it.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了发展中国家中小企业纳税人教育项目对自愿纳税遵从的影响，发现数字化的教育推广项目能有效提升遵从度，但缺乏有效的现代执法框架是主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 纳税人教育项目（特别是数字化推广项目）如何影响发展中国家中小企业的自愿纳税遵从？
AI.motivation: 中小企业对发展中经济体增长至关重要，但公共收入主要依赖自愿纳税遵从。现有研究表明纳税人教育对自愿遵从有影响，但具体机制和效果需要进一步研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于纳税人教育理论、自愿遵从理论和数字治理理论，探讨教育项目如何通过数字化手段影响中小企业纳税行为。
AI.method: 比较研究法，分析多个发展中国家的纳税人教育项目案例，结合文献综述和实证证据。
AI.findings:
1. 数字化推广的纳税人教育项目能显著提升中小企业自愿纳税遵从度
2. 自愿遵从不足的主要障碍不是教育项目缺失，而是缺乏有效的现代执法框架
3. 审计制度、法律框架和整体治理水平影响教育项目的效果
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 深化了纳税人教育与自愿遵从关系的理论理解
2. 强调了数字化手段在教育项目中的关键作用
3. 提出了教育项目效果受制度框架制约的理论观点
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供以数字化为中心的中小企业教育项目方案
2. 建议加强现代执法框架建设以支持教育项目效果
3. 呼吁进一步研究数字化教育项目的制度框架设计

title: Connected for Better or Worse? The Role of Production Networks in Financial Crises

detail.title: Connected for Better or Worse? The Role of Production Networks in Financial Crises

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Boston Working Paper No. 26-1
publicationDetails.journalName: FRB-Boston: Research Department Working Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study how production networks shape the severity of Sudden Stops. We build a small open economy model with collateral constraints and input–output linkages, derive a sufficient statistic that maps network structure onto the amplification of tradable shocks, and show that a planner optimally introduces sectoral wedges to reduce amplification. Using OECD input-output data and Sudden Stop episodes, we document systematic network differences between emerging and advanced economies and show they predict crisis severity. A calibrated three-sector DSGE model disciplined by these differences reveals that endowing an advanced economy with an emerging-market production network moves most of the way toward the observed emerging–advanced Sudden Stop gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究生产网络如何影响"突然停止"危机的严重程度。研究发现，新兴经济体与发达经济体之间的生产网络结构差异能够解释它们在危机严重性上的差距。
AI.research_question: 生产网络结构如何影响突然停止危机的严重程度？新兴经济体与发达经济体在生产网络上的差异如何解释它们在危机严重性上的差距？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么新兴经济体比发达经济体更容易受到突然停止危机的冲击，以及生产网络结构在这一差异中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 小型开放经济模型，包含抵押约束和投入产出联系；网络结构对可贸易冲击放大的充分统计量；最优规划者引入部门楔形以减少放大效应。
AI.method: 1. 理论模型构建：建立包含抵押约束和投入产出联系的小型开放经济模型；2. 实证分析：使用OECD投入产出数据和突然停止事件数据；3. 校准模型：基于三部门DSGE模型，用新兴市场和发达经济体的网络差异进行校准。
AI.findings: 1. 新兴经济体与发达经济体存在系统性生产网络差异；2. 这些网络差异能够预测危机严重程度；3. 将发达经济体的生产网络替换为新兴市场网络，能够解释大部分新兴-发达经济体在突然停止危机严重性上的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了生产网络结构与突然停止危机严重程度之间的理论联系；2. 推导了网络结构对可贸易冲击放大的充分统计量；3. 提出了最优规划者通过部门楔形干预减少危机放大的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了理解危机传播机制的新视角；2. 识别了生产网络结构作为危机脆弱性的重要决定因素；3. 为宏观经济稳定政策设计提供了基于网络结构的干预思路。

detail.abstract: This research looks into the effect of tax morale on the collections of domestic tax revenue in developing countries. Since the traditional approach of the enforcement of tax collection does not succeed in getting complete compliance, the study looks into intrinsic factors, such as civic duty and trust in the government's collection of revenue. A mixed approach of tax morale and domestic revenue. A case study on selected low and middle-income countries, socioeconomic secondary data, and statistical analysis in the area of tax morale and domestic revenue performance. The analysis of the data indicates Giyane is the sole tax philanthropist in the country. The study also tries to explain the situation on the existence of weak enforcement, low taxpayer education, and weak trust in the public voluntary compliance as well as opaque formal policy measures, and the overall low taxpayer education, and weak compliance as well as opaque formal policy measures, with the overall study on the need to strengthen tax morale as the cornerstone of the formal enforcement of the policy. Policy recommendations include strengthening taxpayer education programs, building institutional trust, and designing incentive structures that align with intrinsic motivations. By integrating behavioural and economic perspectives, this research underscores the importance of fostering a culture of voluntary compliance to support fiscal sustainability in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了税收道德对发展中国家国内税收收入的影响，强调内在动机（如公民责任感和对政府的信任）比传统执法手段更能促进税收遵从，并提出了加强税收道德的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 税收道德如何影响发展中国家的国内税收收入？
AI.motivation: 传统的税收执法方法无法实现完全遵从，因此需要研究内在因素（如公民责任感和对政府的信任）对税收遵从的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合行为经济学和传统经济学视角，关注内在动机（税收道德）与外在强制（执法）在税收遵从中的作用。
AI.method: 采用混合方法，对选定的中低收入国家进行案例研究，使用社会经济二手数据进行统计分析，探讨税收道德与国内税收绩效的关系。
AI.findings: 数据显示Giyane是该国唯一的税收慈善家；研究发现存在执法薄弱、纳税人教育不足、公众自愿遵从信任度低、正式政策不透明等问题；强调需要加强税收道德作为政策正式执行的基石。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合行为经济学和经济学的视角，强调内在动机在税收遵从中的重要性，为理解发展中国家的税收遵从行为提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策建议包括：加强纳税人教育计划、建立制度信任、设计与内在动机一致的激励结构，通过培养自愿遵从文化来支持发展中国家的财政可持续性。

detail.abstract: Apart from its contributions to theoretical frameworks, this study also attempts to digitise tax and tax compliance in different settings (Wulandari, Mandasari, Mbise, and Baseka). The study aims to ascertain the effect of the digital tax reform from the developed and developing countries in particular, and in juxtaposition to the differentiated outcome of the digital tax reform (Katua, Apollo, Zlatnikov, and Firsovich). The reviewed literature from different countries suggests migration towards new tax compliance technology motivates lower cost of compliance, transparency, system deterrence, active monitoring, and procedural justice (Wulandari, Mandasari, Mbis, et al. Baseka). The study findings suggest that compliance with tax digitalisation lowers the burden of the tax system and increases the detection and fairness of the tax system (Wulandari, Mandasari, Mbis, et al.). However, the system is equally dispersed in firm size, economic sector, and institutional capacity. Weaker and small enterprises, the administration system has fewer benefits of digital tax compliance (Katua, Apollo, Zlatnikov, and Firsovich). The study concludes that while tax digitalisation is a necessary condition for improving compliance, it is not sufficient on its own and must be complemented by reforms in taxpayer education, enforcement strategies, and governance quality (Belahouaoui and Attak; Slimani and Abidli; Dhaliwal et al.).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了税收数字化改革对发达国家和发展中国家的影响，发现数字化虽然能降低合规成本、提高透明度和公平性，但对中小企业和制度能力较弱的国家效果有限，需要配套改革才能充分发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 税收数字化改革对发达国家和发展中国家的税收合规有何不同影响？数字化税收系统在不同企业规模、经济部门和制度能力下的实施效果如何？
AI.motivation: 随着全球税收数字化趋势加速，需要了解数字化改革在不同国家背景下的实际效果，特别是发达国家与发展中国家的差异，以及数字化对各类纳税人的影响差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收合规理论、制度理论和数字治理理论，研究数字化如何通过降低合规成本、提高透明度、增强系统威慑、主动监控和程序公正来影响税收合规行为。
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合分析了来自多个国家（包括发达国家和发展中国家）的现有研究文献，比较不同背景下的税收数字化改革效果。
AI.findings: 1. 税收数字化降低了合规负担，提高了税收系统的检测能力和公平性；2. 数字化效果在不同企业规模、经济部门和制度能力下分布不均；3. 中小企业和制度能力较弱的国家从数字化中获益较少；4. 数字化本身不足以改善合规，需要配套改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了税收合规理论，强调了数字化作为中介变量的作用；深化了对制度能力与数字化效果关系的理解；提出了数字化税收系统的边界条件理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实施税收数字化的具体建议：需要配套纳税人教育、执法策略改进和治理质量提升；特别关注中小企业的特殊需求；强调制度能力建设的重要性。

title: Effectiveness of Penalty and Incentive Systems in Tax Collection

detail.abstract: Although tax collection is a significant source of government revenue for emerging economies, taxpayer noncompliance is a serious concern. Defining measures for the systematic management of compliance via noncompliance is a management challenge. This study attempts a systematic, comparative, and empirical analysis of mechanisms prescribed for dealing with compliance and noncompliance of income taxes and corporate taxes. The study relies on both quantitative and qualitative data. The study contends that incentive mechanisms such as tax credits and tax deductions, while maintaining compliance, increase the rate of voluntary compliance. Exile from the system, as a sanction, is successful to a degree, and is counterproductive for socio-political reasons, unless the fleeing citizen is politically disadvantaged, and enforcement is systematic, predictable, and visible. There appears to be a withdrawal of compliance in the migration of enforcement sanction measures. It is to be concluded that monitoring and controlling compliance noncompliance mechanisms, along with socio-political factors, are essential to the following aspects of voluntary compliance: migrant mechanisms, punitive mechanisms, educational factors, and social compliance factors. Taxes as penalties with incentives are positive. The study provides actionable insights for policymakers seeking to optimise revenue mobilisation while promoting fairness and voluntary compliance in tax systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究对新兴经济体的税收合规与非合规管理机制进行了系统性比较实证分析，发现激励措施（如税收抵免和扣除）能提高自愿合规率，而制裁措施（如驱逐出系统）在特定条件下有效但可能适得其反，强调监控合规机制与社会政治因素对自愿合规的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何系统管理新兴经济体的税收合规与非合规机制？特别是，激励措施和制裁措施对收入税和企业税的自愿合规率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体税收是非政府收入的重要来源，但纳税人非合规问题严重。系统管理合规与非合规机制是管理挑战，需要实证研究为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收合规理论、激励理论、制裁理论、社会政治因素对合规行为的影响理论
AI.method: 采用定量与定性相结合的混合研究方法，对收入税和企业税的合规与非合规机制进行系统性比较实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 激励机制（税收抵免和扣除）在维持合规的同时提高自愿合规率；2. 制裁措施（驱逐出系统）在特定条件下有效，但可能因社会政治原因适得其反；3. 执行制裁措施时可能出现合规撤退现象；4. 监控合规机制与社会政治因素对自愿合规至关重要
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了税收合规管理的理论框架；2. 揭示了激励与制裁机制的交互作用；3. 强调了社会政治因素在合规决策中的理论重要性；4. 提出了"合规撤退"的新概念
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供优化税收征管的可行见解；2. 指导如何平衡激励与制裁措施；3. 帮助设计更公平、促进自愿合规的税收系统；4. 提供监控合规机制的具体建议

title: Audit-Ready Contractor and Professional Service Payments: A Documentation & Controls Playbook Lessons from a High-Scrutiny Audit Environment-Year-End FX Valuation, Evidence Standards, and Cross-Border Performance Risk

detail.title: Audit-Ready Contractor and Professional Service Payments: A Documentation & Controls Playbook Lessons from a High-Scrutiny Audit Environment-Year-End FX Valuation, Evidence Standards, and Cross-Border Performance Risk
detail.abstract: Contractor and professional service payments often trigger tax disputes not because the rules are unclear, but because classification, substantiation, and valuation are not embedded in the procure‑to‑pay process. This practitioner playbook sets out: (i) a risk‑based taxonomy for service payments; (ii) a minimum viable Audit‑Ready File (ARF); and (iii) control gates that prevent issues before they escalate into controversies. Based on patterns observed in a high‑scrutiny audit environment, it focuses on three recurring failure points: non‑deductible items recorded as professional expenses, foreign‑currency misvaluation (particularly at year‑end), and mischaracterization caused by a gap between contractual descriptions and actual performance. Because outcomes are often determined by the strength of the evidence, the playbook treats documentation quality as governance—especially in cross‑border services where location, withholding, and valuation risks intersect. The framework is jurisdiction‑agnostic, focusing on evidence design and controls rather than country‑specific rules.

AI.tldr: 本文为实务指南，针对承包商和专业服务付款引发的税务争议，提出基于风险的服务付款分类、最低可行审计就绪文件和控制关口，重点关注非可抵扣项目、外币估值错误和合同描述与实际执行不符三大常见问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过系统化方法预防承包商和专业服务付款中的税务争议？
AI.motivation: 承包商和专业服务付款经常引发税务争议，不是因为规则不明确，而是因为分类、证明和估值问题没有嵌入采购到付款流程中。在高强度审计环境下观察到的问题模式表明需要系统化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险分类理论、审计就绪文件设计和流程控制关口理论，将文档质量视为治理机制，特别是在跨境服务中位置、预扣税和估值风险交叉的情况下。
AI.method: 基于高强度审计环境中观察到的模式，采用实务指南方法，提出系统化框架，包括风险分类、审计就绪文件设计和控制关口。
AI.findings: 识别了三个重复出现的失败点：1) 非可抵扣项目记录为专业费用；2) 外币估值错误（特别是年末）；3) 合同描述与实际执行之间的差距导致的错误分类。结果往往取决于证据强度。

AI.practical_contributions: 提供实务操作指南：1) 基于风险的服务付款分类法；2) 最低可行审计就绪文件；3) 防止问题升级为争议的控制关口。帮助企业在采购到付款流程中嵌入税务合规机制。

title: Anti-Evasion Mechanisms and the Effectiveness of Audit Trails

detail.title: Anti-Evasion Mechanisms and the Effectiveness of Audit Trails

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article

declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: Both developed and developing economies continue to struggle with challenges such as tax evasion and the socioeconomic consequences it brings (revenue losses, inequities, and erosion of public confidence in the tax system) (Enicov and Criclivaia; Karwat). Faced with the challenges of revenue losses and the inequities created by the tax system, developing and developed economies continue to struggle with tax evasion (Enicov and Criclivaia; Karwat). Although new strategies have been developed to prevent,... tax evasion continues to exist and to predict and circumvent strategies designed to prevent it, including the porous administrative structures and the power of information asymmetry on the challenges that tax administration faces (Webster). This study, in part, seeks to address the doctrinal and empirical analyses of contemporary mechanisms to counter administrative evasion, focusing on the timber trail of the administrative tax system (Balios et al.; Audit Trails and Financial Transparency). Drawing from the comparative public finance literature and an analysis of institutions, the study seeks to better capture the utility of audit trails in conjunction with other systems of compliance governance. The studies show that audit trails, particularly when they are a part of a digital reporting system, strengthen the internal controls and financial transparency of the jurisdiction in which the audit trail is operational (Public Finance and Tax Transparency; CRS Study). Nevertheless, the merit of systems, audit trails inclusive, is jurisdictionally contingent. However, their effectiveness is not uniform across jurisdictions. The study concludes that while audit trails constitute a powerful anti-evasion instrument, their impact is conditional upon administrative capacity, taxpayer education, and the availability of robust digital infrastructure (Evaluating Taxpayer Education; Shah). Accordingly, audit trails should be implemented as part of a holistic compliance strategy rather than as standalone enforcement mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨审计追踪作为反逃税工具的有效性，发现其效果取决于行政能力、纳税人教育和数字基础设施，应作为整体合规策略的一部分而非独立执行机制。
AI.research_question: 审计追踪作为反逃税机制的有效性如何？其效果在不同司法管辖区有何差异？
AI.motivation: 发达国家和发展中国家都面临逃税带来的挑战，包括税收损失、不平等和公众对税收系统信任的侵蚀。尽管已有新策略，但逃税仍然存在并能够预测和规避反逃税措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较公共财政文献和制度分析，关注行政税收系统的"木材追踪"（timber trail）概念。
AI.method: 教义分析和实证分析，结合比较公共财政文献和制度分析。
AI.findings: 审计追踪（特别是作为数字报告系统的一部分）能够加强内部控制和财务透明度，但其效果在不同司法管辖区并不一致，取决于行政能力、纳税人教育和数字基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 为审计追踪作为反逃税工具的理论框架提供了实证支持，强调了制度条件和情境依赖的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议审计追踪应作为整体合规策略的一部分实施，而非独立的执行机制，需要考虑行政能力、纳税人教育和数字基础设施等因素。

title: Informal Sector Taxation and Challenges in Revenue Collection

detail.title: Informal Sector Taxation and Challenges in Revenue Collection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
