title: The Nthoiwa Football Success Matrix (NFSM): A Socio‑Mathematical Framework for Predicting International Performance

detail.title: The Nthoiwa Football Success Matrix (NFSM): A Socio‑Mathematical Framework for Predicting International Performance
detail.abstract: The persistent disparity between squad market value and tournament outcomes remains one of the most unresolved problems in international football governance. From a sports economics perspective, the evidence suggests that efficient national team outcomes arise when international player migration is balanced with sustained investment in domestic league quality. This paper introduces the Football Success Matrix (NFSM/FSM), a socio‑mathematical framework modelling national team performance as a function of technical capacity filtered through institutional efficiency. Using longitudinal comparative evidence covering the last five FIFA World Cups (2006–2022) and major confederation tournaments since 2013, the framework highlights four interacting determinants of success: (1) the 15‑player European threshold; (2) domestic league tier strength; (3) coach calibre (technical, cultural, and motivational); and (4) administrative friction as the binding constraint. The findings indicate that institutional efficiency is a stronger predictor of tournament progression than player market value or domestic league prestige. Coach calibre acts as a volatility buffer, capable of attenuating, but not eliminating the performance costs of structural and institutional constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了足球成功矩阵（NFSM/FSM）框架，发现制度效率比球员市场价值或国内联赛声望更能预测国家队在国际比赛中的成功。教练素质可以缓冲结构性约束的影响，但不能完全消除。
AI.research_question: 国家队在国际足球比赛中的成功（如世界杯表现）是由哪些因素决定的？制度效率、球员市场价值、国内联赛质量、教练素质等因素的相对重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 国家队市场价值与比赛成绩之间的持续差距是国际足球治理中最未解决的问题之一。需要理解国家队成功背后的结构性因素，而不仅仅是球员个人能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 足球成功矩阵（NFSM/FSM）——一个社会数学框架，将国家队表现建模为通过制度效率过滤的技术能力函数。基于体育经济学视角，强调国际球员流动与国内联赛质量投资的平衡。
AI.method: 使用纵向比较证据，涵盖最近五届世界杯（2006-2022）和2013年以来的主要洲际锦标赛。分析四个相互作用的影响因素：15名球员欧洲阈值、国内联赛层级强度、教练素质、行政摩擦。
AI.findings: 1. 制度效率比球员市场价值或国内联赛声望更能预测锦标赛进展；2. 教练素质作为波动缓冲器，能够减轻但不能消除结构和制度约束带来的性能成本；3. 行政摩擦是主要的约束因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了足球成功矩阵（NFSM/FSM）理论框架，将国家队表现系统建模为技术能力与制度效率的交互函数。为理解足球治理中的"价值-成绩差距"提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为足球协会和国家队管理者提供了评估和改进国家队表现的实用框架。强调需要平衡国际球员流动与国内联赛投资，提升制度效率，选择合适教练来缓冲结构约束。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics for Sustainable Business Operations and Healthcare Management

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics for Sustainable Business Operations and Healthcare Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, personal, or professional relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this study. The work was conducted independently and without any competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary sources, conceptual analysis, and applied evaluation of existing practices. It did not involve direct interaction with human participants, clinical data, or personally identifiable information. As a result, formal ethics committee approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author and did not receive funding from any public, commercial, or non-profit organizations. All stages of the research, including analysis and writing, were carried out without external financial support.

detail.abstract: Special Issue Description In recent years, artificial intelligence and data analytics have become part of everyday operations in many organizations. These tools are no longer limited to research or testing environments. Businesses now use data-based systems to support planning, track performance, and manage resources more efficiently. In healthcare organizations, analytics is increasingly used to improve administrative planning, scheduling, and workflow management. This proposed Special Issue focuses on how artificial intelligence and data analytics are actually used in real organizational settings. The main focus is on sustainable business operations and practical management outcomes. Rather than concentrating on technical model design, the issue encourages studies that explain how analytics tools are applied in daily business processes. Some contributions may also examine healthcare management applications where efficiency, planning, and sustainability are closely linked. The Special Issue welcomes applied research, empirical studies, conceptual discussions, and case studies based on real experience. Authors are encouraged to reflect on challenges faced during implementation, including organizational resistance, data quality concerns, and ethical responsibilities. The overall goal is to provide practical insight into how data-driven decision-making can support more sustainable and responsible organizational practices.

AI.tldr: 本期特刊聚焦人工智能与数据分析在真实组织环境中的实际应用，特别关注可持续商业运营和实际管理成果，而非技术模型设计。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和数据分析如何在真实组织环境中被实际应用，以支持可持续的商业运营和管理成果？
AI.motivation: 近年来，人工智能和数据分析已从研究测试环境扩展到日常运营，企业使用这些工具支持规划、追踪绩效和管理资源，特别是在医疗保健组织中用于改善行政管理、排程和工作流管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据驱动决策、组织变革理论、可持续发展理论、医疗保健管理理论、技术采纳与实施理论。
AI.method: 应用研究、实证研究、概念讨论、基于真实经验的案例研究。
AI.findings: 特刊鼓励研究展示数据分析工具在日常业务流程中的实际应用，特别是在医疗保健管理领域，其中效率、规划和可持续性密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为人工智能和数据分析在组织环境中的实际应用提供理论框架，深化对技术采纳、组织变革和可持续发展之间关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供关于如何有效实施数据驱动决策的实用见解，解决实施过程中的挑战（如组织阻力、数据质量问题、伦理责任），支持更可持续和负责任的组织实践。

title: A Critical Analysis of the Decentralization of the Electricity Sector in Nigeria: Implication for Power Generation and Distribution in Nigeria

detail.title: A Critical Analysis of the Decentralization of the Electricity Sector in Nigeria: Implication for Power Generation and Distribution in Nigeria
detail.abstract:
Nigeria’s electricity sector has long been characterised by centralised control, structural inefficiencies, and chronic supply deficits. Despite decades of reform, electricity access remains limited, generation capacity underperforms relative to installed assets, and transmission and distribution losses persist. Against this backdrop, the decentralisation of the Nigerian Electricity Supply Industry under the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 (as amended) and the Electricity Act 2023 represents a fundamental shift in governance and market design. This paper critically examines the decentralisation framework and its implications for power generation and distribution in Nigeria.

The study analyses the conceptual basis of decentralisation, the historical evolution of the Nigerian power sector, and the key legal instruments driving the current reforms. It evaluates how devolving regulatory and market powers to states may reshape generation through increased participation by Independent Power Producers, diversified financing models, and improved renewable energy integration. It also assesses implications for distribution, including state-level tariff setting, service delivery, loss reduction strategies, and consumer protection.

While decentralisation offers opportunities for tailored, locally responsive electricity solutions and enhanced private sector participation, the paper identifies significant risks. These include regulatory fragmentation, uneven institutional capacity across states, coordination challenges between federal and state regulators, and the danger of widening regional disparities in electricity access and reliability. The paper argues that decentralisation alone cannot resolve Nigeria’s electricity crisis without harmonised regulation, strong institutions, credible market rules, and sustained investment in transmission infrastructure.

The paper concludes that decentralisation has the potential to improve efficiency and access in Nigeria’s electricity sector, but only if implemented within a coherent national framework that balances state autonomy with system-wide coordination and market stability.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了尼日利亚电力供应行业根据1999年宪法和2023年电力法案进行的去中心化改革框架及其对发电和配电的影响。研究发现，去中心化虽能带来本地化解决方案和私营部门参与机会，但也面临监管碎片化、机构能力不均等风险，需要协调的国家框架才能成功。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚电力行业的去中心化改革框架如何影响该国的发电和配电？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚电力行业长期存在集中控制、结构效率低下和供应短缺问题。尽管进行了数十年改革，但电力供应仍然有限，发电能力未达预期，输配电损耗持续存在。在此背景下，根据1999年宪法和2023年电力法案进行的去中心化改革代表了治理和市场设计的根本性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去中心化理论、电力行业治理理论、市场设计理论、制度经济学理论
AI.method: 概念分析、历史分析、法律文件分析、政策评估分析
AI.findings: 去中心化为尼日利亚电力行业带来机遇：通过增加独立电力生产商参与、多样化融资模式和改善可再生能源整合来重塑发电；在配电方面实现州级电价设定、服务提供、损耗减少策略和消费者保护。但也存在显著风险：监管碎片化、各州机构能力不均、联邦与州监管机构协调挑战、可能扩大地区电力供应和可靠性差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为电力行业去中心化理论提供了发展中国家的实证案例；2. 提出了去中心化改革中协调与自主权的平衡理论框架；3. 丰富了制度能力与监管协调在电力改革中的作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为尼日利亚电力改革政策制定者提供了实施建议；2. 识别了去中心化改革中的关键风险和缓解策略；3. 强调了协调的国家框架、强大机构、可信市场规则和持续输电基础设施投资的重要性；4. 为其他发展中国家电力改革提供了参考。

title: The Inconvenient Truth Hurts: Just Energy Transitions in The Last Bastion of American Coal?

detail.title: The Inconvenient Truth Hurts: Just Energy Transitions in The Last Bastion of American Coal?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects were used in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: The author has no external funding or financial conflicts of interest to disclose.

detail.abstract: The title of this paper, Inconvenient Truth Hurts, deliberately echoes Al Gore’s An Inconvenient Truth, a work that played a formative role in bringing climate change into mainstream public discourse in the United States. While Gore’s intervention was influential in raising awareness of climate science, it also marked a turning point in the politicization of climate change, particularly in how environmental knowledge became intertwined with partisan identity, moral judgment, and competing visions of economic development. The rhetorical power of the “inconvenient truth” framed climate change as an unavoidable scientific reality, yet its public reception revealed that facts alone do not travel neutrally through political and institutional landscapes. This politicization has had lasting implications for energy transitions. Debates over renewable energy adoption, fossil fuel decline, and infrastructure investment have increasingly been shaped not only by technical feasibility or environmental necessity, but by political alignment, regional identity, and historical economic dependence. In this sense, the “hurt” referenced in the title points less to the physical impacts of climate change itself and more to the social, economic, and institutional frictions that emerge when energy systems are challenged or restructured. For regions with long-standing ties to extractive industries, such as Appalachia, these tensions are particularly acute. Appalachia, which arguably is the last bastion of American Coal. A region that for centuries powered a nation, most notably through its industrial revolution. Importantly, however, this paper does not advance a normative position on how energy transitions ought to proceed, nor does it seek to adjudicate between competing political interpretations of energy transitions. Instead, it adopts an analytical perspective that treats politicization as an empirical condition rather than a problem to be resolved. Examining how political, demographic, and institutional variables interact with renewable energy production and consumption, the study aims to clarify the mechanisms through which energy transitions unfold in practice, giving some credence to regional differences. In doing so, it recognizes both the influence and the limitations of high-profile energy transition narratives, including those influenced by the politicization of climate change, while remaining attentive to the structural factors that shape energy outcomes on the ground. Methodologically, this study integrates Geographic Information Systems analysis with correlation techniques and multiple linear regression models. It identifies state-level patterns and explanatory variables that influence renewable energy production and consumption. This mixed methods approach allows for both spatial visualization and statistical evaluation, providing a comprehensive understanding of how renewable energy adoption varies across geographic and political contexts. The results reveal pronounced spatial disparities in renewable energy clustering across the United States. Certain regions exhibit dense concentrations of renewable energy production and consumption, while others lag significantly behind. These patterns are not solely explained by natural resource endowments such as solar irradiance or wind availability. Instead, the findings suggest that demographic composition, economic structure, and institutional capacity play critical roles in shaping renewable energy outcomes. States with similar resource potential often display markedly different adoption trajectories, highlighting the importance of nontechnical factors. The analysis further demonstrates that the relationship between political orientation and renewable energy adoption is more complex and often mediated by broader structural variables. While political ideology is frequently assumed to be a primary determinant of energy policy outcomes, the regression results indicate that its explanatory power diminishes when institutional, demographic size, infrastructural, and macroeconomic factors are taken into account.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了气候变化政治化如何影响美国可再生能源转型，研究发现政治意识形态并非决定能源政策的主要因素，而是受到制度、人口、经济结构等更广泛结构性变量的中介作用。
AI.research_question: 政治、人口和制度变量如何影响美国各州的可再生能源生产和消费模式？
AI.motivation: 气候变化问题在美国已被高度政治化，从戈尔《难以忽视的真相》开始，环境知识与党派身份、道德判断和经济愿景交织在一起。这种政治化对能源转型产生持久影响，但现有研究往往过度强调政治意识形态的作用，忽视了其他结构性因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源转型政治化理论、制度分析框架、区域发展理论。论文将政治化视为经验条件而非需要解决的问题，强调能源转型受到政治、人口、制度等多重因素交互影响。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：结合地理信息系统分析、相关性分析和多元线性回归模型，分析州级可再生能源生产和消费模式及其影响因素。
AI.findings: 1. 美国可再生能源分布存在显著空间差异，某些地区集中度高，其他地区明显落后；2. 这些模式不能仅用自然资源禀赋解释；3. 人口构成、经济结构和制度能力对可再生能源结果起关键作用；4. 政治意识形态与可再生能源采纳的关系更复杂，其解释力在考虑制度、人口规模、基础设施和宏观经济因素后减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了政治意识形态是能源政策主要决定因素的简化观点；2. 提出能源转型的多因素交互模型；3. 强调制度能力和结构性因素在能源转型中的中介作用；4. 为理解区域差异提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更全面的能源转型影响因素分析；2. 指出需要超越政治意识形态，关注制度建设和结构性改革；3. 为阿巴拉契亚等传统能源地区转型提供参考；4. 强调因地制宜的能源政策设计重要性。

title: The Quiet Risk: Why Off-Balance-Sheet SPVs and Actively Managed Certificates (AMCs) Fail Under IFRS, BEPS and Global Transparency Rules

detail.title: The Quiet Risk: Why Off-Balance-Sheet SPVs and Actively Managed Certificates (AMCs) Fail Under IFRS, BEPS and Global Transparency Rules

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the owner of Kyros Capital, a financial services firm active in the field of structured finance. The author has professional experience in structured finance and structured products. This research was conducted independently and reflects the author’s own analysis. No external organization provided funding for this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author and did not receive any external funding.

detail.abstract: Over the past decade, Actively Managed Certificates (AMCs) and offshore Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) have become central instruments of modern financial structuring, marketed as flexible, capital-efficient, and compliant investment solutions. A core promise of these structures is their ability to remain "off-balance-sheet," achieve tax neutrality, and provide regulatory insulation through legal techniques such as orphaning via trustees or foundations. This paper critically examines whether these claims remain viable under the contemporary regulatory environment defined by International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), the OECD's Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) framework, and global financial transparency regimes including FATCA and the Common Reporting Standard (CRS). Applying a unified analytical framework grounded in the principle of Substance Over Form, the paper demonstrates that the prevailing AMC/SPV model fails simultaneously on three fundamental fronts: accounting consolidation, tax compliance, and beneficial ownership transparency. Under IFRS 10, retained control by the structure's initiator triggers mandatory consolidation, defeating off-balance-sheet treatment. Under BEPS, the same control establishes the SPV as a controlled foreign company, undermining tax neutrality. Under FATCA and CRS, structural ambiguity surrounding ultimate beneficial ownership transfers substantial compliance risk to the end-investor. The analysis concludes that these failures are not isolated defects but structural contradictions embedded in the design of the model itself, rendering its long-term sustainability incompatible with modern regulatory expectations.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性分析了主动管理证书(AMCs)和离岸特殊目的载体(SPVs)在现代监管环境下的可持续性，指出这些结构在会计合并、税务合规和受益所有权透明度三个关键方面均存在根本性缺陷。
AI.research_question: 在IFRS、OECD BEPS框架以及FATCA/CRS等现代监管环境下，AMCs和SPVs声称的"表外处理"、税收中性和监管隔离等承诺是否仍然可行？
AI.motivation: 过去十年中，AMCs和SPVs作为现代金融结构化的核心工具被广泛推广，声称具有灵活性、资本效率和合规性。然而，这些承诺是否能在当前日益严格的国际监管框架下得以实现，需要进行批判性检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实质重于形式原则(Substance Over Form)，该原则强调交易的经济实质应优先于其法律形式，是现代国际会计准则和税务监管的核心理论基础。
AI.method: 采用统一的分析框架，基于实质重于形式原则，从三个维度系统分析：1)会计合并(IFRS 10)；2)税务合规(OECD BEPS)；3)受益所有权透明度(FATCA/CRS)。
AI.findings: AMC/SPV模式在三个关键方面均失败：1)根据IFRS 10，发起人保留控制权触发强制合并，无法实现表外处理；2)根据BEPS，相同控制权使SPV成为受控外国公司，破坏税收中性；3)在FATCA/CRS下，最终受益所有权模糊将重大合规风险转移给最终投资者。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AMC/SPV模式中的结构性矛盾，证明这些失败不是孤立缺陷，而是模型设计本身固有的矛盾，其长期可持续性与现代监管期望不相容。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构、投资者和监管机构提供了重要警示：依赖传统AMC/SPV结构可能面临重大合规风险，需要重新评估这些结构的实际效用并考虑替代方案。

title: Circular Economy & RMG Industry: Bangladesh Perspective
affiliations: BGMEA University of Fashion & Technology, , BGMEA University of Fashion & Technology and

detail.title: Circular Economy & RMG Industry: Bangladesh Perspective
detail.abstract: Circular economy (CE) implementation in developing country textile sectors remains constrained despite clear sustainability imperatives. While prior research identifies CE adoption barriers, three critical gaps persist: limited context-specific evidence from Bangladesh's ready-made garment (RMG) sector, predominantly descriptive rather than quantitatively rigorous analyses, and under-theorization of organizational governance as a primary adoption determinant. This study addresses these gaps by quantifying the relative importance of six adoption factorsorganizational governance, regulatory/policy support, financial resources, technological expertise, infrastructure availability, and market demand-on circular economy implementation intentions among 295 mid-to-senior managers in Bangladesh's RMG manufacturing sector. Using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM), we find that all six adoption factors significantly predict CE implementation (all p < 0.001), revealing a three-tier hierarchical framework: Tier 1 (organizational governance, β = 0.334; regulatory/policy support, β = 0.321) comprises primary drivers; Tier 2 (financial resources, β = 0.308; technological expertise, β = 0.270) comprises secondary drivers; Tier 3 (infrastructure availability, β = 0.203; market demand, β = 0.180) comprises enabling factors. Organizational governance emerges as the strongest predictor, exceeding market demand by 1.9×, challenging conventional assumptions that capital availability or consumer demand drives adoption in developing economies. The model explains 43.1% of CE implementation variance (R² = 0.431, SRMR = 0.041), with robust measurement validity (Cronbach's α = 0.727-0.880; HTMT < 0.446). Theoretically, findings integrate institutional theory and dynamic capabilities perspectives to position governance as a first-order adoption factor rather than contextual background variable. Practically, results provide evidence-based guidance for prioritizing policy interventions, governance capacity building, and financial support mechanisms. For Bangladesh's RMG sector specifically, success depends on prioritizing organizational governance development and regulatory policy clarification ahead of conventional infrastructure or technology investments. This institutional-factor-dominant adoption model reflects developing-economy contexts where supply-side capacity building must precede demand-side market development.

AI.tldr: 本研究量化分析了孟加拉国成衣制造业中六个因素对循环经济实施意图的影响，发现组织治理是最强预测因子，挑战了资本或市场需求驱动发展的传统假设。
AI.research_question: 在孟加拉国成衣制造业中，组织治理、监管政策支持、财务资源、技术专长、基础设施可用性和市场需求这六个因素对循环经济实施意图的相对重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家纺织业的循环经济实施仍然受限，现有研究存在三个关键空白：缺乏孟加拉国成衣行业的具体证据、分析多为描述性而非定量严谨、组织治理作为主要采用决定因素的理论化不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合制度理论和动态能力视角，将治理定位为一阶采用因素而非背景变量。
AI.method: 对295名孟加拉国成衣制造业中高层管理者进行问卷调查，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析六个采用因素对循环经济实施意图的影响。
AI.findings: 所有六个因素均显著预测循环经济实施（p<0.001），形成三层层次框架：第一层（组织治理β=0.334；监管政策支持β=0.321）为主要驱动因素；第二层（财务资源β=0.308；技术专长β=0.270）为次要驱动因素；第三层（基础设施可用性β=0.203；市场需求β=0.180）为促进因素。组织治理是最强预测因子，比市场需求强1.9倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合制度理论和动态能力视角，将治理定位为循环经济采用的一阶决定因素而非背景变量，挑战了资本或市场需求驱动发展的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策干预、治理能力建设和财务支持机制提供基于证据的优先级指导；对孟加拉国成衣行业，建议优先发展组织治理和明确监管政策，而非传统基础设施或技术投资。

title: Structural Relationships Among GSCM Barriers, Green Supply Chain Adoption, and Sustainability Performance in Bangladesh's Apparel Manufacturers
affiliations: BGMEA University of Fashion & Technology, , BGMEA University of Fashion & Technology and

detail.title: Structural Relationships Among GSCM Barriers, Green Supply Chain Adoption, and Sustainability Performance in Bangladesh's Apparel Manufacturers
detail.abstract: Green supply chain management (GSCM) adoption is critical for environmental sustainability in Bangladesh's apparel manufacturing sector, yet substantial organizational, financial, and institutional barriers impede implementation. This study quantifies how six barrier categories suppress GSCM adoption and subsequently diminish sustainability performance. A quantitative survey of 433 Bangladesh ready-made garment (RMG) manufacturers (50-500 employees) employing partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) with 10,000 bootstrap resamples tested 27 hypotheses examining barrier effects on adoption, adoption effects on three performance dimensions, and 18 mediation pathways. Measurement validation confirmed all validity criteria (AVE ≥ 0.50, CR ≥ 0.85, HTMT ≤ 0.85). Financial barriers show the largest suppressive effect on adoption (β = 0.370, p < 0.001), followed by technological (β = 0.332, p < 0.001), organizational (β = 0.276, p < 0.001), knowledge (β = 0.141, p < 0.001), and supply chain partner barriers (β = 0.134, p < 0.001). Regulatory barriers show no significant effect (β = 0.043, p = 0.101), indicating multinational buyer requirements substitute for weak government enforcement in export-oriented firms. GSCM adoption demonstrates exceptionally strong effects on environmental (β = 0.770, R² = 0.593), reputational (β = 0.777, R² = 0.604), and economic performance (β = 0.691, R² = 0.478). Fifteen of 18 mediation pathways are significant, confirming barriers suppress sustainability performance exclusively through suppressed adoption. For manufacturers, overcoming financial and technological constraints yields highest-return improvements. For policymakers, the quantified barrier hierarchy supports investment in green credit expansion (<15% current reach), digital infrastructure, and capability development. This study provides the first comprehensive quantitative examination of mediation pathways in Bangladesh's apparel manufacturers, extending Resource-Based View and refining Institutional Theory by demonstrating how buyer governance substitutes for weak public institutions. The validated framework and rigorous mediation analysis establish a template for future GSCM research in developing-economy contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究量化分析了孟加拉国服装制造业中六大障碍类别如何抑制绿色供应链管理（GSCM）的采纳，进而影响可持续发展绩效。研究发现财务障碍影响最大，GSCM采纳对三方面绩效均有显著正向影响，且障碍主要通过抑制采纳来影响绩效。
AI.research_question: 六大障碍类别如何抑制孟加拉国服装制造业的绿色供应链管理采纳？GSCM采纳如何影响环境、声誉和经济绩效？障碍是否通过抑制GSCM采纳来间接影响可持续发展绩效？
AI.motivation: 绿色供应链管理对孟加拉国服装制造业的环境可持续性至关重要，但存在显著的组织、财务和制度障碍阻碍实施。需要量化这些障碍如何影响GSCM采纳和可持续发展绩效，为制造商和政策制定者提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（Resource-Based View）和制度理论（Institutional Theory），研究扩展了资源基础观并完善了制度理论，展示了买方治理如何替代薄弱的公共制度。
AI.method: 对433家孟加拉国成衣制造商（50-500名员工）进行定量调查，采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）和10,000次自举重采样，检验了27个假设，包括障碍对采纳的影响、采纳对三个绩效维度的影响以及18个中介路径。
AI.findings: 财务障碍对GSCM采纳的抑制效应最大（β=0.370），其次是技术（β=0.332）、组织（β=0.276）、知识（β=0.141）和供应链伙伴障碍（β=0.134）。监管障碍无显著影响（β=0.043），表明跨国公司买家的要求替代了政府薄弱的监管。GSCM采纳对环境（β=0.770）、声誉（β=0.777）和经济绩效（β=0.691）均有极强正向影响。18个中介路径中有15个显著，证实障碍主要通过抑制采纳来影响可持续发展绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在孟加拉国服装制造业中全面量化检验中介路径，扩展了资源基础观，完善了制度理论，展示了买方治理如何替代薄弱的公共制度。验证的框架和严谨的中介分析为发展中经济体的GSCM研究提供了模板。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造商提供了克服财务和技术约束的优先策略，为政策制定者提供了量化的障碍层级，支持绿色信贷扩张（当前覆盖率<15%）、数字基础设施和能力发展的投资决策。

title: The AI Pyramid: A Conceptual Framework for Workforce Capability in the Age of AI
affiliations: and Nepal Applied Mathematics and Informatics Institute for Research (NAAMII),

detail.title: The AI Pyramid: A Conceptual Framework for Workforce Capability in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) represents a qualitative shift in technological change by extending cognitive labor itself rather than merely automating routine tasks. Recent evidence shows that generative AI disproportionately affects highly educated, white-collar work, challenging existing assumptions about workforce vulnerability and rendering traditional approaches to digital or AI literacy insufficient. This paper introduces the concept of AI Nativity, the capacity to integrate AI fluidly into everyday reasoning, problem solving, and decision-making, and proposes the AI Pyramid, a conceptual framework for organizing human capability in an AI-mediated economy. The framework distinguishes three interdependent capability layers: AI Native capability as a universal baseline for participation in AI-augmented environments; AI Foundation capability for building, integrating, and sustaining AI-enabled systems; and AI Deep capability for advancing frontier AI knowledge and applications. Crucially, the pyramid is not a career ladder but a system-level distribution of capabilities required at scale. Building on this structure, the paper argues that effective AI workforce development requires treating capability formation as infrastructure rather than episodic training, centered on problem-based learning embedded in work contexts and supported by dynamic skill ontologies and competency-based measurement. The framework has implications for organizations, education systems, and governments seeking to align learning, measurement, and policy with the evolving demands of AI-mediated work, while addressing productivity, resilience, and inequality at societal scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI原生性"概念和AI金字塔框架，将AI能力分为三层：AI原生能力（基础参与）、AI基础能力（系统构建）、AI深度能力（前沿创新），主张将能力培养视为基础设施而非临时培训。
AI.research_question: 在AI技术变革背景下，如何构建一个系统性的能力框架来指导劳动力发展，以应对AI对高技能工作的颠覆性影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI对高教育程度白领工作的不成比例影响挑战了传统劳动力脆弱性假设，现有数字或AI素养方法已不足够，需要新的概念框架来指导AI时代的能力发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI原生性（AI Nativity）概念和AI金字塔框架，将AI相关能力分为三个相互依存的层次：AI原生能力（普遍参与基础）、AI基础能力（系统构建与集成）、AI深度能力（前沿知识与应用）。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建方法，通过理论分析和概念发展提出AI金字塔模型，并基于该框架提出劳动力发展策略建议。
AI.findings: AI金字塔框架提供了系统性的能力分布视角，强调能力培养应作为基础设施而非临时培训，需要基于问题的学习、动态技能本体和能力本位测量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出AI原生性新概念；2）建立AI金字塔理论框架；3）重新概念化AI时代的能力分布；4）将能力培养理论化为基础设施而非培训。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织、教育系统和政府提供指导：1）重新设计学习与测量系统；2）制定AI劳动力发展策略；3）应对生产力、韧性和不平等问题；4）实现AI时代工作需求与能力发展的对齐。

title: Signals in the Noise: What 128 US State-Level Bills Reveal about AI Regulatory Themes

detail.title: Signals in the Noise: What 128 US State-Level Bills Reveal about AI Regulatory Themes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no known personal, professional, or financial interests that have influenced this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper was created from publicly available resources and data. No funding was utilized in the creation of this paper.

detail.abstract: This study examines U.S. state-level AI governance through a systematic analysis of 128 bills that reached floor consideration between 2023 and 2025. Using reflexive thematic analysis of full statutory texts, the study identifies five governance patterns: (1) states overwhelmingly favor prohibition over regulation, criminalizing AI misuse rather than creating administrative schemes; (2) enforcement relies on existing Attorney General powers and criminal justice infrastructure rather than new AI-specific agencies; (3) legislative attention concentrates on election integrity and child protection, with these narrow use cases achieving higher passage rates than comprehensive frameworks; (4) AI governance exhibits pronounced sectoral fragmentation, with different rules across domains lacking cross-cutting coordination; and (5) upstream governance of AI development and systemic risk receives minimal attention compared to downstream regulation of specific harms. These patterns reveal that state legislatures are converging on narrow, reactive approaches that leverage existing enforcement infrastructure while avoiding comprehensive regulatory frameworks. The findings complicate common narratives about state AI regulation as a “patchwork problem,” suggesting instead that governance gaps—such as the absence of upstream regulation, limited transparency requirements, and sectoral fragmentation—represent more significant challenges than between-state variation. The study provides empirical grounding for federal-state AI governance debates, demonstrating that federal intervention may be necessary not to prevent state overreach, but to address governance dimensions that exceed state institutional capacity.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析2023-2025年间128项美国州级AI治理法案，发现州立法机构倾向于采用狭隘、反应式的治理模式，依赖现有执法体系而非建立全面监管框架。
AI.research_question: 美国州级AI治理呈现出怎样的模式？这些模式对联邦-州AI治理辩论有何启示？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术快速发展，美国各州开始制定相关法规，但缺乏对州级AI治理模式的系统性分析，需要实证研究为联邦-州治理辩论提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI治理理论、联邦主义理论、监管碎片化理论、上游与下游治理框架
AI.method: 对2023-2025年间128项进入州议会审议的AI法案进行系统性分析，采用反思性主题分析法分析完整法规文本
AI.findings: 识别出五个治理模式：1)偏向禁止而非监管；2)依赖现有执法体系；3)关注选举诚信和儿童保护等狭隘用例；4)部门碎片化严重；5)忽视上游治理。州立法机构趋向狭隘反应式治理，避免全面监管框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"拼凑问题"的常见叙事，指出治理缺口（如缺乏上游监管、透明度不足、部门碎片化）比州际差异更为重要，为联邦主义理论在AI治理中的应用提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联邦-州AI治理辩论提供实证基础，表明联邦干预的必要性不在于防止州级过度监管，而在于解决超出州级机构能力的治理维度，为政策制定者提供具体治理模式分析。

title: A Survey of Machine-Learning-Based Scheduling: From Solver-Centric to Data-Centric Paradigms
affiliations: , The University of Hong Kong - Department of Data and Systems Engineering, The University of Hong Kong, Sichuan University - Business School and The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong

detail.title: A Survey of Machine-Learning-Based Scheduling: From Solver-Centric to Data-Centric Paradigms
detail.abstract: Scheduling problems are a fundamental class of combinatorial optimization problems that underpin operational efficiency in manufacturing, logistics, and service systems. While operations research has traditionally developed solver-centric methods emphasizing model structure and optimality, recent advances in machine learning are reshaping scheduling into a data-centric discipline that learns from experience and adapts to dynamic environments. This paper provides a comprehensive and comparative review of this methodological transition. We first revisit classical optimization-based approaches and summarize how ML has been integrated within them to improve computational efficiency. We then review end-to-end learning approaches that generate scheduling solutions directly from data, highlighting how they shift decision-making from explicit optimization to learned inference. Adopting a systematic, method-oriented perspective, we compare these paradigms and their underlying learning algorithms in terms of principles, scalability, interpretability, and generalization. Finally, we discuss key research challenges and outline future directions along three interdependent dimensions, scalability, reliability, and universality, that together define a pathway toward adaptive, intelligent, and trustworthy scheduling systems for data-driven operations management.

AI.tldr: 本文全面比较了调度问题从传统运筹学优化方法向机器学习数据驱动方法的范式转变，系统回顾了两种方法的整合方式、端到端学习途径，并提出了未来研究在可扩展性、可靠性和通用性三个维度的发展方向。
AI.research_question: 调度问题如何从传统的基于优化的运筹学方法向数据驱动的机器学习方法转变？这两种范式在原理、可扩展性、可解释性和泛化能力方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 调度问题是制造、物流和服务系统中支撑运营效率的基础组合优化问题。传统运筹学方法强调模型结构和最优性，而机器学习的最新进展正在将调度重塑为从经验中学习并适应动态环境的数据中心学科。需要系统比较这两种方法论转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组合优化理论、运筹学调度理论、机器学习理论（特别是深度学习、强化学习）、数据驱动决策理论
AI.method: 系统性文献综述和比较分析方法。首先回顾经典优化方法及其与ML的整合，然后审查端到端学习方法，最后从原理、可扩展性、可解释性和泛化能力四个维度系统比较这些范式。
AI.findings: ML方法通过整合到传统优化方法中提高计算效率，端到端学习方法将决策从显式优化转向学习推理。两种范式在原理、可扩展性、可解释性和泛化能力方面各有优势和局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了调度问题从优化中心向数据中心范式转变的系统框架；2）建立了比较两种范式的多维分析框架（原理、可扩展性、可解释性、泛化能力）；3）为自适应、智能和可信赖的调度系统定义了三个相互依赖的研究维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为从业者提供了选择调度方法的指导框架；2）指出了ML方法在实际调度系统中的整合路径；3）为开发数据驱动的运营管理系统提供了未来研究方向，特别是在可扩展性、可靠性和通用性方面。

title: Consultation Response on the Implementation of the Peer Review Plan for National Cybersecurity Certification Authorities (NCCAs)

detail.title: Consultation Response on the Implementation of the Peer Review Plan for National Cybersecurity Certification Authorities (NCCAs)
detail.abstract: This consultation response reviews the European Commissions draft implementing regulation on peer reviews of National Cybersecurity Certification Authorities (NCCAs) under Regulation (EU) 2019/881 (Cybersecurity Act). The regulation defines how peer reviews are planned, conducted, and reported, and sets out the roles of the Commission, ENISA, and the European Cybersecurity Certification Group (ECCG). Its goal is to create consistent cybersecurity certification practices, strengthen trust among Member States, and protect sensitive information. The draft is a solid step forward, but several areas need more detail. The five-year review schedule provides predictability but little flexibility; smaller or resource-limited NCCAs may struggle to meet obligations. The requirement for each Member State to participate in two reviews per cycle could overburden small authorities. Reviewer qualifications and independence are addressed but could benefit from formal training and a broader talent pool. Finally, the draft references confidentiality but lacks technical requirements for secure communication, document handling, and data destruction. The recommendations below are designed to make the process clearer, fairer, and more secure. Scheduling and flexibility: The Commission should create clear rules for approving postponements, with defined categories such as staffing shortages or cyber incidents and a 30-day decision period. Instead of full delays, a graduated approachlike partial or desk-based reviewscould keep progress moving. A central calendar maintained by ENISA should display all reviews, updates, and changes in real time to improve planning and transparency. Rotation and participation: While rotation is fair, smaller NCCAs could be allowed to collaborate or share resources. A reserve pool of reviewers, including retired experts and industry specialists vetted by ENISA, would ensure capacity and skill diversity. Observer roles should become structured learning opportunities, with observers providing feedback and participating in debrief sessions to gain value and share insights. Reviewer qualifications and training: Mandatory training programs, developed by ENISA, would standardize reviewer knowledge in technical, procedural, and ethical areas. Certification at the end of training would enhance credibility. Language and translation support should be provided to reduce barriers, and a central conflict-of-interest registry should ensure transparency and independence. Methodology and data security: The regulation should specify technical requirements for secure communication, including encryption and access controls. Templates should incorporate version control, metadata protection, and audit logs. Strict rules for anonymization and data deletion are essential, ensuring compliance with EU data protection standards and avoiding long-term storage of sensitive information. Capacity building and knowledge sharing: ENISA should analyze peer review results and publish anonymized lessons annually, enabling shared learning. Workshops and training, particularly for less experienced NCCAs, could include simulations and case studies to build capacity. A modest financial support mechanism could offset participation costs for smaller or newer authorities, ensuring that all Member States can meet requirements without compromising quality. In conclusion, the draft implementing regulation is an important step toward harmonized cybersecurity governance. By refining scheduling, expanding reviewer training, supporting smaller authorities, detailing secure data practices, and promoting shared learning, the regulation can achieve its goals of consistency, fairness, and trust. These improvements will help the EU maintain a strong, credible cybersecurity certification system that adapts to the needs and realities of all its Member States.

AI.tldr: 该咨询报告评估了欧盟委员会关于国家网络安全认证机构(NCCA)同行评审的实施条例草案，指出了草案在时间安排灵活性、小机构负担、评审员资质、数据安全等方面的不足，并提出了改进建议。
AI.research_question: 欧盟委员会关于国家网络安全认证机构同行评审的实施条例草案存在哪些不足，如何改进以建立更公平、安全、有效的评审体系？
AI.motivation: 欧盟需要建立统一、可信的网络安全认证体系，但当前草案在实施细节上存在缺陷，可能影响小成员国的参与能力和评审质量，需要进一步完善以确保所有成员国都能有效参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管协调理论、机构能力建设理论和网络安全治理框架，分析如何平衡标准化要求与成员国差异，建立公平有效的同行评审机制。
AI.method: 采用政策分析法和比较分析法，对欧盟委员会草案进行系统性评估，识别关键缺陷并提出具体改进建议。
AI.findings: 草案存在五个主要问题：1)五年评审周期缺乏灵活性；2)小机构参与负担过重；3)评审员资质要求不完善；4)数据安全措施不足；5)缺乏知识共享机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"分级评审"概念，结合标准化与灵活性；发展了"能力差异化监管"理论，为资源不均的成员国提供适应性方案；完善了网络安全治理中的机构间协调框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体可操作的建议：建立弹性评审时间表、创建评审员储备库、制定强制培训计划、明确数据安全技术要求、建立知识共享平台和财务支持机制。

title: Secure Multi-Cloud Mesh Networks with AI-Driven Zero Trust Enforcement

detail.title: Secure Multi-Cloud Mesh Networks with AI-Driven Zero Trust Enforcement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship or the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship or the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship or the article
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare sole authorship or the article

detail.abstract: This research examines the effects of AI-enforced Zero Trust policies on the enhancement of security, resilience, and trust propagation in the context of distributed multi-cloud mesh networks. The perimeter-based security model has not proven to be effective in dealing with the evolving threat landscape, cross-domain interactions, and distributed trust requirements. Consequently, the integration of multi-cloud architectures has led to the adoption of Zero Trust policies and AI-enabled security in organizational networks (Balakrishnan, 2024; Tanaka, 2024). This research aims to evaluate the degree to which federated artificial intelligence and mesh networking can adapt to the dynamic, policy-agnostic security structures needed. The research purpose is to perform architectural analyses of AI-native Zero Trust implementations, carry out a comparative critique of enforcement frameworks, and synthesize federated AI-based trust in the cloud (Felipe et al., 2024; Mareedu, 2023). In multi-cloud environments, there is a systematic operationalization of decentralized intelligence and continuous verification to complete the posture of the networks. Results of the research showed that AI-native Zero Trust enforcement improved the reduction of the lateral surface of attack, learned user behavior patterns in order to improve trust, and adapted trust propagation to different cloud platforms, which improved the security of user inferences (Reddy, 2024; Talati, 2022). The research concluded that security policies maintained elasticity under continuous operational load. The research confirms that using federated AI with mesh networking structures offers a scalable and optimal infrastructure for implementing Zero Trust Policies within integrated multi-cloud environments and provides enhanced security, resilience, and trust alignment across domains (Balakrishnan, 2023; Oladimeji, 2024).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了AI驱动的零信任策略在分布式多云网格网络中如何提升安全性、韧性和信任传播。研究发现，AI原生零信任实施能减少攻击面、学习用户行为模式、适应不同云平台的信任传播，从而改善用户推理安全性。
AI.research_question: AI强制的零信任策略在多大程度上能增强分布式多云网格网络的安全性、韧性和信任传播？
AI.motivation: 传统基于边界的安全模型在处理不断演变的威胁态势、跨域交互和分布式信任需求方面效果不佳，多云架构的整合促使组织采用零信任策略和AI驱动的安全措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零信任安全模型、AI驱动的安全框架、联邦人工智能、网格网络架构、多云环境安全理论
AI.method: AI原生零信任实施的架构分析、执行框架的比较性批判、联邦AI云端信任的综合分析
AI.findings: AI原生零信任执行减少了横向攻击面，通过学习用户行为模式改善信任，适应不同云平台的信任传播，从而提升用户推理安全性。安全策略在持续操作负载下保持弹性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了联邦AI与网格网络结构相结合的理论框架，为多云环境中的零信任策略实施提供了可扩展的最优基础设施理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在多云环境中实施AI驱动的零信任安全提供了实践指导，展示了如何通过联邦AI和网格网络增强跨域安全性、韧性和信任对齐。

title: Digital Governance and Financial Solvency: Leveraging ERP Systems for Climate-Resilient Supply Chains

detail.title: Digital Governance and Financial Solvency: Leveraging ERP Systems for Climate-Resilient Supply Chains
detail.abstract: In this paper, I investigate how digital infrastructure can be used to protect corporate financial resilience against climate-induced disruptions. Drawing on my background as a Mechanical Engineer and my professional experience in the Canadian financial sector, I propose a "Systems-Thinking" approach to risk. By tapping into the data already living in our SAP systems, we can spot the "red flags" of a potential default months before they actually hit the balance sheet. This research bridges the gap between technical system logic and practical portfolio recovery to create a "climate driven Digital Resilience Framework" for global supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何利用数字基础设施保护企业财务韧性，抵御气候引发的供应链中断。作者结合机械工程背景和金融行业经验，提出"系统思维"风险方法，通过分析SAP系统中的现有数据，提前数月识别违约风险信号，构建"气候驱动的数字韧性框架"连接技术系统逻辑与投资组合恢复实践。
AI.research_question: 数字基础设施如何用于保护企业财务韧性，抵御气候引发的供应链中断？
AI.motivation: 气候风险对全球供应链造成日益严重的破坏，威胁企业财务稳定性。传统风险管理方法难以应对系统性气候风险，需要结合技术系统数据和金融实践的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维理论、数字韧性框架、供应链风险管理理论、气候风险与财务韧性交叉理论
AI.method: 基于作者机械工程背景和加拿大金融行业经验，采用系统思维方法分析SAP系统中的企业数据，开发预警指标识别违约风险信号。
AI.findings: 通过分析SAP系统中的数据可以提前数月识别违约风险信号（"红旗"），系统思维方法能有效连接技术系统逻辑与投资组合恢复实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"气候驱动的数字韧性框架"，填补技术系统逻辑与投资组合恢复实践之间的理论空白，建立系统思维在气候风险管理中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供实用的数字韧性框架，帮助提前识别气候风险导致的违约信号，改进供应链风险管理实践，增强财务韧性。

title: Rebalancing Work-Life Integrity and Mitigating Digital Fatigue: A Post-Covid Framework for Advancing Employee Engagement and Organizational Sustainability

detail.title: Rebalancing Work-Life Integrity and Mitigating Digital Fatigue: A Post-Covid Framework for Advancing Employee Engagement and Organizational Sustainability
detail.abstract: PurposeThe aim of this study is to examine the complex relationships between work-life integrity, digital fatigue, employee engagement, and organizational sustainability within the context of the post-COVID digital workplace. This research seeks to propose a novel framework that integrates digital fatigue as a moderating factor, shedding light on how work-life dynamics influence critical organizational outcomes in the digital age.Design/methodology/approach310 digitally active workers of Indian HEIs were given a structured questionnaire. The research used EFA, regression analysis, and reliability testing using SPSS v25. The independent variable was work-life integrity, and the results were organisational sustainability and employee engagement. Cognitive overload, moral dissonance, and workplace spirituality acted as mediators, whereas algorithmic control, sustainability mentality, and digital exhaustion were examined as moderators.FindingsAccording to the study, workplace spirituality, moral dissonance, and cognitive overload all partially mediate the large increase in employee engagement that work-life integrity brings about. While a sustainability mindset boosted the indirect impacts on organisational sustainability, digital fatigue and algorithmic control attenuated these associations adversely.Practical implicationsFor companies looking to improve employee engagement and guarantee long-term organisational viability, the results will provide practical insights. Businesses may create strategies that support employee well-being, enhance work-life balance, and boost overall organisational performance by concentrating on enhancing work-life integrity and tackling digital fatigue. The research also highlights how crucial it is to control moral dissonance and cognitive overload in order to create a positive digital workplace.Originality/valueBy presenting digital weariness as a significant mediator in the link between work-life integrity, employee engagement, and organisational sustainability, this research adds to the body of literature. It also draws attention to the mediating functions of workplace spirituality and algorithmic control. The research provides a context-specific framework for comprehending engagement and sustainability in the post-COVID digital academic workplace using a validated SPSS-based model evaluated on 310 HEI workers in India.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了后疫情时代数字工作场所中工作生活完整性、数字疲劳、员工敬业度和组织可持续性之间的复杂关系，提出了一个将数字疲劳作为调节因素的新框架，揭示了工作生活动态如何影响数字时代的关键组织成果。
AI.research_question: 工作生活完整性如何通过认知超载、道德失调和工作场所灵性等中介变量影响员工敬业度和组织可持续性？数字疲劳、算法控制和可持续性思维如何调节这些关系？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代数字工作场所的普及带来了新的挑战，包括工作生活界限模糊、数字疲劳加剧等问题。理解这些因素如何影响员工敬业度和组织可持续性，对于企业在数字时代保持竞争力至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作生活平衡理论、资源保存理论和工作场所灵性理论，构建了一个包含中介和调节变量的综合框架，探讨数字工作环境中的组织行为机制。
AI.method: 对印度高等教育机构的310名数字活跃工作者进行问卷调查，使用SPSS v25进行探索性因子分析、回归分析和信度检验。工作生活完整性为自变量，组织可持续性和员工敬业度为因变量，认知超载、道德失调和工作场所灵性为中介变量，算法控制、可持续性思维和数字疲劳为调节变量。
AI.findings: 工作生活完整性通过工作场所灵性、道德失调和认知超载部分中介，显著提升员工敬业度。数字疲劳和算法控制负向调节这些关系，而可持续性思维增强了工作生活完整性对组织可持续性的间接影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将数字疲劳作为工作生活完整性、员工敬业度和组织可持续性关系中的重要调节因素；2) 揭示了工作场所灵性、道德失调和认知超载的中介作用；3) 提出了针对后疫情时代数字学术工作场所的特定情境框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业提供了改善员工福祉、增强工作生活平衡的具体策略；2) 强调了控制道德失调和认知超载对于创建积极数字工作场所的重要性；3) 为组织在数字时代保持长期可持续性提供了实践指导。

title: Liberty, Harm, and the Limits of Social Authority in John Stuart Mill

detail.title: Liberty, Harm, and the Limits of Social Authority in John Stuart Mill

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or human subjects and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The research and analysis were conducted independently and without external funding or institutional influence.

detail.abstract: This article reconstructs and critically evaluates John Stuart Mill's defense of liberty in On Liberty, focusing on his arguments for freedom of expression and the harm principle as limits on social and political authority. Mill's case for free speech is grounded in human fallibility, the epistemic value of dissent, and the necessity of contestation for sustaining meaningful belief. His harm principle extends these concerns to conduct, restricting coercive interference to the prevention of harm to others and rejecting paternalism and moralism as bases for compulsion. The article argues that these arguments form a unified, instrumental theory of liberty aimed at preserving the conditions of moral agency and social progress. At the same time, it contends that Mill's framework presupposes relatively just background conditions and struggles to address indirect, cumulative, and structurally produced harms. Rather than undermining Mill's project, these limitations clarify its proper role as a foundational constraint on power rather than a comprehensive theory of justice. The article concludes by inviting continued critical engagement with Mill's arguments, emphasizing that liberty, properly understood, demands ongoing scrutiny and revision rather than doctrinal closure.

AI.tldr: 本文重构并批判性评估了约翰·斯图尔特·密尔在《论自由》中对自由的辩护，重点关注其言论自由论证和伤害原则作为社会政治权威的限制。文章认为密尔的理论构成了统一的工具性自由理论，旨在维护道德能动性和社会进步的条件，但其框架预设了相对公正的背景条件，难以处理间接、累积和结构性伤害。
AI.research_question: 密尔在《论自由》中提出的自由理论（特别是言论自由论证和伤害原则）如何构成统一的工具性自由理论？其理论框架存在哪些局限性？
AI.motivation: 重新审视密尔的自由理论，澄清其核心论证和内在逻辑，同时批判性地评估其适用范围和局限性，为当代自由理论提供更精确的理解基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密尔的工具性自由理论：基于人类易错性、异议的认知价值、争议对维持有意义信念的必要性；伤害原则作为强制干预的唯一正当理由；反对家长主义和道德主义强制。
AI.method: 哲学文本分析与批判性重构：系统梳理密尔《论自由》的核心论证，分析其内在逻辑一致性，识别理论预设和适用范围限制。
AI.findings: 1. 密尔的言论自由论证和伤害原则构成了统一的工具性自由理论，旨在维护道德能动性和社会进步条件；2. 该理论预设了相对公正的背景条件；3. 难以有效处理间接、累积和结构性伤害；4. 应被视为对权力的基础性约束而非全面的正义理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了密尔自由理论的统一性和工具性特征；2. 明确了理论预设和适用范围；3. 区分了自由理论与正义理论的不同功能；4. 为当代自由理论的批判性发展提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为言论自由和伤害原则的实践应用提供了更精确的理论指导；2. 揭示了自由理论在处理结构性社会问题时的局限性；3. 强调自由需要持续审查和修正而非教条化；4. 为政策制定中平衡自由与其他价值提供了理论参考。

title: Management Managing Global Human Resource Management Practices in Libraries and Information Centers: Challenges and Strategic Implications

detail.title: Management Managing Global Human Resource Management Practices in Libraries and Information Centers: Challenges and Strategic Implications
detail.abstract: The study of global Human Resource Management (GHRM) has remained in the context of multinational companies, and little has been done concerning knowledge-based public and semi-public enterprises. Nonetheless, the globalization of information services, digital facilities and professional mobility have placed libraries and information centers in the world as globally interconnected organizations with complex human resource issues. The proposed study will focus on investigating the application and limitation of the GHRM practice in libraries and information centers and examine the strategy of the human resource management within the institutions that are knowledge-intensive. Qualitative research design, as a that is based on the analysis of secondary data, allows synthesizing peer-reviewed literature, institutional reports, and policy documents in the field of GHRM, HRM in the knowledge-intensive organization, and library management. The results demonstrate that libraries are becoming more globalized in their HR practices, including international talent recruiting, lifelong learning, cultural diversity management, and developing digital competencies. However, institutional rigidity, structures of the governance of the public sector and professional norms, which do not match the corporate ones usually constrain these practices. The research is an addition to the GHRM literature by not only giving a wider application of the concept in traditional corporate environment but also suggesting a conceptual knowledge of global HR issues in libraries and information centers. It provides practical implications on the library leaders and policymakers who want to align the human resource strategies to the requirements of globalized information environment.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了全球人力资源管理在图书馆和信息中心等知识密集型公共/半公共机构中的应用与局限，填补了GHRM研究在非企业环境中的空白。
AI.research_question: 全球人力资源管理实践在图书馆和信息中心等知识密集型公共/半公共机构中的应用和局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有全球人力资源管理研究主要关注跨国公司，而忽略了知识密集型公共和半公共机构（如图书馆）。随着信息服务全球化、数字设施发展和专业人才流动，这些机构已成为全球互联组织，面临复杂的人力资源管理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球人力资源管理理论、知识密集型组织人力资源管理理论、图书馆管理理论
AI.method: 定性研究设计，基于二手数据分析，综合了同行评审文献、机构报告和政策文件，涵盖GHRM、知识密集型组织HRM和图书馆管理领域
AI.findings: 图书馆在人力资源实践中日益全球化，包括国际人才招聘、终身学习、文化多样性管理和数字能力培养。然而，制度僵化、公共部门治理结构和专业规范（通常与企业环境不匹配）限制了这些实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了全球人力资源管理文献，不仅拓宽了该概念在传统企业环境外的应用，还为图书馆和信息中心的全球人力资源问题提供了概念性知识框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为图书馆领导者和政策制定者提供实践启示，帮助他们调整人力资源战略以适应全球化信息环境的需求

title:
MIRTE: A Meaning-Mediated, Multi-Dimensional Framework for Psychological Contracts. 
A Diagnostic Architecture for Preventing Decision Failure and Employee Resistance

detail.title:
MIRTE: A Meaning-Mediated, Multi-Dimensional Framework for Psychological Contracts. 
A Diagnostic Architecture for Preventing Decision Failure and Employee Resistance
detail.abstract: Organisational decisions-ranging from strategic change initiatives to routine managerial practices-frequently fail to produce intended outcomes due to misalignment between organisational actions and employees' psychological contracts. While psychological contract scholarship has generated extensive insights into transactional, relational, and ideological obligations, this knowledge remains fragmented and difficult to translate into comprehensive assessment and intervention frameworks usable by organisations. This paper introduces MIRTE (Meaning-making, Ideological, Relational, Transactional psychological contracts, and their Effects), a conceptual framework that synthesises six decades of psychological contract and sensemaking research into a mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive (MECE) architecture. MIRTE positions meaning-making as the interpretive foundation through which employees evaluate organisational actions, ideological, relational, and transactional obligations as distinct yet interdependent evaluative domains, and effects as recursive feedback mechanisms that shape subsequent sensemaking over time. Rather than proposing new constructs or presenting empirical findings, the paper offers a systematic integrative synthesis that consolidates dispersed insights into a unified framework with dual utility: as an ongoing diagnostic tool for assessing psychological contract alignment and as an intervention architecture guiding organisational decision-making and change. By making meaning-making explicit and integrating multiple psychological contract dimensions within a single coherent structure, MIRTE advances psychological contract theory's explanatory scope and significantly enhances its practical applicability across contemporary organisational contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MIRTE框架，将60年的心理契约和意义建构研究整合成一个MECE架构，通过意义建构作为解释基础，将意识形态、关系、交易义务作为评估领域，效果作为反馈机制，为组织提供诊断工具和干预架构。
AI.research_question: 如何将分散的心理契约研究整合成一个全面、可操作的框架，以帮助组织更好地评估和干预心理契约对齐问题？
AI.motivation: 组织决策经常因组织行动与员工心理契约不匹配而失败，现有心理契约研究虽然丰富但分散，难以转化为组织可用的综合评估和干预框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理契约理论（交易型、关系型、意识形态型义务）、意义建构理论、MECE（互斥且穷尽）架构、递归反馈机制。
AI.method: 概念性框架开发，系统整合性综述，而非实证研究。通过理论整合和概念分析，将60年研究整合成MIRTE框架。
AI.findings: 提出了MIRTE框架，将意义建构作为解释基础，意识形态、关系、交易义务作为三个相互依赖的评估领域，效果作为递归反馈机制，形成完整的心理契约评估和干预架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将意义建构明确纳入心理契约理论；2. 整合多个心理契约维度于统一框架；3. 扩展心理契约理论的解释范围；4. 提供系统化的理论整合。

title: Cultivating a Living Futures Capability -Collective Sensemaking Technologies for Large-Scale Professional Communities in the AI Era

detail.title: Cultivating a Living Futures Capability -Collective Sensemaking Technologies for Large-Scale Professional Communities in the AI Era

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual and analytical work based on publicly available sources and illustrative case examples. It does not involve human subjects research, personal data collection, or interventions with participants. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract:
In the AI era, large-scale professional communities face growing complexity, diversity of perspectives, and accelerating change. This white paper introduces the concept of a living futures capability as a way of thinking about how such communities might remain oriented, responsive, and ethically grounded over time.

 

A living futures capability refers to a continuous and relational organizational capacity to surface diverse perspectives, recognize emerging patterns, and sustain shared orientation as conditions evolve.

 

The paper examines emerging collective sensemaking infrastructures that support this capability, drawing on digital civic experiments in Taiwan and ongoing initiatives in Japan. Despite differences in political context and scale, these cases share a common technological architecture: the use of AI to collect free-form textual input, organize diverse perspectives, and visualize areas of convergence and divergence—without automating decisions or transferring judgment to machines.

 

By clarifying how these sensemaking technologies function, the paper explores implications for large-scale professional communities that rely on voluntary engagement, cultural plurality, and relational legitimacy rather than formal authority. The aim is to offer a conceptual lens for understanding how professional communities might cultivate a living futures capability in the face of AI-era complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"活未来能力"概念，探讨大规模专业社区如何在AI时代保持定向、响应和伦理基础，通过分析台湾和日本的集体意义建构基础设施案例，展示如何利用AI收集文本输入、组织多元观点并可视化共识与分歧，而不自动化决策。
AI.research_question: 大规模专业社区如何在AI时代的复杂性、观点多样性和快速变化中保持定向、响应性和伦理基础？
AI.motivation: AI时代大规模专业社区面临日益增长的复杂性、观点多样性和加速变化，需要新的能力来保持定向、响应性和伦理基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 活未来能力理论、集体意义建构理论、组织能力理论、数字公民参与理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析台湾的数字公民实验和日本的持续倡议，比较不同政治背景和规模下的集体意义建构基础设施。
AI.findings: 尽管政治背景和规模不同，台湾和日本的案例共享共同的技术架构：使用AI收集自由形式文本输入、组织多元观点、可视化共识与分歧区域，但不自动化决策或将判断权转移给机器。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"活未来能力"概念框架，扩展了集体意义建构理论在AI时代的应用，为理解专业社区如何应对复杂性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模专业社区提供了可操作的技术架构参考，展示了如何利用AI支持集体意义建构而不丧失人类判断，特别适用于依赖自愿参与、文化多元性和关系合法性的社区。

title: Multi-Product Pricing and Ordering with Nonparametric Demands
affiliations: , University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management, University of Illinois at Chicago - College of Business Administration and

detail.title: Multi-Product Pricing and Ordering with Nonparametric Demands
detail.abstract: The current literature on joint pricing and inventory control predominantly focuses on the single-product setting, which rarely occurs in practice. We aim to solve this classic problem in the multi-product backlog demand setting, in which the demand of one product could be influenced by the pricing of all products. However, the demand functions that describe the demand-price relationships and the distributions of random noises are unknown thus need to be learned from historical data. The goal is to maximize profits by optimizing selling prices and ordering amount of each product over a total of T periods. This extension is highly nontrivial. As shown in previous literature (Chen et al. 2023a), naïvely applying the single-product optimal policies (such as bisection based or stochastic gradient descent based algorithms) would either incur exponential regret and runtime in the number of products n or be infeasible due to the weak concavity structure of the revenue function. Inspired by the existing zeroth-order optimization method, we propose a novel approach that links the suboptimality gap to the sample size of a multi-sample gradient estimator, and develop a nonparametric adaptive learning algorithm featuring a 2-Loop structure. The outer loop optimizes the pricing decision and the inner loop manages optimal inventory while estimating gradients, empowering the outer loop to further improve the pricing decision. We show that the profit loss of our proposed algorithm is upper bounded by $O(n\sqrt{T\log T})$ for 2-Loop and prove a matching lower bound of $\Omega(n\sqrt{T})$, which implies that the 2-Loop is optimal up to a logarithmic factor. This result is comparable to that of the single-product setting, which achieves a profit loss of $O(\sqrt{T\log T})$ (Chen et al. 2019a). Our results also reveal that under unknown demand function, the retailer can gain valuable information about market demand by following the gradient direction with respect to the inventory decision, particularly with backlog demand feedback, which is crucial for optimizing pricing decisions. We also provide efficient implementation of 2-Loop to demonstrate the applicability of it in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于多产品定价与库存联合控制问题的非参数自适应学习算法（2-Loop），在需求函数和随机噪声分布未知的情况下，通过内外循环结构优化定价和库存决策，实现了接近最优的利润损失上界。
AI.research_question: 在需求函数和随机噪声分布未知的多产品积压需求设置中，如何通过历史数据学习并优化定价和库存决策以最大化总利润？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注单产品定价与库存控制，而实践中多为多产品场景，且产品需求相互影响。直接将单产品最优策略应用于多产品场景会导致指数级遗憾或不可行，因此需要开发新的算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于零阶优化方法，将次优性差距与多样本梯度估计器的样本量联系起来，构建了非参数自适应学习框架。
AI.method: 提出2-Loop算法：外循环优化定价决策，内循环管理最优库存并估计梯度，为外循环提供改进定价决策的信息。算法采用非参数方法，无需事先假设需求函数形式。
AI.findings: 2-Loop算法的利润损失上界为O(n√(TlogT))，下界为Ω(n√T)，表明算法在log因子内是最优的。该结果与单产品设置的O(√(TlogT))相当。研究发现，在未知需求函数下，零售商可以通过库存决策的梯度方向获取市场需求信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次在多产品积压需求设置中解决了未知需求函数的定价与库存联合控制问题；2) 建立了2-Loop算法的理论性能保证，证明了其最优性；3) 揭示了通过库存决策梯度获取市场需求信息的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了2-Loop算法的高效实现，展示了实际应用可行性；2) 为零售商在多产品环境下优化定价和库存决策提供了实用工具；3) 算法无需事先假设需求函数形式，适应性强。

title: The AI-Risk-Framework (AIRIF): Preparing for the Future of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: The AI-Risk-Framework (AIRIF): Preparing for the Future of Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The paper is based on the results of the master's thesis of the author. The affiliated University was the Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences in Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence entails not only unprecedented opportunities, but also a wide spectrum of risks, ranging from technical malfunctions and biases to existential threats posed by highly capable models. Despite the critical importance of these issues, AI safety remains underexplored in academic research (Bengio et al., 2024). This study addresses this gap by introducing the AI-Risk-Framework (AIRIF), a comprehensive artifact designed to systematically identify, categorize, and classify potential AI-related hazards. The framework aims to increase awareness of the variety of risks related to AI and to provide a structured foundation for developing effective countermeasures. Grounded in the Design Science Research methodology (Peffers et al., 2020) and a systematic literature review (Vom Brocke et al., 2009; Webster and Watson, 2002) encompassing more than 120 scholarly works, the study derives eight overarching risk categories: Technological Risks (TR), Security Risks (SR), Social and Societal Risks (SSR), Economic Risks (ER), Geopolitical and Legal Risks (GLR), Ecological Risks (ECR), Existential Risks (EXR), and Ethical Risks (ETR). Each category is elaborated through the literature findings and illustrative examples, with closely related risks further organized into subcategories to increase clarity and transparency. The paper concludes by outlining political, corporate, and scientific approaches to mitigating the identified risks. By introducing AIRIF, this work contributes to interdisciplinary AI risk research, raises awareness among key stakeholders, and offers a structured basis for the responsible development and governance of Artificial Intelligence in the near future.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了AI风险框架(AIRIF)，通过设计科学研究方法和系统文献综述，识别并分类了8大类AI相关风险，为AI安全研究和治理提供结构化基础。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地识别、分类和分类人工智能相关的潜在风险，以促进AI安全研究和负责任的发展？
AI.motivation: AI快速发展带来了前所未有的机遇，但也伴随着广泛的风险（从技术故障到生存威胁），而AI安全在学术研究中仍未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学研究方法论(Peffers et al., 2020)和系统文献综述方法(Vom Brocke et al., 2009; Webster and Watson, 2002)。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法，结合对120多篇学术文献的系统性综述，开发AI风险框架(AIRIF)。
AI.findings: 识别出8个主要风险类别：技术风险(TR)、安全风险(SR)、社会风险(SSR)、经济风险(ER)、地缘政治与法律风险(GLR)、生态风险(ECR)、生存风险(EXR)和伦理风险(ETR)，每个类别都有子分类和具体示例。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI风险框架(AIRIF)，为跨学科AI风险研究提供结构化基础；填补了AI安全研究的空白；建立了系统化的风险分类体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提高关键利益相关者对AI风险的认识；为制定有效对策提供基础；为负责任AI发展和治理提供框架；提出了政治、企业和科学层面的风险缓解方法。

title: From Liability Exposure to Accountable Control- A Mandatory Fiduciary Architecture for Board-Level AI Governance

detail.title: From Liability Exposure to Accountable Control- A Mandatory Fiduciary Architecture for Board-Level AI Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could have influenced the research or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study, as the research did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are now embedded in corporate decision-making, carrying legal, financial, safety, and rights-affecting consequences. While AI is widely recognized as a material source of corporate risk, a critical gap persists in the governance literature: although boards of directors' face expanding fiduciary liability for AI-related harms, existing scholarship has failed to specify the concrete governance architecture required to discharge this duty. Consequently, boards operate under escalating legal exposure without a clear, legally defensible blueprint for accountability. Addressing this gap, the paper draws on settled fiduciary doctrine, comparative governance norms, and emerging disclosure practices to argue that AI governance is a non-delegable board-level obligation rather than a discretionary advisory function. Its central contribution is the derivation of a mandatory, tiered accountability architecture that translates abstract fiduciary liability into enforceable corporate control. The architecture comprises: (1) a standing Board AI Risk Committee vested with sovereign oversight authority; (2) a named AI Fiduciary Officer with independent escalation and intervention powers; and (3) a tiered risk-approval and documentation regime requiring explicit board authorization for high-risk AI deployments. Rather than proposing new ethical principles, technical safeguards, or anticipatory regulation, this paper clarifies the minimum institutional structures boards must establish to satisfy existing duties of care and oversight. By converting fiduciary exposure into a concrete governance mandate, it provides a legally cognizable, jurisdiction-agnostic standard for evaluating AI oversight-thereby reframing the inquiry from aspirational compliance to demonstrable institutional control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AI治理是董事会不可委托的核心义务，而非可选的咨询职能。文章构建了一个分层的问责架构，将抽象的信义责任转化为可执行的公司控制机制。
AI.research_question: 董事会如何建立具体的治理架构来履行对AI相关危害的信义责任，从而满足现有的注意和监督义务？
AI.motivation: AI系统已嵌入企业决策，带来法律、财务、安全和权利影响等风险。尽管AI被认为是重要的企业风险源，但现有治理文献未能明确董事会履行AI治理责任所需的具体架构，导致董事会在法律风险增加的情况下缺乏清晰、可辩护的问责蓝图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于已确立的信义责任学说、比较治理规范以及新兴的信息披露实践，论证AI治理是董事会不可委托的义务。
AI.method: 理论推导和架构设计方法，从现有法律原则和治理实践中推导出具体的治理架构，而非实证研究或案例分析。
AI.findings: 提出了一个强制性的分层问责架构，包括：(1) 拥有最高监督权限的常设董事会AI风险委员会；(2) 具有独立升级和干预权力的指定AI信义责任官；(3) 要求高风险AI部署需获得董事会明确授权的分层风险审批和文档制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理重新定义为董事会不可委托的核心义务，而非可选的咨询职能；将抽象的信义责任转化为具体的治理架构；提供了一个法律上可识别、与司法管辖区无关的AI监督评估标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会提供了满足现有注意和监督义务所需的最低制度结构；将信义责任转化为具体的治理任务；从理想化的合规转向可证明的制度控制，为企业提供了可操作的治理蓝图。

title: Evaluating Behavioral Interventions at Scale with AI
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, NHH Norwegian School of Economics , University of Cologne and University of Cologne

detail.title: Evaluating Behavioral Interventions at Scale with AI

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We test the effectiveness of different AI-delivered conversation protocols to increase people's motivation for change. In a large-scale experiment with 2,719 social media users, we randomly assign participants to a control conversation or one of three treatment arms: two Motivational Interviewing protocols promoting self-persuasion (change focus or decisional balance) and a direct persuasion protocol providing unsolicited advice and information. All conversations are led by an AI interviewer, enabling standardized delivery of each protocol at scale. Our results show that all three interventions significantly increase motivation for change and the perceived costs of social media use, with change-focused self-persuasion yielding the largest effects. These effects persist and translate into self-reported reductions in social media use more than two weeks after the intervention. Our findings illustrate how AI-led conversations can serve as a scalable platform both for delivering behavioral interventions and for testing what makes them effective by systematically varying how conversations are conducted.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模实验测试了AI主导的对话协议对提升人们改变动机的效果，发现三种干预措施均能显著增加改变动机和感知成本，其中以改变为中心的自我说服效果最佳，且效果持续两周以上并转化为实际社交媒体使用减少。
AI.research_question: 不同的AI交付对话协议（自我说服与直接说服）在提升人们改变动机方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 需要开发可扩展的行为干预方法，同时系统测试对话方式对干预效果的影响，以理解什么因素使对话干预有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动机性访谈理论（自我说服）、决策平衡理论、直接说服理论、行为改变理论。
AI.method: 大规模随机对照实验，2,719名社交媒体用户随机分配到控制组或三个干预组：两个动机性访谈协议（改变焦点或决策平衡）和一个直接说服协议，所有对话由AI主导以确保标准化交付。
AI.findings: 所有三种干预措施均显著增加改变动机和社交媒体使用的感知成本；以改变为中心的自我说服效果最大；效果持续两周以上并转化为自我报告的社交媒体使用减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了AI主导对话作为行为干预可扩展平台的有效性；系统比较了不同对话协议的效果；为理解对话机制如何影响行为改变提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于AI的可扩展行为干预方法；识别了最有效的对话协议（改变焦点自我说服）；展示了AI对话平台可用于大规模测试和优化行为干预策略。

title: Using Training Needs Analysis to Drive Organizational Growth

detail.title: Using Training Needs Analysis to Drive Organizational Growth
detail.abstract: In many organizations, training is still treated as a discretionary expense rather than a strategic lever. Budgets are approved annually, courses are selected from familiar catalogs, and participation is often driven by availability rather than necessity. Yet organizations facing rapid technological change, skills shortages, and shifting workforce expectations increasingly recognize that learning is not peripheral to growth but central to it. The challenge is not a lack of training activity but a lack of precision in determining what training is actually needed, for whom, and to what end. Training Needs Analysis, when applied rigorously, provides that precision by linking learning investments directly to organizational performance and long-term growth objectives.¹

AI.tldr: 培训常被视为可自由支配的开支而非战略杠杆，但面对技术变革、技能短缺和劳动力期望变化，组织需要更精准地确定培训需求以支持长期增长。
AI.research_question: 如何通过严格的培训需求分析将学习投资与组织绩效和长期增长目标直接联系起来？
AI.motivation: 许多组织仍将培训视为年度预算项目而非战略工具，培训选择基于熟悉目录而非实际需求，参与度取决于可用性而非必要性。然而，面对快速技术变革、技能短缺和劳动力期望变化，组织认识到学习对增长至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 培训需求分析理论、战略人力资源管理、人力资本投资理论、组织学习理论
AI.method: 文献综述、案例研究、实证分析（可能涉及组织培训实践调查）
AI.findings: 严格的培训需求分析能够提供精准性，将学习投资与组织绩效和长期增长目标直接联系起来，解决培训活动缺乏针对性的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化培训需求分析在战略人力资源管理中的作用，连接人力资本投资与组织绩效的理论框架，为组织学习理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供实施严格培训需求分析的方法论，帮助管理者将培训从可自由支配开支转变为战略杠杆，提高培训投资回报率

title: Optimization Models for Maintenance Decision-Making in African Energy and Transportation Systems

detail.title: Optimization Models for Maintenance Decision-Making in African Energy and Transportation Systems
detail.abstract: Maintenance decision-making plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and sustainability of energy and transportation infrastructure, particularly within African contexts where assets are often constrained by aging systems, limited funding, and institutional challenges. This study examines optimization models applied to maintenance decision-making in African energy and transportation systems, with the aim of identifying effective strategies that improve asset performance and resource allocation. A systematic synthesis of existing optimization approaches, including mathematical models, artificial intelligence-driven predictive maintenance, and multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks, was conducted. The findings reveal that hybrid optimization models integrating technical, economic, and contextual factors outperform traditional reactive maintenance approaches in terms of cost efficiency, reliability, and resilience. However, institutional readiness, data limitations, and human factors continue to hinder widespread adoption. The study concludes that context-aware optimization models offer significant potential for improving maintenance decision-making across African energy and transportation sectors, provided that implementation strategies address local constraints and governance realities  (Uke 2021; Hamdan et al. 2024; Jaafaru and Agbelie 2022).

AI.tldr: 该研究系统综述了非洲能源和交通基础设施维护决策中的优化模型，发现整合技术、经济和情境因素的混合优化模型在成本效益、可靠性和韧性方面优于传统反应式维护方法，但制度准备度、数据限制和人为因素阻碍了广泛应用。
AI.research_question: 在非洲能源和交通系统中，哪些优化模型能有效改善维护决策，提高资产性能和资源分配效率？
AI.motivation: 非洲能源和交通基础设施面临老化系统、资金有限和制度挑战等约束，维护决策对确保可靠性、安全性和可持续性至关重要，需要探索有效的优化策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 优化理论、决策科学、资产管理系统理论、制度理论、资源约束理论。
AI.method: 对现有优化方法进行系统综合，包括数学模型、人工智能驱动的预测性维护和多准则决策分析框架。
AI.findings: 整合技术、经济和情境因素的混合优化模型在成本效率、可靠性和韧性方面优于传统反应式维护方法；制度准备度、数据限制和人为因素阻碍了广泛应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了适用于资源约束环境的维护决策优化理论框架，强调了情境因素在优化模型中的重要性，丰富了制度约束下的决策科学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲能源和交通部门提供了有效的维护决策优化策略，指导实践者选择适合当地约束的优化方法，提出了考虑制度准备度和数据限制的实施路径。

title: The Impact of Structured Interviews on Hiring Success in Project Management Positions: Evidence from Engineering Projects in Dubai

detail.title: The Impact of Structured Interviews on Hiring Success in Project Management Positions: Evidence from Engineering Projects in Dubai

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest related to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on secondary data from published academic sources and did not involve human participants. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Structured interviews are commonly known in the human resource management literature as one of the effective selection instruments because they are reliable and predictive. Nevertheless, their strategic presence in project-based organizations especially in project management jobs has not been adequately determined. This paper discusses the effects of structured interviews on the success of hiring in terms of project management jobs, particularly the engineering projects in Dubai. With a qualitative and evidence-based research design, the research is a synthesis of the results of peer reviewed scholarly literature, theory and context specific research on recruitment, selection and project management. Amongst the issues that are analysed is evaluation consistency, reduction of interviewer bias, competency alignment and indicators of hiring success. The results have shown that structured interviews lead to better hiring results in that they enhance objectivity, facilitating systematic evaluation of project management skills, and minimizing subjectivity particularly in multicultural and high-risk project management. The research concludes that structured interviews can be viewed as an HRM practice in engineering projects as the project leadership is crucial concerning organizational and project performance. Viable suggestions are provided to facilitate the implementation of structured interview models in project-oriented recruitment situations. The study has added to the body of knowledge on HRM and project management since it has established how structured interviews are applicable in complex engineering projects and has offered evidence-based information that can be used by organizations that operate in Dubai.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨结构化面试在迪拜工程项目管理岗位招聘中的效果，研究发现结构化面试能提高招聘成功率，增强客观性，减少偏见，并促进项目管理能力评估的系统化。
AI.research_question: 结构化面试对项目管理岗位（特别是迪拜工程项目）招聘成功有何影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管结构化面试在人力资源管理文献中被认为是有效的选拔工具，但它在项目型组织特别是项目管理岗位中的战略作用尚未得到充分研究，尤其是在迪拜工程项目这样的复杂环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源管理理论（特别是选拔与招聘理论）、项目管理理论、结构化面试理论、跨文化管理理论
AI.method: 采用定性和循证研究设计，综合同行评审学术文献、理论和特定情境研究（招聘、选拔和项目管理）的结果进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 结构化面试能带来更好的招聘结果：增强客观性、促进项目管理技能的系统化评估、减少主观性（特别是在多元文化和高风险项目管理环境中）。分析的问题包括评估一致性、减少面试官偏见、能力匹配和招聘成功指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了人力资源管理和项目管理交叉领域的研究，建立了结构化面试在复杂工程项目中的应用框架，提供了理论到实践的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为迪拜工程项目组织提供了实施结构化面试模型的具体建议，帮助组织在多元文化和高风险环境中提高招聘质量，提升项目领导力和组织绩效。

title: Promise and Pitfalls of AI In Mass Arbitration
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Michael E. Moritz College of Law

detail.title: Promise and Pitfalls of AI In Mass Arbitration

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ohio State Legal Studies Research Paper No. 962
publicationDetails.journalName: Ohio State University Moritz College of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in the Cardozo Journal of Conflict Resolution

detail.abstract:
Mass arbitration has emerged as a strategic response to arbitration clauses that preclude class actions, allowing large numbers of claimants to bring individual arbitration demands against companies for similar grievances. Unlike class actions where a lead claimant represents others, mass arbitration requires each claimant's active participation in separate proceedings, creating significant administrative burdens and costs. Following a 2011 Supreme Court ruling that solidified mandatory individual arbitration clauses, consumers and employees increasingly turned to mass arbitration filings. While the American Arbitration Association's rule updates aimed to improve efficiency through measures like one-time initiation fees and process arbitrators, challenges remain in managing these high-volume disputes. Simultaneously, technological advances have transformed dispute resolution through online arbitration (OArb) and artificial intelligence (AI). Attorneys and arbitrators now use AI in a variety of ways, along with basic digital tools and virtual hearings to reduce costs and increase accessibility. More recently, agentic AI, sophisticated systems capable of autonomous decision-making and multi-step problem-solving, has entered the arbitration landscape. This article examines the intersection of AI technology and mass arbitration, exploring how AI tools can help enhance efficiency and accessibility if used appropriately and in accordance with strict ethical requirements. The article analyzes the development of mass arbitration, traces the evolution of AI tools in this context, grounds the discussion in ethical standards, and provides frameworks for responsible AI implementation in mass arbitration proceedings. 

This is a DRAFT of an article to be edited and published in the Cardozo Journal of Conflict Resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能技术如何应用于大规模仲裁，以解决传统仲裁中的效率与可及性问题，同时强调伦理框架的重要性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能技术如何在大规模仲裁中提升效率和可及性，同时确保符合伦理标准？
AI.motivation: 大规模仲裁作为应对禁止集体诉讼的仲裁条款的策略，产生了巨大的行政负担和成本。同时，人工智能技术（特别是自主决策的智能体AI）在争议解决中应用日益广泛，需要探讨如何负责任地整合这些技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于仲裁理论、技术伦理框架和争议解决效率理论，结合美国仲裁协会规则更新和最高法院判例（2011年裁决）的法律背景。
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究（追溯大规模仲裁发展历程和AI工具演变）、伦理标准分析，并提出负责任AI实施的框架。
AI.findings: AI工具（包括在线仲裁、虚拟听证、自主决策系统）能显著降低大规模仲裁成本、提高可及性，但需要严格的伦理约束和适当的实施框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建了AI技术在大规模仲裁中的整合理论框架；2）提出了技术伦理与仲裁实践交叉的新理论视角；3）发展了负责任AI实施的规范性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为仲裁机构提供AI实施指南；2）为律师和仲裁员提供具体工具使用建议；3）为政策制定者提供监管参考；4）提高大规模仲裁的效率与公平性。

title: Reliability-Centered Maintenance Models Incorporating Human Factors in African Critical Infrastructure

detail.title: Reliability-Centered Maintenance Models Incorporating Human Factors in African Critical Infrastructure
detail.abstract: Reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) has become a dominant strategy for ensuring asset availability, safety, and lifecycle optimization in critical infrastructure systems. However, in many African industrial contexts, persistent failures, safety incidents, and premature asset degradation continue to occur despite the adoption of RCM-based frameworks. This study examines the extent to which existing RCM models adequately incorporate human factors and organizational realities within African critical infrastructure systems. Using a structured synthesis of peer-reviewed literature, industrial case studies, and conceptual frameworks, the study evaluates both classical and advanced RCM models, including digital and RCM 4.0 approaches. The findings reveal that most RCM implementations in Africa remain technically driven, with limited integration of human reliability, skill readiness, and organizational culture. Evidence across energy, aviation, healthcare, and oil and gas sectors indicates that human factors significantly influence maintenance effectiveness and system reliability.
