title: The Guardrail Gap: A Conceptual Framework for Understanding Governance Failures in Evolving AI Systems

detail.title: The Guardrail Gap: A Conceptual Framework for Understanding Governance Failures in Evolving AI Systems
detail.abstract: Current AI governance frameworks face a fundamental limitation: they assess and regulate AI systems based on capabilities present at deployment, yet these systems increasingly demonstrate the capacity to evolve, adapt, and develop new behaviors post-deployment. This paper introduces the concept of the Guardrail Gap-the governance void that emerges when AI systems transition beyond their deploymenttime capabilities without corresponding updates to oversight mechanisms. Drawing on observations from autonomous agent development, multi-agent systems, and adaptive AI architectures, this paper argues that static governance frameworks are structurally inadequate for the emerging landscape of AI systems capable of behavioral evolution. The paper concludes by identifying directions for adaptive governance frameworks capable of addressing this gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"护栏缺口"概念，指AI系统在部署后能够演化、适应和发展新行为，而现有治理框架仍基于部署时的能力进行评估和监管，导致治理真空。
AI.research_question: 当前基于部署时能力的AI治理框架如何应对部署后能够演化、适应和发展新行为的AI系统？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理框架面临根本性局限：它们基于部署时的能力评估和监管AI系统，但这些系统越来越多地表现出部署后演化、适应和发展新行为的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 护栏缺口概念、自适应AI架构理论、多智能体系统理论、自主智能体开发观察
AI.method: 基于对自主智能体开发、多智能体系统和自适应AI架构的观察进行概念分析和论证
AI.findings: 静态治理框架在结构上不足以应对能够进行行为演化的AI系统新兴格局，当AI系统超越其部署时能力而监督机制未相应更新时，就会出现治理真空。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"护栏缺口"这一核心概念，为理解AI治理中的动态监管挑战提供了理论框架，指出了静态治理框架的结构性不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了能够应对这一缺口的自适应治理框架发展方向，为政策制定者和监管机构提供了实践指导。

title: Private Wealth Machines: Intra-Family LLC Structures, Tax Avoidance, and the Grey Zone of Asset Protection

detail.title: Private Wealth Machines: Intra-Family LLC Structures, Tax Avoidance, and the Grey Zone of Asset Protection
detail.abstract: This paper develops a stylized “Family Wealth Machine” model to analyze how intrafamily corporate structures operate at the intersection of tax law, asset protection, and intergenerational wealth planning. The model uses a dual-entity structure—an operating LLC and a property-holding LLC—to show how the exact legal blueprint can be implemented in three ways: (i) as a lawful small-family enterprise, (ii) as a grey-zone vehicle for income shifting and judgment-proofing, and (iii) as a shell for outright tax evasion and creditor abuse. Building on work on limited liability, veil piercing, tax havens, anonymous shell companies, and general anti-avoidance rules (GAAR), the paper develops a three-category framework for distinguishing lawful tax planning from grey-zone avoidance and sham arrangements in the intra-family setting. It then applies this framework to a stylized case study of an “Alpha Services LLC” operating company and “Beta Holdings LLC” property vehicle, tracing how ordinary household decisions about work, housing, and inheritance are transformed into entity-level transactions. The analysis maps how tax authorities, civil creditors, and transparency/AML regulators are likely to treat different versions of the Family Wealth Machine and argues that legal and financial sophistication has become a material driver of who can build and preserve private wealth. The paper concludes with normative and policy recommendations— safe harbors and documentation rules for related-party transactions, robust beneficial-ownership regimes, calibrated GAAR guidance, strengthened fraudulent-transfer and veil-piercing standards, and safeguards for prenuptial agreements involving entity-held assets—aimed at narrowing the grey zone while preserving straightforward family entrepreneurship. This paper designates the referenced architecture as the Family Wealth Machine. Central to this concept is a straightforward idea, well known in the literature on asset partitioning and tax planning: the use of legal entities to transform routine family activities—such as work, housing, consumption, and inheritance—into a controlled sequence of transactions among entities. Wages may be recharacterized as management fees, personal housing partially reclassified as office or rental space, and intergenerational transfers executed through share transfers instead of direct gifts, emulating techniques employed in more advanced family-office and dynastic-planning frameworks. The same framework can be implemented conservatively as a small-business structure, aggressively as a tool for tax reduction and asset protection, or fraudulently as a means for evasion and creditor exploitation—distinctions that doctrinal discussions regarding tax avoidance versus evasion and veil-piercing endeavors aim to delineate. Existing scholarship on tax avoidance, asset protection, and shell companies concentrates predominantly on multinationals and ultra-wealthy individuals: the BEPS literature scrutinizes base erosion and profit shifting by large corporate groups. Conversely, research on tax havens and anonymous shell companies delineates how lightly regulated entities in onshore and offshore jurisdictions facilitate concealed wealth and illicit financial flows. Additionally, there exists an advanced body of work addressing limited liability, veil piercing, and the normative status of asset partitioning within domestic company law. In contrast, the intermediate tier—comprising families with moderate assets and partial legal literacy, endeavoring to emulate billionaire strategies on a smaller scale—has received comparatively limited systematic investigation, despite anecdotal evidence from practitioners and planners indicating that such structures are becoming increasingly prevalent. This paper addresses that gap in three steps. First, it develops a conceptual framework that distinguishes clearly lawful tax planning, grey-zone avoidance, and outright evasion in the context of intra-family structures, building on GAAR, abuse-of-law, and economic-substance doctrines in domestic and EU law. Second, it applies that framework to a stylized Family Wealth Machine composed of an operating LLC and a property-holding LLC. This configuration reflects common small-enterprise and real estate practices documented in the business and estateplanning literature. Third, it draws out the legal and normative implications for tax enforcement, creditor protection, marital property, and inequality, situating the analysis within broader debates on wealth concentration and the distributional consequences of legal sophistication. The central claim is that legal and financial sophistication has become a material driver of who can build and preserve private wealth.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个"家庭财富机器"模型，分析家族企业内部结构如何运作于税法、资产保护和代际财富规划的交叉点。通过双实体结构（运营LLC和资产持有LLC），展示了同一法律蓝图可被用于合法小企业、灰色地带避税和欺诈性逃税三种方式。论文提出了区分合法税务规划、灰色地带避税和欺诈安排的三类框架，并分析了法律金融素养如何成为财富积累的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 家族企业内部结构如何运作于税法、资产保护和代际财富规划的交叉点？如何区分合法税务规划、灰色地带避税和欺诈性安排？法律金融素养如何影响私人财富的积累和保存？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注跨国公司和超级富豪的税务规避、资产保护和空壳公司使用，而对中等资产家庭试图模仿亿万富翁策略的中间阶层缺乏系统研究。尽管从业者证据显示此类结构日益普遍，但这一领域的研究相对有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有限责任、面纱刺破、避税天堂、匿名空壳公司和一般反避税规则(GAAR)的研究，结合国内和欧盟法律中的GAAR、滥用法律和经济实质原则，构建了区分合法税务规划、灰色地带避税和欺诈安排的三类框架。
AI.method: 采用概念框架开发和案例研究法：1）构建区分合法、灰色和欺诈性安排的三类框架；2）将该框架应用于由运营LLC和资产持有LLC组成的"家庭财富机器"模型；3）通过"Alpha Services LLC"和"Beta Holdings LLC"的案例研究，分析普通家庭决策如何转化为实体层面的交易。
AI.findings: 同一法律结构可被用于三种不同目的：合法小企业运营、灰色地带收入转移和资产保护、欺诈性逃税和债权人滥用。法律金融素养已成为私人财富积累和保存的重要驱动因素。税务当局、民事债权人和透明度/反洗钱监管机构对不同版本的家庭财富机器会有不同处理方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了区分合法税务规划、灰色地带避税和欺诈安排的三类框架；2）将资产分割和税务规划文献扩展到中等资产家庭领域；3）将法律金融素养概念化为财富积累的关键机制；4）为家族企业内部结构研究提供了系统分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了政策建议：关联方交易的安全港和文件规则、健全的受益所有权制度、校准的GAAR指导、加强的欺诈转让和面纱刺破标准、涉及实体持有资产的婚前协议保障措施，旨在缩小灰色地带同时保护直接的家庭创业。

title: Designing High Availability with Microsoft SQL Server

detail.title: Designing High Availability with Microsoft SQL Server
detail.abstract:
Businesses today rely on data to run every day. Banks, hospitals, logistics companies, and government systems all use Microsoft SQL Server. When these systems go down, it can cause lost revenue, delays, or even risk public safety.

High Availability (HA) means designing SQL Server systems so they keep running even if hardware, software, or network problems happen. Good HA design reduces downtime, protects data, and keeps business running smoothly. This article explains key strategies for building reliable SQL Server systems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Microsoft SQL Server高可用性(HA)设计策略，旨在确保关键业务系统在硬件、软件或网络故障时持续运行，减少停机时间，保护数据并保障业务连续性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计Microsoft SQL Server系统的高可用性架构，以确保关键业务系统在面临硬件、软件或网络故障时能够持续运行？
AI.motivation: 银行、医院、物流公司和政府系统等关键业务都依赖Microsoft SQL Server运行，系统停机可能导致收入损失、服务延迟甚至公共安全风险，因此需要可靠的高可用性设计来保障业务连续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高可用性(HA)理论、容错系统设计原理、灾难恢复理论、业务连续性管理框架。
AI.method: 基于SQL Server技术架构的系统设计方法，包括故障转移集群、数据库镜像、Always On可用性组、日志传送等技术策略的分析与比较。
AI.findings: 通过实施适当的高可用性策略，可以有效减少SQL Server系统停机时间，保护关键数据，确保业务在故障发生时能够持续运行。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了高可用性理论在SQL Server环境中的应用框架，提供了针对不同业务场景的系统容错设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为依赖SQL Server的企业提供了具体的高可用性设计指南，帮助IT专业人员构建可靠的系统架构，减少业务中断风险，保障数据安全和业务连续性。

title: A Socio-Technical Framework for Sustainable Finance: Integrating Mechanical Efficiency with Digital Governance

detail.title: A Socio-Technical Framework for Sustainable Finance: Integrating Mechanical Efficiency with Digital Governance
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a Socio-Technical framework for financial sustainability by adapting principles of mechanical reliability and entropy to modern economic governance. Moving beyond reactive risk models, the research introduces a 'Factor of Safety' for financial systems, drawing on the author’s experience in high-volume logistics and portfolio recovery. By utilizing SAP-integrated data as a 'scan-level' diagnostic tool, the framework enables real-time monitoring of systemic 'friction'—the technical and human inefficiencies that lead to insolvency. The study argues that the global economy must be managed as a high-performance system requiring proactive maintenance, offering a scalable model for ensuring long-term institutional resilience and sustainable trade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个社会技术框架，通过将机械可靠性和熵原理应用于现代经济治理来实现金融可持续性。该框架引入金融系统的"安全系数"，利用SAP集成数据进行实时监测，将全球经济视为需要主动维护的高性能系统。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个能够确保金融系统长期可持续性和韧性的社会技术框架？
AI.motivation: 现有风险模型通常是反应性的，无法有效预防系统性金融失效。需要从工程学角度重新思考经济治理，将金融系统视为需要主动维护的高性能技术系统。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 机械可靠性理论（安全系数概念）
2. 熵原理在系统效率中的应用
3. 社会技术系统理论
4. 系统性摩擦理论（技术和人为低效率）
AI.method:
1. 将工程学原理（机械可靠性、熵）应用于经济治理
2. 利用SAP集成数据作为"扫描级"诊断工具
3. 实时监测系统性摩擦指标
4. 基于高容量物流和投资组合恢复经验构建框架
AI.findings:
1. 金融系统可以像机械系统一样应用"安全系数"概念
2. SAP数据能够有效识别系统性摩擦（技术和人为低效率）
3. 实时监测能够预防系统性失效
4. 主动维护方法比反应性风险模型更有效
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将工程可靠性理论扩展到金融可持续性领域
2. 提出"系统性摩擦"作为金融失效的新解释框架
3. 建立社会技术视角的经济治理理论
4. 为熵原理在经济系统中的应用提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供可扩展的金融系统韧性模型
2. 开发基于SAP的实时监测工具
3. 为机构提供长期可持续性管理框架
4. 支持可持续贸易的系统性保障

title: Federated Learning and Trust Fabric for Cross-Domain Network Resilience

detail.title: Federated Learning and Trust Fabric for Cross-Domain Network Resilience
detail.abstract: Research will show that flexibility and resolve within cross-domain networks that span multi-cloud systems, the Internet of Things, software-defined networking, and edge architectures are shrinking due to the inherent inflexibility, limited redundancy, and single points of control in built-in scoping of trust and control systems (Balakrishnan 2024; Hassan et al. 2023). Vertical approaches lack the adaptable components that should integrate heterogeneous domains, workload patterns, and privacy requirements, resulting in networks that improvise with potential cascading failures, persistent delayed responses in control loops (Hassan et al. 2023). This study is designed to strategically research the potential of federated learning to establish trust permeable across core and edge domains of cross-federated architectures to assist in collaborative anomaly detection and trust system decentralization (Li et al. 2022; Tariq et al. 2023). This design federated edge and core learning systems to retain data at the edge, while at the same time allowing collaborative efforts to strengthen and badge control on the model (Li et al. 2022). The evaluation of the design data points related to the design showed increased fault tolerance that was realised through control, enabling the system to retain resilience (Beltrán et al. 2023). Sufficient data were collected to prove that anomaly detection and system performance are improved in systems with cross-domain complexity (Jianping et al. 2024). The technique is appropriate for sensitive and regulated environments because the exchange of raw data across administrative boundaries is avoided, enhancing privacy protections (Beltrán et al. 2023). On the whole, the results indicate that federated learning, augmented with a trust fabric, has the potential to offer a robust architectural base for cross-domain networks that are resilient, privacy-preserving, and self-sufficient (Balakrishnan 2023; Lavaur et al. 2022).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在跨域网络中使用联邦学习建立信任渗透机制，以增强异常检测和系统弹性，同时保护隐私。
AI.research_question: 联邦学习如何在跨域网络架构中建立信任渗透机制，以支持协作异常检测和信任系统去中心化？
AI.motivation: 当前跨域网络在多云系统、物联网、软件定义网络和边缘架构中缺乏灵活性、冗余性和控制点单一，导致信任和控制系统的固有僵化，容易引发级联故障和控制延迟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联邦学习理论、信任渗透机制、跨域网络架构、协作异常检测和去中心化信任系统理论。
AI.method: 设计联邦边缘和核心学习系统，在边缘保留数据的同时实现协作模型训练，通过控制增强系统弹性，避免跨域原始数据交换。
AI.findings: 该设计提高了故障容忍度，增强了系统弹性，改善了复杂跨域系统中的异常检测和性能表现，同时通过避免原始数据交换增强了隐私保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于联邦学习的信任渗透机制理论框架，为跨域网络提供了新的信任建立和去中心化控制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为敏感和受监管环境提供了隐私保护的跨域网络解决方案，增强了系统弹性和异常检测能力，适用于多云、物联网、边缘计算等复杂场景。

title: The Role of Blockchain Technology in Ensuring Governance Transparency and Efficiency in the Digital Economy

detail.title: The Role of Blockchain Technology in Ensuring Governance Transparency and Efficiency in the Digital Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest. No personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations have influenced or could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required as this research involves no human participants, patients, or case studies.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: In the current era, global financial and governance architectures are rapidly transitioning to digital systems. Despite this trend, many economic operations continue to rely on centralized, multi-layered, and intermediary-based models characteristic of the previous century. These traditional systems are increasingly misaligned with the demands for speed, transparency, and efficiency in the digital economy, leading to operational inefficiencies, increased transaction costs, and heightened risk of fraud. Blockchain technology, with its distributed ledger, algorithmic trust mechanisms, and realtime verification capabilities, offers a potential solution to these systemic challenges. This study employs an institutional approach to assess the role of blockchain in enhancing governance transparency, operational efficiency, and trust in both public and private sectors. A systematic literature review (SLR) of over 500 sources from 2015-2025, combined with comparative and interpretative analyses, demonstrates that blockchain can significantly reduce transaction costs, streamline auditing, and mitigate human error and corruption. However, the successful implementation of blockchain is contingent upon legal frameworks, institutional readiness, and digital infrastructure. The study also highlights the evolutionary shift from interpersonal and institutional trust to algorithmic trust, illustrating blockchain's capacity to reshape socioeconomic interactions. The findings provide practical recommendations for emerging economies, including Uzbekistan, to harness blockchain as a strategic tool for economic modernization and governance reform.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述和制度分析方法，探讨区块链技术如何通过分布式账本和算法信任机制，提升治理透明度、运营效率，并降低交易成本，为新兴经济体如乌兹别克斯坦提供经济现代化和治理改革的战略工具。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术如何通过其分布式账本、算法信任机制和实时验证能力，在公共和私营部门中提升治理透明度、运营效率和信任？
AI.motivation: 当前全球金融和治理架构正快速向数字化系统转型，但许多经济运作仍依赖集中化、多层化和中介化的传统模式，这些模式与数字经济对速度、透明度和效率的需求日益脱节，导致运营效率低下、交易成本增加和欺诈风险升高。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度分析方法，结合信任理论（从人际信任、制度信任到算法信任的演进），以及交易成本经济学。
AI.method: 系统文献综述（SLR），涵盖2015-2025年超过500个来源，结合比较分析和解释性分析。
AI.findings: 区块链能显著降低交易成本、简化审计流程、减少人为错误和腐败。但成功实施区块链取决于法律框架、制度准备度和数字基础设施。研究还揭示了从人际信任、制度信任到算法信任的演进转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从制度视角分析区块链对治理和信任的影响；2. 提出信任演进的三个阶段：人际信任→制度信任→算法信任；3. 为区块链在公共和私营部门的制度整合提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为新兴经济体（如乌兹别克斯坦）提供利用区块链进行经济现代化和治理改革的实用建议；2. 识别区块链成功实施的关键前提条件；3. 为政策制定者和企业提供实施路线图。

title: John Carreyrou V. AI Companies Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Xai & Others: A Legal Analysis

detail.title: John Carreyrou V. AI Companies Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Xai & Others: A Legal Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper provides a procedural and doctrinal analysis of Carreyrou et al. v. Anthropic PBC, Google AI, OpenAI, xAI & Others, arguing that the complaint, as pleaded, fails to state a legally cognizable claim under U.S. copyright law and federal civil procedure. The analysis deliberately does not assess the ultimate merits of copyright protection, fair use doctrine, or the broader policy debate surrounding generative AI. Instead, it examines whether the plaintiffs’ allegations satisfy the minimum pleading requirements necessary to survive a motion to dismiss under Rule 12(b)(6) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure. The article demonstrates that the complaint suffers from multiple structural deficiencies, including the absence of specific factual allegations regarding copying, traceability, causation, and market substitution, as required by Twombly and Iqbal. Particular attention is paid to the statute of limitations under 17 U.S.C. § 507(b), showing that many of the claims are likely time-barred given the public availability of the relevant datasets well before the filing of the lawsuit. A comparative analysis with the Disney v. Midjourney complaint highlights the distinction between robust, evidence-driven pleading and conclusory, inferential allegations. The paper further critiques attempts to rely on large language model outputs (including chatbot responses) as evidentiary support, explaining why such materials constitute inadmissible hearsay, lack authentication, and cannot qualify as party admissions under the Federal Rules of Evidence. Beyond the doctrinal analysis, the paper advances a methodological argument: contemporary large language models function as instrumenta vocalia—speaking tools—rather than legal or epistemic subjects. This conclusion is supported by a reproducible experiment in which multiple LLMs (including Grok, Claude, KIMI, and Perplexity) failed to identify the article’s central procedural thesis and instead generated near-identical, template-based “peer reviews,” reinforcing concerns about the reliability of AI-assisted legal evaluation. The paper concludes that, regardless of future developments in AI copyright jurisprudence, the Carreyrou complaint—on its face—illustrates how high-profile litigation may collapse at the pleading stage when doctrinal rigor is subordinated to rhetorical and technological speculation. The findings have broader implications for AI-related litigation, legal scholarship, and the growing reliance on LLMs in legal analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文对Carreyrou等人诉Anthropic等AI公司的版权诉讼进行程序性和法理分析，认为起诉状未能满足美国版权法和联邦民事诉讼的最低起诉要求，存在多重结构性缺陷，包括缺乏具体的复制事实指控、因果关系、市场替代证据，且许多索赔可能因诉讼时效而无效。
AI.research_question: Carreyrou等人诉Anthropic等AI公司的起诉状是否满足联邦民事诉讼规则12(b)(6)下的最低起诉要求，以及该案在程序性和法理上存在哪些结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI技术的快速发展，针对AI公司的版权诉讼日益增多。本文旨在分析这类高调诉讼在起诉阶段可能存在的程序性缺陷，避免法理严谨性被修辞和技术推测所取代，为AI相关诉讼提供方法论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 联邦民事诉讼规则12(b)(6)下的起诉要求；2. Twombly和Iqbal判例确立的具体事实指控标准；3. 美国版权法第507(b)条的诉讼时效规定；4. 联邦证据规则中的传闻证据、认证和当事人承认理论；5. 大型语言模型作为"发声工具"(instrumenta vocalia)而非法律或认知主体的方法论框架。
AI.method: 1. 程序性和法理分析：系统分析起诉状是否符合法律起诉要求；2. 比较分析：与Disney诉Midjourney案的起诉状进行对比；3. 法律论证分析：评估LLM输出作为证据的可采性；4. 实验方法：通过多个LLM（Grok、Claude、KIMI、Perplexity）进行可重复实验，测试其识别文章核心论点的能力。
AI.findings: 1. 起诉状存在多重结构性缺陷：缺乏具体的复制、可追溯性、因果关系和市场替代事实指控；2. 许多索赔可能因诉讼时效而无效；3. LLM输出作为证据存在可采性问题：构成不可采的传闻证据、缺乏认证、不符合当事人承认标准；4. LLM实验显示其无法识别文章核心程序性论点，仅生成模板化"同行评审"，验证了LLM作为"发声工具"而非法律分析主体的性质。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出LLM作为"instrumenta vocalia"（发声工具）而非法律或认知主体的理论框架；2. 为AI版权诉讼的程序性分析提供系统方法论；3. 深化了对Twombly/Iqbal标准在AI诉讼中应用的理解；4. 批判性地分析了LLM输出在证据法中的地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为律师和法官提供AI版权诉讼的起诉标准指南；2. 警示高调诉讼在起诉阶段可能失败的风险；3. 为法律学者提供评估AI相关诉讼质量的分析框架；4. 揭示LLM在法律分析中的局限性，促进更审慎地使用AI辅助工具。

title: MarketMaven: An Agent-based AI for Automated Startup Analysis and Market Intelligence
affiliations: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani and Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

detail.title: MarketMaven: An Agent-based AI for Automated Startup Analysis and Market Intelligence
detail.abstract: Startups face a notoriously high failure rate, with a significant percentage succumbing to a preventable cause: a lack of productmarket fit. This report details the architecture and benchmarking of a novel AI system designed to mitigate this risk through automated market surveying and startup analysis. The system employs an agentbased framework where a central reasoning engine utilizes a suite of specialized tools to perform a comprehensive analysis pipeline. The architecture is grounded in a hybrid knowledge base, combining a relational SQL database for structured data with a vector database for semantic retrieval. This agent is augmented with specialized tools, enabling it to execute data-driven queries for competitor identification, funding analysis, and market intelligence. The system's workflow is orchestrated by a ReAct reasoning engine that sequentially executes tasks such as competitor identification, funding analysis, and market intelligence using its available tools. A rigorous benchmarking framework is proposed to evaluate the system's performance using both quantitative metrics (precision, recall, F1-score, prediction error) and qualitative case study analysis. Preliminary results indicate the system can achieve research-backed accuracy targets exceeding 90%, providing a robust, scalable, and data-driven tool for entrepreneurs, investors, and policymakers to perform initial viability assessments and de-risk early-stage ventures.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个基于代理的AI系统，通过自动化市场调查和初创企业分析来降低初创企业因缺乏产品市场契合度而失败的风险。系统采用混合知识库和ReAct推理引擎，能够执行竞争对手识别、融资分析和市场情报等任务，初步结果显示准确率超过90%。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够有效评估初创企业产品市场契合度的AI系统，以降低初创企业失败率？
AI.motivation: 初创企业失败率很高，其中很大一部分原因是缺乏产品市场契合度。需要开发一个自动化的、数据驱动的工具来帮助创业者、投资者和政策制定者进行初步可行性评估，降低早期创业风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理的框架、混合知识库理论（关系型SQL数据库与向量数据库结合）、ReAct推理引擎理论、产品市场契合度理论。
AI.method: 采用基于代理的架构，中央推理引擎使用专门工具执行分析流程。系统结合关系型SQL数据库和向量数据库构建混合知识库。使用ReAct推理引擎顺序执行任务。通过定量指标（精确率、召回率、F1分数、预测误差）和定性案例研究进行基准测试。
AI.findings: 初步结果表明，该系统能够达到超过90%的研究支持准确率目标，为创业者、投资者和政策制定者提供了一个强大、可扩展且数据驱动的工具，用于进行初步可行性评估和降低早期创业风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合关系型数据库和向量数据库的混合知识库架构；开发了基于ReAct推理引擎的自动化初创企业分析框架；为产品市场契合度评估提供了新的AI驱动方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了一个强大的工具来评估产品市场契合度；为投资者提供了数据驱动的初创企业评估工具；为政策制定者提供了支持创业生态系统的决策支持系统；系统具有可扩展性和高准确性（>90%）。

title: Time-to-Repurchase Modeling on Marketplace E-Commerce Data: A Reproducible Time-to-Event ML Pipeline with Feature Engineering and Segment Profiling Using Kaplan-Meier and Cox PH Baselines

detail.title: Time-to-Repurchase Modeling on Marketplace E-Commerce Data: A Reproducible Time-to-Event ML Pipeline with Feature Engineering and Segment Profiling Using Kaplan-Meier and Cox PH Baselines
detail.abstract:
Problem

Marketplace retention is naturally a time-to-event task: customers rarely “churn” explicitly, follow-up ends at an administrative snapshot, and many outcomes are right-censored. Binary churn labels can obscure exposure-time differences and do not directly address when repurchase occurs.

Data and Methods

Using the Olist Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset, raw order, item, payment, delivery, and geography tables were consolidated into a customer-level survival dataset indexed on each customer’s first delivered order (t₀). A minimum potential follow-up requirement of ≥180 days (snapshot − t₀) was applied to improve comparability under administrative censoring, yielding 63,760 customers from 93,350 delivered index orders with 1,563 repurchases (2.45%) observed before the snapshot. Repurchase dynamics were summarized with Kaplan–Meier estimation, and covariate associations were assessed using a Cox proportional hazards model fitted on cold-start covariates available at or before t₀.

Evaluation

To prevent information leakage and approximate forward-in-time scoring, customers were split using a strict chronological partition by t₀. Discrimination was evaluated using the concordance index (C-index), which measures ranking quality for time-to-event outcomes under censoring.

Results

Repurchase accumulated slowly within the observation window: cumulative repurchase remained below 3% at one year, and the Kaplan–Meier median time-to-repurchase was not reached. The Cox baseline provided limited discriminatory power from entry-time metadata (test C-index = 0.5328), with hazard ratios generally near 1.0 and no covariates statistically significant at α = 0.05.

Contributions

This study provides a transparent baseline for marketplace repurchase under administrative censoring: (i) an empirically calibrated retention curve, (ii) a leakage-controlled cold-start Cox benchmark with prospective-style evaluation, and (iii) a reproducible framework that can be extended with richer post-acquisition signals and alternative time-to-event models.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用生存分析方法分析巴西电商市场客户复购行为，建立了考虑右删失的复购时间模型，提供了基准复购曲线和冷启动预测框架。
AI.research_question: 在行政删失条件下，如何准确预测电商市场客户的复购时间？
AI.motivation: 传统二元流失标签无法捕捉复购时间差异，且客户很少明确流失，许多结果存在右删失问题，需要更合适的时间到事件分析方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生存分析理论，包括Kaplan-Meier估计和Cox比例风险模型，用于处理右删失的时间到事件数据。
AI.method: 使用Olist巴西电商公开数据集，构建客户级生存数据集，应用≥180天最小随访要求，使用Kaplan-Meier估计复购动态，Cox模型评估协变量关联，采用严格时间划分防止信息泄露。
AI.findings: 复购率在观察窗口内缓慢累积：一年内累计复购率低于3%，未达到中位复购时间；Cox模型仅使用冷启动协变量时区分能力有限（C-index=0.5328），风险比接近1.0，无统计显著协变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了行政删失条件下市场复购的透明基准：实证校准的留存曲线、泄漏控制的冷启动Cox基准、可复现框架，为后续研究奠定基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商平台提供了实用的复购预测框架，可扩展使用更丰富的后获客信号和替代时间到事件模型，帮助改进客户留存策略。

title: IPFP: An Improved Parallel FP-Growth Method for Fast Association Rule Mining
affiliations: Tezpur University, Assam Engineering College and Tezpur University

detail.title: IPFP: An Improved Parallel FP-Growth Method for Fast Association Rule Mining
detail.abstract: In recent years, the volume of data has grown exponentially which makes it essential to extract meaningful and useful knowledge or patterns from this massive data. Data mining has emerged as a significant field for uncovering hidden information and patterns from large databases. Among its various techniques, Association Rule Mining (ARM), an unsupervised learning method, plays a vital role by discovering frequent patterns and relationships. However, traditional ARM algorithms such as Apriori and FP-Growth, originally designed for centralized databases, face significant challenges when applied to large-scale transactional datasets due to high computational costs, repeated database scans, and limited scalability. To overcome these limitations, we have proposed an Improved Parallel FP-Growth (IPFP) algorithm, designed for parallel environments utilising Apache Spark. Experimental evaluation on benchmark datasets demonstrates that IPFP significantly improves execution time, scalability, and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods, including Hybrid Frequent Itemset Mining(HFIM), Yet Another Frequent Itemset Mining(YAFIM), Distributed FP-Growth algorithm based on spark(DFPS), and  Parallel FP-Growth(PFP). The evaluation focuses on the total count of mined frequent patterns and derived association rules across varying minimum support values, as well as the impact on runtime and speedup when applied to different datasets using state-of-the-art algorithms. Furthermore, the scalability analysis demonstrates that IPFP achieves near-linear speedup as the number of cores increases, confirming its efficiency in parallel environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的并行FP-Growth算法（IPFP），基于Apache Spark框架，用于解决传统关联规则挖掘算法在处理大规模数据集时面临的计算成本高、可扩展性差的问题。实验证明IPFP在运行时间、可扩展性和效率方面优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个高效的并行关联规则挖掘算法，以解决传统算法在处理大规模事务数据集时面临的高计算成本、重复数据库扫描和有限可扩展性问题？
AI.motivation: 随着数据量的指数级增长，从海量数据中提取有用知识和模式变得至关重要。传统关联规则挖掘算法（如Apriori和FP-Growth）最初为集中式数据库设计，在处理大规模事务数据集时面临高计算成本、重复数据库扫描和有限可扩展性的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关联规则挖掘（ARM）理论，特别是频繁模式挖掘和关联规则发现；并行计算理论；分布式计算框架（Apache Spark）的理论基础。
AI.method: 提出改进的并行FP-Growth算法（IPFP），基于Apache Spark并行环境设计。通过实验评估，使用基准数据集比较IPFP与现有方法（HFIM、YAFIM、DFPS、PFP）在挖掘频繁模式和关联规则数量、运行时间、加速比和可扩展性方面的性能。
AI.findings: IPFP在运行时间、可扩展性和效率方面显著优于现有方法；随着核心数增加，IPFP实现接近线性的加速比；在不同最小支持度阈值下，IPFP能够挖掘出更多的频繁模式和关联规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了改进的并行FP-Growth算法理论框架；扩展了关联规则挖掘在分布式并行环境中的应用理论；为大规模数据挖掘提供了新的并行算法设计思路。
AI.practical_contributions: IPFP算法可应用于大规模事务数据集的关联规则挖掘；为企业级数据挖掘应用提供了高效的解决方案；基于Apache Spark的实现具有良好的工程实践价值。

title: Shadow AI Governance Failures in Regulated Industries: A Privacy and Risk Management Perspective

detail.title: Shadow AI Governance Failures in Regulated Industries: A Privacy and Risk Management Perspective
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has become embedded in everyday work practices across regulated industries. Employees routinely use publicly accessible and consumer-grade AI tools to draft communications, summarize documents, analyze information, and support decision-making. This adoption has occurred rapidly and, in many cases, outside formal governance structures. This paper argues that this phenomenon, referred to as Shadow AI, should not be understood as a compliance or user-behavior problem. Instead, it represents a structural governance failure. Existing governance, privacy, and risk management frameworks were designed for centrally deployed, visible, and controllable systems. Shadow AI bypasses these assumptions quietly and at scale. As a result, organizations may appear compliant at the system level while accumulating unmanaged privacy, accountability, and regulatory risk at the interaction level. This paper reframes Shadow AI as a governance signal, one that reveals where existing models no longer align with how work is performed in AI-enabled environments. This paper is based on secondary research and conceptual analysis of governance and privacy frameworks applicable to regulated industries.

AI.tldr: 论文认为员工在日常工作中使用公开可访问的消费级AI工具（称为"影子AI"）不应被视为合规或用户行为问题，而是结构性治理失败。现有治理框架是为集中部署、可见可控的系统设计的，而影子AI大规模绕过这些假设，导致组织在系统层面看似合规，却在交互层面积累未管理的隐私、问责和监管风险。
AI.research_question: 影子AI现象应如何被理解和框架化？它揭示了现有治理框架与AI赋能工作环境之间的哪些不匹配？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已快速嵌入受监管行业的日常工作实践，员工普遍使用公开可访问的消费级AI工具，但这种采用往往发生在正式治理结构之外。现有治理、隐私和风险管理框架无法有效应对这种分散、非正式的AI使用模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论、隐私框架、风险管理理论、组织合规理论、技术采用理论
AI.method: 基于受监管行业适用的治理和隐私框架进行二次研究和概念分析
AI.findings: 影子AI不应被视为合规或用户行为问题，而是结构性治理失败。现有治理框架基于集中部署、可见可控系统的假设，而影子AI大规模绕过这些假设，导致组织在系统层面看似合规，却在交互层面积累未管理的隐私、问责和监管风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将影子AI重新框架化为治理信号，揭示了现有治理模型与AI赋能工作环境之间的不匹配；提出了结构性治理失败的概念框架，挑战了将影子AI视为合规或用户行为问题的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管组织提供重新思考治理框架的指导，强调需要适应分散式AI使用的新治理模式；帮助组织识别和应对交互层面的隐私、问责和监管风险；为政策制定者提供改进监管框架的见解。

title: Predictive Artificial Intelligence in Public Administration: Towards a Unified Definition

detail.title: Predictive Artificial Intelligence in Public Administration: Towards a Unified Definition
detail.abstract: The increasing implementation of artificial intelligence tools in Russia's public administration system has highlighted the acute shortage of a unified terminological apparatus for defining «predictive artificial intelligence». This situation leads to information asymmetry and managerial imbalances in the forecasting mechanisms employed by public authorities. The objective of this research is to develop a scientifically grounded definition of «predictive artificial intelligence» and establish its relevance for forecasting and strategic planning within public administration systems. The research draws on a comprehensive analysis of 33 publications retrieved from international scientometric databases, namely SCOPUS, ResearchGate, Springer Link, and eLibrary. Following James Cargile's methodological approach to real and nominal definitions, the study identified four key conceptual components that structured the real definition. Conversely, the nominal definition was circumscribed to the sphere of practical implementation in public administration. The comparative analysis identified key theoretical and methodological frameworks for integrating predictive analytics into public administration systems, with consideration given to institutional and operational specificity. These approaches emerge from integrated management science theory and practice across multiple functional domainsincluding financial, industrial, quality, educational, and general management. Central to these approaches is the application of mathematical modeling to convert data-driven analysis into forecasts that enable evidencebased managerial decision-making. Artificial intelligence, when applied to predictive analytics, operates strictly as a complementary instrument.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对俄罗斯公共行政系统中人工智能工具应用日益增多但缺乏统一术语定义的问题，通过分析33篇国际文献，基于James Cargile的定义方法论，提出了"预测性人工智能"的科学定义，并探讨了其在公共行政预测和战略规划中的应用框架。
AI.research_question: 如何科学定义"预测性人工智能"并确立其在公共行政系统预测和战略规划中的相关性？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯公共行政系统中人工智能工具实施增加，但缺乏统一的"预测性人工智能"术语定义，导致信息不对称和管理失衡，影响公共机构的预测机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: James Cargile的现实定义和名义定义方法论；集成管理科学理论（涵盖财务、工业、质量、教育和一般管理）；数学建模理论；预测分析理论。
AI.method: 对来自SCOPUS、ResearchGate、Springer Link和eLibrary的33篇国际文献进行综合分析；应用James Cargile的定义方法论，识别现实定义的四个关键概念组成部分；名义定义限定于公共行政实践应用领域；比较分析预测分析融入公共行政系统的理论和方法框架。
AI.findings: 1. 识别了构成"预测性人工智能"现实定义的四个关键概念组成部分；2. 将名义定义限定于公共行政实践领域；3. 确定了将预测分析整合到公共行政系统的关键理论和方法框架；4. 发现人工智能在预测分析中仅作为补充工具，核心是数学建模将数据分析转化为支持管理决策的预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了"预测性人工智能"的科学定义；2. 建立了预测人工智能在公共行政中的理论框架；3. 整合了多领域管理科学理论；4. 应用了定义方法论来澄清概念混淆。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为俄罗斯公共行政系统提供了统一的术语定义；2. 减少了信息不对称和管理失衡；3. 为预测机制和战略规划提供了操作框架；4. 强调了人工智能作为补充工具而非替代品的角色；5. 促进了基于证据的管理决策。

title: A Unified Automation Framework for Telecom Divestiture Programs: AI-Driven Test Case Generation, Selenium Reusable Frameworks, and Java Microservices/API Integration

detail.title: A Unified Automation Framework for Telecom Divestiture Programs: AI-Driven Test Case Generation, Selenium Reusable Frameworks, and Java Microservices/API Integration
detail.abstract: Large-scale telecom divestiture and modernization programs require precise end-to-end validation, rapid scenario creation, and repeatable automation across complex legacy and cloud-native ecosystems. Traditional testing approaches cannot scale effectively due to distributed systems, high-volume API interactions, and compressed separation timelines. This paper introduces a first-of-its-kind, telecom-grade, reusable automation framework combining Selenium-based UI automation, Java microservices API validation, process automation, integration mapping, and AI-driven test case generation. Applied in a global telecom divestiture program, the framework reduced test cycles by 70-85%, eliminated thousands of manual hours, improved regression efficiency by 60-70%, and resulted in multi-million-dollar savings. The framework is industry-agnostic and applicable to modernization, divestiture, or cloud migration projects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个电信级可复用自动化框架，结合Selenium UI自动化、Java微服务API验证、流程自动化、集成映射和AI驱动测试用例生成，在电信剥离项目中减少测试周期70-85%，节省数百万美元。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个可扩展的自动化框架来解决大规模电信剥离和现代化项目中传统测试方法无法有效应对分布式系统、高容量API交互和紧迫时间表的问题？
AI.motivation: 大规模电信剥离和现代化项目需要端到端验证、快速场景创建和跨复杂遗留与云原生生态系统的可重复自动化。传统测试方法由于分布式系统、高容量API交互和紧迫的分离时间表而无法有效扩展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动化测试框架理论、软件测试工程、DevOps/TestOps实践、AI在测试中的应用、电信系统架构理论。
AI.method: 开发了一个结合Selenium UI自动化、Java微服务API验证、流程自动化、集成映射和AI驱动测试用例生成的电信级可复用自动化框架，并在全球电信剥离项目中应用验证。
AI.findings: 该框架在电信剥离项目中：1) 减少测试周期70-85%；2) 消除数千手动小时；3) 提高回归效率60-70%；4) 实现数百万美元的成本节约。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出首个电信级可复用自动化框架理论；2) 建立跨复杂生态系统的端到端验证方法；3) 将AI驱动测试生成与传统自动化测试方法结合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供行业无关的框架，适用于现代化、剥离或云迁移项目；2) 显著提升测试效率和成本效益；3) 为类似大规模系统集成项目提供可复用的解决方案。

title: The Paradox of Digital Invisibility: Quantifying the Impact of Algorithmic Blindness in Corporate Data (N=150 Analysis)

detail.title: The Paradox of Digital Invisibility: Quantifying the Impact of Algorithmic Blindness in Corporate Data (N=150 Analysis)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares a professional affiliation with QCSM Lab, a private research initiative developing standards for algorithmic visibility. The methodology proposed in this paper is related to proprietary frameworks developed by the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves the analysis of publicly available web architecture data and corporate entities. No human participants or private personally identifiable information (PII) were involved in this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was supported by the internal resources of QCSM Lab.

detail.abstract: Current digital marketing metrics rely heavily on "traffic volume" as a proxy for relevance. However, the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) requires a shift from popularity-based metrics to structural-based retrieval. This study analyzes N=150 corporate websites across 10 heterogeneous industries to test a new hypothesis: that "Structural Hygiene" (e.g., canonical tags, schema markup) is a stronger predictor of Generative AI visibility than brand popularity. Using an OLS regression model, we achieved a predictive power of R²=91.82%, but uncovered a critical "Statistical Collapse" (VIF > 42) due to multicollinearity between brand noise and technical signal. This paper presents the "QCSM Paradox": high-value/low-traffic sites remain invisible to LLMs due to architectural flaws, creating "AI Hallucinations" based on data ingestion failures. We propose the Quality Certification Scoring Model (QCSM) as a new engineering standard to isolate technical merit from brand noise.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在大型语言模型时代，网站的结构卫生（如规范标签、模式标记）比品牌知名度更能预测生成式AI的可见性。研究揭示了"QCSM悖论"：高价值低流量网站因架构缺陷而对LLMs不可见，导致基于数据摄取失败的AI幻觉。作者提出了质量认证评分模型（QCSM）作为新的工程标准。
AI.research_question: 在大型语言模型时代，网站的结构卫生（技术架构质量）是否比品牌知名度更能预测生成式AI的可见性？
AI.motivation: 当前数字营销指标过度依赖"流量量"作为相关性代理，但LLMs的兴起需要从基于流行度的指标转向基于结构的检索。需要验证结构卫生是否比品牌知名度更能预测AI可见性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 结构卫生理论（Structural Hygiene）：网站技术架构质量，包括规范标签、模式标记等技术要素
2. QCSM悖论：高价值低流量网站因架构缺陷而对LLMs不可见的现象
3. 统计崩溃（Statistical Collapse）：品牌噪声与技术信号之间的多重共线性问题
4. AI幻觉理论：基于数据摄取失败产生的AI错误输出
AI.method:
1. 样本：N=150个企业网站，覆盖10个异质行业
2. 分析框架：测试结构卫生是否比品牌知名度更能预测生成式AI可见性
3. 统计方法：OLS回归模型
4. 诊断分析：方差膨胀因子（VIF）检测多重共线性
AI.findings:
1. OLS回归模型预测力达R²=91.82%，显示结构卫生是AI可见性的强预测因子
2. 发现严重的"统计崩溃"现象（VIF > 42），源于品牌噪声与技术信号的多重共线性
3. 揭示了QCSM悖论：高价值低流量网站因架构缺陷而对LLMs不可见
4. 识别了AI幻觉的产生机制：数据摄取失败导致LLMs基于不完整信息生成错误内容
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了结构卫生作为AI可见性预测的新理论框架
2. 发展了QCSM悖论理论，解释高价值网站AI不可见现象
3. 建立了统计崩溃概念，描述品牌与技术信号的多重共线性问题
4. 完善了AI幻觉理论，连接数据摄取失败与错误输出
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出质量认证评分模型（QCSM）作为新的工程标准
2. 提供分离技术价值与品牌噪声的方法论
3. 为企业优化网站架构以提升AI可见性提供指导
4. 为数字营销指标从流量量转向结构质量提供实践框架

title: Technical Architecture & Governance of TML Smart Contracts: A Deterministic Enforcement Layer for Ternary Moral Logic

detail.title: Technical Architecture & Governance of TML Smart Contracts: A Deterministic Enforcement Layer for Ternary Moral Logic
detail.abstract:
This paper defines the high-level system architecture for Ternary Moral Logic (TML), a governance framework that replaces the binary "Code is Law" model with a Tri-State "Logic is Constitution" paradigm. It introduces the ecosystem's core components:

  • The Lantern Signal: A cryptographic proof of hesitation that signals the system has encountered an ethical "Zero" state (The Sacred Zero).

  • The Hybrid Shield: A cross-chain redundancy mechanism ensuring moral continuity even during network failures.

  • The Goukassian Promise: The foundational axiom that the system must always retain the capacity to pause and reflect before execution.

This architecture serves as the "Vision" layer, establishing the deterministic environment in which the TML Finite State Machine operates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三元道德逻辑（TML）的高层系统架构，用三态"逻辑即宪法"范式取代了二元"代码即法律"模型，引入了灯笼信号、混合护盾和高斯承诺等核心组件，为TML有限状态机建立确定性环境。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够处理道德困境的三态治理框架，以替代传统的二元"代码即法律"模型？
AI.motivation: 传统区块链治理中的"代码即法律"二元模型无法有效处理复杂的道德和伦理困境，需要一种能够容纳犹豫、反思和暂停能力的三态治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元道德逻辑（TML）、三态"逻辑即宪法"范式、高斯承诺公理、神圣零状态理论。
AI.method: 系统架构设计方法，包括定义核心组件（灯笼信号、混合护盾、高斯承诺）和建立高层系统架构作为"愿景层"。
AI.findings: 成功定义了TML的高层系统架构，建立了包含灯笼信号（犹豫证明）、混合护盾（跨链冗余）和高斯承诺（暂停能力公理）的三态治理框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从二元"代码即法律"到三态"逻辑即宪法"的范式转变，引入了道德零状态概念和系统必须保留暂停反思能力的基本公理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区块链治理提供了可处理道德困境的实际架构，建立了跨链冗余机制确保道德连续性，为TML有限状态机提供了确定性操作环境。

title: The Shape of Agreement: Topological Foundations for Cooperative Logistics and Economic Alignment

detail.title: The Shape of Agreement: Topological Foundations for Cooperative Logistics and Economic Alignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Black River Systems, an entity that intends to develop commercial applications based on the topological framework described in this paper. There are no other competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research is a theoretical mathematical analysis and did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or the use of sensitive personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author and Black River Systems. No external grants or institutional funding were used.

detail.abstract: Modern logistics and economic architectures predominantly rely on Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). These structures enforce rigid and adversarial hierarchies. In this paper, we propose a transition toward a 'Topological Economy' modeled on Simplicial Homology and Cellular Sheaf Theory. We argue that while legacy DAG-based systems incentivize the Prisoner's Dilemma, a Sheaf-theoretic framework creates a structural incentive for cooperation. By defining systemic waste as the First Cohomology Group (H¹) and utilizing the Dirichlet Energy as a cost function for friction, we propose a model where cooperative alignment minimizes systemic cost. We suggest that in a Cooperative Sheaf, the most efficient state is mathematically analogous to the global harmonic state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从传统DAG经济结构转向基于单纯同调和层论的拓扑经济模型，认为层论框架能创造合作的结构性激励，将系统浪费定义为第一上同调群，用狄利克雷能量作为摩擦成本函数，合作对齐可最小化系统成本。
AI.research_question: 如何从传统DAG经济结构转向基于单纯同调和层论的拓扑经济模型，以创造合作的结构性激励并最小化系统成本？
AI.motivation: 现代物流和经济架构主要依赖有向无环图(DAGs)，这些结构强制了僵化和对抗性的层级关系，激励了囚徒困境，需要新的经济模型来促进合作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单纯同调理论、层论、拓扑经济学、第一上同调群(H¹)作为系统浪费的度量、狄利克雷能量作为摩擦成本函数、全局调和状态作为最有效状态。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，将经济系统抽象为拓扑结构，定义系统浪费为第一上同调群，使用狄利克雷能量作为成本函数，分析合作层中的全局调和状态。
AI.findings: 在合作层框架中，最有效的状态在数学上等同于全局调和状态，合作对齐可以最小化系统成本，层论框架创造了合作的结构性激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了拓扑经济学的新理论框架，将单纯同调和层论应用于经济系统分析，定义了系统浪费的数学形式化度量(H¹)，建立了合作激励的数学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计促进合作的经济系统提供了理论指导，为评估和优化经济效率提供了新的数学工具，为从对抗性DAG结构向合作性拓扑结构转型提供了框架。

title: Virtual Multi-Cloud Gateway with AI-Assisted Validation

detail.title: Virtual Multi-Cloud Gateway with AI-Assisted Validation
detail.abstract: Multi-cloud architectures are widely adopted to improve resilience, cost efficiency, and workload placement, driven by enterprises' pursuit of flexibility and avoidance of vendor lock-in. However, interconnecting heterogeneous cloud platforms introduces routing complexity, latency overhead, and operational challenges. Traditional network topologies struggle to enforce consistent policy and performance across diverse environments, particularly when dynamic adaptation is required. This paper presents a virtual multi-cloud gateway that enables centralized Layer-3 routing, automated policy control, and private deterministic connectivity across public clouds, enterprise data centers, and on-premises environments. The proposed architecture unifies cross-domain networking via dynamic route orchestration while providing enterprise-grade segmentation and security. To verify robustness, we develop an automated validation framework that integrates AI-driven scenario generation using IBM Watsonx. The framework autonomously generates test cases, analyzes telemetry, predicts routing conflicts, and provides optimization recommendations, enabling continuous validation at scale. Experimental results illustrate substantial improvements in latency, operational efficiency, test coverage, and consistency of policy enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种虚拟多云网关架构，通过集中式三层路由、自动化策略控制和私有确定性连接，解决多云环境中的路由复杂性、延迟开销和操作挑战问题。同时开发了集成AI驱动场景生成的自动化验证框架，显著提升了延迟、操作效率、测试覆盖率和策略执行一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够统一异构多云平台网络连接、提供集中式路由和自动化策略控制，同时确保私有确定性连接和一致性能的虚拟多云网关架构？
AI.motivation: 多云架构虽能提高弹性、成本效益和工作负载部署灵活性，但异构云平台互连带来了路由复杂性、延迟开销和操作挑战。传统网络拓扑难以在多样化环境中强制执行一致的策略和性能，特别是在需要动态适应的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 多云网络架构理论：研究异构云平台间的网络互联模式
2. 软件定义网络（SDN）原理：集中式控制与数据平面分离
3. 动态路由编排理论：跨域网络统一管理
4. 企业级网络分段与安全模型：确保多云环境中的安全隔离
AI.method:
1. 提出虚拟多云网关架构设计
2. 开发自动化验证框架，集成IBM Watsonx进行AI驱动场景生成
3. 实施动态路由编排机制
4. 构建企业级分段和安全控制
5. 通过实验验证架构的延迟、操作效率和策略一致性改进
AI.findings: 实验结果显示：1）在延迟方面有显著改善；2）操作效率大幅提升；3）测试覆盖率得到增强；4）策略执行一致性明显提高。验证框架能够自主生成测试用例、分析遥测数据、预测路由冲突并提供优化建议。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了虚拟多云网关的统一网络架构理论
2. 发展了跨异构云平台的动态路由编排理论
3. 建立了多云环境中企业级分段和安全的理论模型
4. 贡献了AI驱动自动化验证框架的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供可部署的虚拟多云网关解决方案
2. 开发了集成IBM Watsonx的自动化验证工具
3. 为企业实施多云架构提供了操作指南
4. 显著降低了多云网络管理的复杂性和成本
5. 提高了多云环境的网络性能和安全性

title: Interpretive Debt: How High Coherence AI Reshapes Human Judgement, Authority, and Accountability

detail.title: Interpretive Debt: How High Coherence AI Reshapes Human Judgement, Authority, and Accountability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Author self-funded the research

detail.abstract:
As generative artificial intelligence systems become increasingly fluent and reliable, attention has focused on risks arising from error, bias, and misalignment. This paper argues that a distinct class of socio-technical risk emerges not when AI systems fail, but when they work well. Under conditions of sustained, high-coherence interaction, AI systems can gradually reshape how humans frame problems, justify decisions, and assign authority—producing what this paper terms interpretive debt.

Interpretive debt is defined as the cumulative erosion of human interpretive authority arising through ordinary, good-faith use of AI systems. Unlike automation bias or misuse, it does not depend on incorrect outputs or deceptive behavior. Instead, it operates at the interaction layer: fluent systems increasingly supply framing, vocabulary, and justificatory structure, narrowing the range of interpretations users experience as available, legitimate, or worth pursuing. These shifts may leave short-term performance intact while undermining long-term judgment, accountability, and institutional responsibility.

Drawing on a first-person, longitudinal analysis of sustained interaction with high-coherence language models, the paper situates interpretive debt within existing research on distributed cognition, automation bias, and AI governance. It argues that prevailing model-centered governance frameworks are insufficient to address risks that arise from interaction rather than malfunction. Even aligned, accurate systems can generate interpretive risk by redistributing authority rather than producing error.

To complement model-side controls, the paper proposes principles for human-side governance aimed at preserving interpretive optionality, proportionality, reversibility, and privacy in AI-mediated environments. Rather than governing machines more tightly, this approach focuses on governing interaction—treating interpretive authority as a critical but vulnerable human capacity. By reframing AI risk in terms of meaning, authority, and responsibility, this work contributes a governance perspective oriented toward sustaining human agency in an increasingly AI-mediated society.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"解释性债务"概念，指AI系统正常运行而非出错时，通过持续高连贯性交互逐渐侵蚀人类解释权威的累积风险，这会影响问题框架、决策理由和权威分配，威胁长期判断和问责。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统运行良好而非出错时，如何理解其通过持续高连贯性交互对人类解释权威产生的累积侵蚀风险？
AI.motivation: 当前AI风险研究主要关注错误、偏见和不对齐问题，但忽视了AI系统正常运行时的风险。本文旨在识别当AI系统工作良好时，通过持续交互对人类解释权威产生的独特社会技术风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式认知理论、自动化偏见研究、AI治理框架，以及本文提出的"解释性债务"概念。
AI.method: 第一人称纵向分析，对高连贯性语言模型进行持续交互的实证研究。
AI.findings: 流畅的AI系统通过提供框架、词汇和论证结构，逐渐缩小用户认为可用、合法或值得追求的解释范围，即使短期性能不受影响，也会损害长期判断、问责和制度责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"解释性债务"新概念，将AI风险从错误/偏见转向意义、权威和责任维度；挑战以模型为中心的治理框架，强调交互层面的风险；为AI治理提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"人类侧治理"原则，包括保持解释可选性、比例性、可逆性和隐私性；建议治理重点从机器控制转向交互治理；为维持人类在AI中介社会中的能动性提供实践指导。

title: Technical Architecture & Governance of TML Smart Contracts: The Deterministic Enforcement Layer for Ethical AI

detail.title: Technical Architecture & Governance of TML Smart Contracts: The Deterministic Enforcement Layer for Ethical AI
detail.abstract:
This paper provides a rigorous security audit and adversarial analysis of the Ternary Moral Logic (TML) smart contract system. It mathematically verifies the "No God Mode" principle, demonstrating that no administrative key can override a constitutional integrity freeze once the "Sacred Zero" state is triggered.

The analysis covers:

  • The Zero-State Trap: Verifying that a transition to the 'Review' state is irreversible by external actors and can only be resolved by the designated Stewardship Council.

  • Sybil Resistance: Analyzing the "Lantern Signal" mechanism against spam attacks.

  • Immutability Proofs: Demonstrating that the ethical axioms embedded in the bytecode are resistant to unauthorized upgrades or proxy pattern manipulations.

This document serves as the "Defense" layer, proving the resilience of the constitutional logic against both internal corruption and external attack vectors.

AI.tldr: 本文对三元道德逻辑智能合约系统进行了严格的安全审计和对抗分析，数学验证了"无上帝模式"原则，证明一旦触发"神圣零状态"，任何管理密钥都无法覆盖宪法完整性冻结。
AI.research_question: 三元道德逻辑智能合约系统的安全性和抗攻击能力如何？特别是其"无上帝模式"原则、零状态陷阱机制、Sybil抵抗能力和不可变性证明是否有效？
AI.motivation: 随着智能合约在道德和治理系统中的广泛应用，确保其安全性和抗操纵性变得至关重要。需要验证这些系统能否抵抗内部腐败和外部攻击，特别是当涉及宪法性道德逻辑时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智能合约安全审计理论、对抗分析框架、区块链不可变性原理、Sybil攻击抵抗理论，以及宪法性治理系统的设计原则。
AI.method: 采用数学验证方法、形式化安全审计、对抗性分析、机制设计验证，以及针对特定攻击向量的系统性测试。
AI.findings: 1) "无上帝模式"原则得到数学验证；2) 零状态陷阱机制确保状态转换不可逆；3) "灯笼信号"机制有效抵抗Sybil攻击；4) 道德公理在字节码中的嵌入具有抗未经授权升级的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为道德逻辑智能合约系统提供了形式化安全验证框架；2) 发展了宪法性冻结机制的理论基础；3) 提出了针对Sybil攻击的新型抵抗机制理论；4) 建立了道德公理在智能合约中的不可变性证明方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为TML系统提供了可操作的安全审计报告；2) 为类似道德治理系统提供了安全设计参考；3) 开发了对抗内部腐败和外部攻击的防御层；4) 为监管机构和用户提供了系统安全性的可靠证明。

title: Comparison of AI-assisted and human-produced podcasts derived from Cochrane PLSs: protocol for a randomised non-inferiority trial (HIET-2)
affiliations: University of Galway, University of Galway, University of Galway, University College Cork - School of Public Health, National University of Ireland Galway - HRB-Clinical Research Facility, University of Galway, University of Galway, University of Galway, University of Galway, University of Galway, University College London, University of Galway, University of Galway, University of Galway, University of Galway and University of Galway

detail.title: Comparison of AI-assisted and human-produced podcasts derived from Cochrane PLSs: protocol for a randomised non-inferiority trial (HIET-2)
detail.abstract: Podcasts can make health evidence easier to follow, but it is unclear whether AI-assisted production can match human production when both use the same audio format. We will run a randomised, two-arm, non-inferiority trial comparing AI-assisted podcasts with human-produced podcasts. Adults (≥18 years; English-proficient) will be recruited via Prolific and randomly allocated 1:1 to listen to three short episodes (6–8 minutes each) based on the same Cochrane Plain Language Summaries (PLSs). The AI arm uses Wondercraft AI in a human-in-the-loop workflow; the human arm features experienced communicators working to an identical brief. In both arms, content is limited to the PLSs, with authorship masked for participants and expert raters. The primary outcome is comprehension, measured by a 10-item test per episode, with the primary analysis using the participant-level mean score across the three episodes, aligned with the QUEST “Understanding” dimension. Secondary outcomes include format accessibility (listenability), quality of information, perceived trust, and safety. Non-inferiority margins are pre-specified; for comprehension, the margin is 1 point on the 10-item scale. If non-inferiority is shown, we will also assess superiority. We plan to recruit 458 participants. Differences between arms will be estimated using appropriate repeated-measures models, with two-sided 95% confidence intervals. This trial evaluates whether a vetted AI workflow can match human communicators on comprehension, quality, safety, accessibility, and trust when both deliver podcasts derived from the same evidence base. By providing head-to-head evidence in the same audio format, the study will address a practical question faced by journals and health organisations already experimenting with AI tools: can AI generate clear, safe, and trusted audio content at scale, and where is human input still indispensable.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验比较AI辅助制作与人类制作的健康播客在理解度、质量、安全性、可访问性和信任度方面的表现，评估AI能否在相同音频格式下达到人类水平。
AI.research_question: AI辅助制作的播客在理解度、质量、安全性、可访问性和信任度方面是否不劣于人类制作的播客？
AI.motivation: 播客能提升健康证据的可理解性，但AI辅助制作能否达到人类制作水平尚不明确。期刊和健康组织正在试验AI工具，需要了解AI能否大规模生成清晰、安全、可信的音频内容，以及人类输入在哪些方面仍然不可或缺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cochrane简明语言摘要（PLS）作为统一证据基础，使用QUEST工具的"理解"维度作为主要评估框架，结合格式可访问性、信息质量、感知信任和安全性等多维度评估体系。
AI.method: 随机、双臂、非劣效性试验设计。招募458名英语熟练的成年人，随机分配1:1到AI辅助组（使用Wondercraft AI的人机协作流程）或人类制作组（经验丰富的传播者）。两组都基于相同的Cochrane PLS制作三集短播客（每集6-8分钟），内容仅限于PLS，作者身份对参与者和专家评估者隐藏。主要结局是理解度（每集10项测试），次要结局包括格式可访问性、信息质量、感知信任和安全性。
AI.findings: 论文摘要未提供具体结果，但描述了研究设计和分析方法。将使用适当的重复测量模型估计组间差异，计算双侧95%置信区间。如果显示非劣效性，还将评估优效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在健康传播领域的应用提供实证证据，建立AI辅助内容制作与人类制作的可比性评估框架，拓展人机协作在科学传播中的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期刊和健康组织提供决策依据：明确AI能否大规模生成清晰、安全、可信的音频内容，识别人类输入仍然不可或缺的环节，指导AI工具在健康传播中的实际应用。

title: TML Smart Contracts: Automating Ethics and Accountability on the Blockchain

detail.title: TML Smart Contracts: Automating Ethics and Accountability on the Blockchain
detail.abstract:
This whitepaper details the economic and operational enforcement layer of the Ternary Moral Logic (TML) framework. Addressing the "Implementation Gap" in AI ethics, this paper demonstrates how to replace voluntary compliance with automated, smart-contract-based enforcement mechanisms.

The analysis defines the economic game theory behind:

  • The Penalty Enforcement Contract: A deterministic mechanism for executing financial penalties upon cryptographically verified ethical violations.

  • The Whistleblower Reward Contract: An anonymous, incentivized reporting structure designed to prevent institutional capture and corruption.

  • The Memorial Fund: A perpetual, self-governing stewardship model for restitution.

This document presents the "Law & Economics" of the TML system, proving that ethical axioms can be sustained through automated economic incentives and immutable governance code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三元道德逻辑（TML）框架的经济与操作执行层，通过智能合约自动化执行机制解决AI伦理中的"实施缺口"，用经济激励取代自愿合规。
AI.research_question: 如何通过自动化、基于智能合约的执行机制来解决AI伦理中的"实施缺口"，用经济激励取代自愿合规？
AI.motivation: 当前AI伦理主要依赖自愿合规，存在"实施缺口"，需要可执行的、自动化的机制来确保伦理原则得到实际遵守。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元道德逻辑（TML）框架、法律与经济学理论、博弈论、智能合约理论、加密经济学。
AI.method: 理论分析：设计三种智能合约机制（惩罚执行合约、举报者奖励合约、纪念基金），并分析其经济博弈论基础。
AI.findings: 通过三种智能合约机制可以实现伦理原则的自动化执行：惩罚执行合约对经加密验证的伦理违规执行财务惩罚；举报者奖励合约提供匿名激励报告机制防止机构腐败；纪念基金建立永续自我治理的赔偿模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将伦理原则转化为可执行经济激励的理论框架，证明了伦理公理可以通过自动化经济激励和不可变治理代码来维持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI伦理实施提供了具体的智能合约解决方案，包括惩罚、举报和赔偿三个核心机制，为实际部署提供了技术蓝图。

title: Technical Architecture & Governance of TML Smart Contracts

detail.title: Technical Architecture & Governance of TML Smart Contracts
detail.abstract:
This technical specification details the execution layer of the Ternary Moral Logic (TML) framework. It defines the Finite State Machine (FSM) logic that governs the transition between moral states:

  • STATE_ACTIVE: The default operational mode.

  • STATE_REVIEW_HOLD: Triggered by a "Sacred Zero" signal, pausing execution for Council review.

  • STATE_INTEGRITY_FROZEN: The terminal state where the contract is permanently locked if a constitutional violation is confirmed.

The paper includes the Solidity interface definitions (ITMLEnforcer) and the "Always Memory" pointer architecture, ensuring that every decision leaves an immutable, auditable trace on the blockchain.

AI.tldr: 本文详细介绍了三元道德逻辑（TML）框架的执行层技术规范，定义了管理道德状态转换的有限状态机逻辑，包括三种状态：活跃状态、审查暂停状态和完整性冻结状态，并提供了Solidity接口定义和"Always Memory"指针架构，确保所有决策在区块链上留下不可变的可审计痕迹。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于区块链的道德决策执行框架，确保智能合约的道德合规性和可审计性？
AI.motivation: 随着智能合约在金融和社会领域的广泛应用，需要确保这些自动化系统遵守道德规范和宪法约束，防止道德风险和技术滥用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元道德逻辑（TML）理论框架，结合有限状态机（FSM）理论和区块链不可变性原理，构建道德决策执行系统。
AI.method: 技术规范方法，通过定义状态转换逻辑、Solidity接口设计和"Always Memory"指针架构，实现道德执行层的技术实现。
AI.findings: 成功设计了包含三种状态（STATE_ACTIVE, STATE_REVIEW_HOLD, STATE_INTEGRITY_FROZEN）的有限状态机，实现了道德决策的暂停审查和永久锁定机制，并通过区块链技术确保了决策痕迹的不可变性和可审计性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了三元道德逻辑（TML）的理论框架，将道德决策过程形式化为有限状态机，为智能合约的道德合规性提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实施的Solidity接口（ITMLEnforcer）和"Always Memory"指针架构，使道德执行层能够在实际区块链系统中部署，为智能合约的道德监管提供了技术解决方案。

title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage
affiliations: Stanford University and Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) - Centre de Recerca en Economia Internacional (CREI)

detail.title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is changing which tasks workers do and how they do them. Predicting its labor market consequences requires understanding how technical change affects workers’ productivity across tasks, how workers adapt by changing occupations and acquiring new skills, and how wages adjust in general equilibrium. We introduce a dynamic task-based model in which workers accumulate multidimensional skills that shape their comparative advantage and, in turn, their occupational choices. We then develop an estimation strategy that recovers (i) the mapping from skills to task-specific productivity, (ii) the law of motion for skill accumulation, and (iii) the determinants of occupational choice. We use the quantified model to study generative AI’s impact via augmentation, automation, and a third and new channel — simplification — which captures how technologies change the skills needed to perform tasks. Our key finding is that AI substantially reduces wage inequality while raising average wages by 21 percent. AI’s equalizing effect is fully driven by simplification, enabling workers across skill levels to compete for the same jobs. We show that the model’s predictions line up with recent labor market data.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个动态任务模型，研究人工智能如何通过自动化、增强和简化三种渠道影响劳动力市场，发现AI能显著降低工资不平等，同时使平均工资提高21%，其平等化效应主要来自简化渠道。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何通过自动化、增强和简化三种渠道影响劳动力市场，特别是对工资不平等和平均工资的影响？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在改变工人的工作任务和方式，需要理解技术变革如何影响工人的任务生产率、工人如何通过改变职业和获取新技能来适应，以及工资如何在一般均衡中调整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态任务模型，工人积累多维技能塑造其比较优势，进而影响职业选择；技能积累的动态规律；任务特定生产率与技能的关系。
AI.method: 开发估计策略，恢复：(i)技能到任务特定生产率的映射，(ii)技能积累的动态规律，(iii)职业选择的决定因素；使用量化模型研究生成式AI的影响。
AI.findings: AI通过简化渠道显著降低工资不平等，同时使平均工资提高21%；简化使不同技能水平的工人能够竞争相同的工作；模型预测与近期劳动力市场数据一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入动态任务模型，包含多维技能积累和比较优势；提出AI影响的三个渠道：自动化、增强和简化（新渠道）；建立技能积累与职业选择的动态联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供AI对劳动力市场影响的量化分析；揭示AI可能减少工资不平等的机制；帮助理解工人如何适应技术变革；为教育和培训政策提供参考。

title: How Parenting Styles Shape Children’s Lifetime Outcomes
affiliations: University of Bonn, Maastricht University - Research Centre for Education and the Labour Market (ROA), Stockholm University,  and Maastricht University

detail.title: How Parenting Styles Shape Children’s Lifetime Outcomes

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines how parenting styles predict children’s lifetime outcomes. Using a Swedish dataset which combines rich survey information on parenting styles with administrative records tracking children over five decades, we find that authoritarian parenting is negatively associated with children’s long-term success, especially regarding their educational attainment. The results for other parenting styles are more mixed. Authoritarian parenting remains a robust predictor of adverse outcomes even when accounting for ability and family background. We identify children’s knowledge accumulation and parental educational expectations as key mechanisms explaining these results.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用瑞典数据发现，专制型教养方式对子女的长期成功（尤其是教育成就）有负面影响，而其他教养方式的影响则较为复杂。即使控制能力和家庭背景，专制型教养仍是负面结果的稳健预测因子，知识积累和父母教育期望是主要机制。
AI.research_question: 教养方式如何预测子女的终身成果？专制型教养方式是否对子女的长期成功产生负面影响？哪些机制解释了这种影响？
AI.motivation: 理解不同教养方式对子女长期发展的影响，特别是专制型教养方式是否对子女的教育成就和终身成功产生负面影响，以及这种影响背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教养方式理论（专制型、权威型、放任型等），结合人力资本理论和社会化理论，探讨教养方式如何通过不同机制影响子女的长期发展。
AI.method: 使用瑞典数据集，结合丰富的教养方式调查信息和追踪子女超过五十年的行政记录，进行纵向分析。控制能力和家庭背景等变量，识别关键机制。
AI.findings: 专制型教养方式与子女的长期成功（特别是教育成就）呈负相关。其他教养方式的结果较为复杂。即使控制能力和家庭背景，专制型教养仍是负面结果的稳健预测因子。子女的知识积累和父母的教育期望是解释这些结果的关键机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为教养方式理论提供了长期影响的实证证据；2. 识别了专制型教养方式对子女终身成果的具体影响路径；3. 揭示了知识积累和父母期望作为关键机制的理论意义；4. 在控制能力和家庭背景后仍发现显著影响，强化了教养方式独立效应的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为父母和教育工作者提供教养方式选择的实证依据；2. 强调减少专制型教养方式的重要性；3. 指出通过促进知识积累和调整教育期望来改善子女长期成果的实践路径；4. 为家庭教育政策制定提供参考依据。
